Dustin personally escorted him beyond the borders of the Wisteria Star River.
"Why are you leaving so soon?"
Dustin asked.
"Are you uncomfortable staying in our territory?"
"Not at all."
Daniel smiled.
"I’d actually be perfectly happy freeloading here with the Chaos Humans."
"It’s just that..."
"I can feel my next breakthrough approaching."
Dustin immediately felt another crushing blow to his confidence.
You only broke through recently!
And now you’re about to advance again?
Back when they first met, both of them had stood at the peak of the Demi Sage realm.
Now...
Dustin had only reached Divine Radiant.
Meanwhile, Faustus had already become a Divine Sovereign...
and was somehow preparing to break through yet again.
The distance between them was only growing wider.
Faustus truly isn’t a normal person...
Dustin silently composed himself before speaking sincerely.
"Then I wish you a successful breakthrough."
"Thank you."
Daniel nodded.
The Imperial Bow Ark continued sailing through Chaosverse.
Meanwhile, Daniel extended his consciousness into the Ivahpin World.
That mysterious space could be entered no matter where he happened to be.
While wandering through Ivahpin World, he quickly noticed a newly posted mission related to Chaosverse.
The reward wasn’t particularly generous.
Yet it immediately caught his attention.
Companion Recruitment
A public sacred land has appeared within the Pyroflare Star River, Blooming Starfield, and Azurebird Star System of Chaosverse.
Seeking one companion for joint exploration.
Reward: 10,000 Contribution Points.
"A sacred land?"
Daniel’s eyes brightened.
Having cultivated the Law of Destiny, he could already vaguely sense that his breakthrough opportunity was connected to the Ring of Destiny.
He had been planning to search for a place rich in energy where he could cultivate.
However, he knew very little about Chaosverse.
Without guidance, he’d simply be wandering aimlessly.
Unexpectedly...
such an opportunity had appeared before him.
It would save him considerable effort.
He immediately accepted the mission and obtained the publisher’s contact information.
"Greetings."
A deep voice sounded from the other side of the Ivahpin Scroll.
"I am Thorne, a Divine Descendant of the Golden Holy Mountain."
"Hello."
Daniel calmly introduced himself.
"I am Faustus, a Divine Sovereign."
"A Divine Sovereign?"
Thorne was just about to decline.
After all, Divine Sovereigns generally lacked the qualifications necessary to survive within that sacred land.
Competition there would inevitably lead to fierce battles.
However...
the instant he heard the final word—
Faustus—
his attitude changed completely.
"My heavens!"
"Faustus?!"
"I never imagined it would be you!"
"What an unexpected surprise!"
Within the Golden Holy Mountain, that name had long become legendary.
Back when he was only a Demi Sage, he had already been recognized as the strongest Demi Sage in the Myriad-Star Cosmos.
Many even considered him the strongest Demi Sage in all known universes.
After advancing to the Divine Grade, he had leaped directly to the Divine Sovereign Realm.
Not long ago, he had shattered records on the Sky Trial Platform, earning treatment normally reserved for Quasi Oracle experts.
Those achievements had already spread throughout the Golden Holy Mountain by word of mouth.
Among those with even the slightest insight...
everyone understood one undeniable truth.
Faustus possessed limitless potential.

chapters.title: Chapter 409 -409-Thorne’s Recruitment for a Companion
paragraphs: How could Thorne possibly look down on him now?
He immediately changed his tone, his voice becoming noticeably more enthusiastic.
"So it’s you! I’ve long heard of your reputation—your name is known far and wide!"
Daniel blinked.
That attitude changed rather quickly.
"Thorne," he asked, "why are you still staying in Chaosverse?"
From what Daniel remembered, countless powerful cultivators had been desperate to escape.
Why would anyone voluntarily remain behind?
Thorne let out a long sigh, one filled with unmistakable helplessness.
"I offended an Oracle-grade powerhouse and had no choice but to flee here."
"The current situation in Chaosverse is incredibly complicated. That Oracle-grade expert doesn’t dare pursue me here recklessly."
"Right now, I’ve already reached the peak of the Divine Descendant Realm. I’m only one step away from becoming a Quasi Oracle."
"So I urgently need a sacred cultivation ground where I can advance in peace."
"Unfortunately, that place is open to the public. Everything there is decided by strength."
"If I go alone..."
"I honestly don’t have complete confidence."
Daniel immediately understood.
A so-called public sacred land was not ownerless territory.
It was always controlled by one or more powerful factions that simply allowed outside cultivators to enter after paying a certain fee.
As for what level of cultivation chamber one could occupy...
That depended entirely upon one’s own strength.
Ordinarily, a peak Divine Descendant was already strong enough.
However, Thorne was an extremely cautious person who preferred minimizing unnecessary risks.
That was why he had decided to recruit a trustworthy companion.
"How many people have you recruited so far?"
Daniel asked.
"None."
Thorne answered honestly.
"There simply aren’t many Golden Holy Mountain experts left in Chaosverse."
"Ever since the seal weakened, everyone who could leave already departed."
"I contacted quite a few people."
"In the end..."
"You were the only one who accepted my request."
So that was the reason.
The number of Golden Holy Mountain cultivators remaining inside Chaosverse had already dwindled to such an extent.
Daniel wasn’t particularly surprised.
"All right."
"Where shall we meet?"
"At the harbor of the Azurebird Star System."
"The sacred land lies within that star system."
"Once we leave the harbor, we’ll reach it very quickly."
"I happen to be inside the Pyroflare Star River right now."
"I’ll head over to Azurebird Star System immediately and wait for you there."
"Sounds good."
Daniel ended the communication.
Taking out his Star Chart, he examined his current location.
There was still quite a considerable distance between him and the Pyroflare Star River.
Several days later...
The Imperial Bow Ark slowly docked at the harbor of the Azurebird Star System.
After paying a batch of Origin Crystals as the entrance fee, Daniel followed the address Thorne had provided and arrived at a stone-built tavern beside the port.
Thorne was a burly member of the human race with crimson skin, though Daniel couldn’t immediately tell which human branch he belonged to.
His face was framed by a thick beard, giving him the appearance of an honest and straightforward man.
However...
Daniel could immediately tell that beneath that simple exterior hid someone remarkably meticulous and thoughtful.
"Thorne?"
"Lord Faustus!"
Thorne’s eyes immediately brightened as he stood to greet him.
"I’ve admired you for a very long time."
"Now that I’ve finally met you in person..."
"Your reputation truly lives up to its name."
"You flatter me."
Daniel preferred not to waste time.
"Do you have any unfinished business here?"
"If not, let’s depart immediately."
"None."
"Let’s go."
Thorne was equally decisive.
The two transformed into streaks of light and shot into the starry sky.
"That sacred land is jointly managed by several different factions."
Thorne began explaining.
"Paying ten thousand cubic units of Origin Crystals grants ten days of residence."
"The energy concentration inside is astonishing."
"More importantly..."
"It contains an ancient spacetime formation."
"At the highest-tier sanctuaries, cultivating for ten thousand years inside only corresponds to a single day passing outside."
A ten-thousandfold time flow...
Daniel couldn’t help recalling his own Chrono Temple.
However, that temple only allowed a single cultivator inside.
This sacred land, on the other hand, could accommodate numerous people simultaneously.
The difference was substantial.
"However..."
Thorne continued.
"Those ten-thousandfold sanctuaries have long been occupied by Oracle-grade experts."
"They’re beyond our reach."
"The best we can realistically hope for are the second-tier sanctuaries."
"They don’t reach ten thousand times, but several thousand-fold acceleration is still available."
"That’s already exceptionally good."
Several thousand times?
Daniel silently considered the matter.
He wasn’t entirely convinced that he had no chance of competing for one of the ten-thousandfold cultivation chambers.
After all...
He possessed several Oracle-grade treasures.
Even against genuine Oracle-grade experts, he wasn’t completely without confidence.
Naturally, he kept those thoughts to himself and simply listened.
The two continued chatting while traversing countless starfields.
Soon...
The outline of the public sacred land gradually appeared on the distant horizon.
From afar, it resembled a miniature world floating quietly within the depths of space.
Like a piece of amber abandoned among the stars.
Streams of light continuously flowed through its entrance.
The entire sacred land resembled an eternal marketplace built upon the edge of the void.
Bustling.
Lively.
Overflowing with cultivators.
Daniel and Thorne stopped before the glowing entrance.
Looking at the portal through which countless figures entered and departed...
Thorne continued his explanation.
"Most sacred lands are formed through the fusion of a living world and a secret realm."
"Certain life worlds naturally evolve special regions known as Treasure Lands."
"The spiritual energy gathered there is extraordinarily dense."
"Some Great Oracle-grade experts take those Treasure Lands as their foundation."
"They then infuse them with supreme Holy Relics before constructing numerous formations."
"In the end..."
"A sacred land is born."
"Of course..."
"There are also naturally occurring sacred lands created by the universe itself."
"You’ll occasionally encounter those within the Chaos Star Sea."
Daniel nodded thoughtfully.
Back then, the Star Relic he had obtained had likewise originated from one such naturally formed sacred land.
Without lingering further...
Both of them paid the entrance fee of ten thousand cubic units of Origin Crystals before passing through the portal.
For Daniel...
Ten thousand Origin Crystals weren’t worth mentioning.
But for the overwhelming majority of Divine-grade cultivators...
It was an amount painful enough to make one’s heart ache.
Out of the corner of his eye, Daniel noticed the obvious reluctance flashing across Thorne’s face.
He almost laughed.
Ten days...
No matter what...
I’d better secure one of those ten-thousandfold sanctuaries.
Anything with merely several times—or even dozens of times—the normal flow of time simply wasn’t worth the price.
After cultivating there for ten days, only a few months would pass outside.
Naturally, very few people chose those lower-tier chambers.
The most sought-after locations were the middle and upper levels, offering hundreds, thousands, or several thousand times faster cultivation.
Ironically...
The supreme ten-thousandfold sanctuaries were almost deserted.
Not because they lacked value.
Quite the opposite.
Almost every one of them had long since been claimed by Oracle-grade experts.
Anyone below Oracle Grade shouldn’t even dream of competing for them...
Unless they possessed the confidence to challenge an Oracle-grade cultivator directly.
Thorne’s original plan had been simple.
Find two sanctuaries with roughly a thousandfold time acceleration.
Occupying chambers at that level with his peak Divine Descendant cultivation wouldn’t involve excessive risk.
The method was equally straightforward.
If someone was already inside...
Throw them out.
Then move in yourself.
He planned to occupy one chamber while Daniel occupied another, allowing them to watch over each other if necessary.
Just then...
A lean, wiry figure suddenly emerged from the crowd.

chapters.title: Chapter 410 -410-A Divine Sovereign Challenging an Oracle-grade?
paragraphs: Whoosh...
A thin, bamboo-like figure darted toward them, his sharp eyes constantly scanning every passerby.
Stopping before the two of them, he bowed respectfully, lowering his posture as much as possible.
"My lords, I serve as a guide within this sanctuary. If you’re willing to hire me, I can save you a great deal of time."
"I also collect the latest intelligence from all across the Chaosverse. Stay here, and you’ll still know everything happening throughout the universe."
A guide?
Daniel’s eyes flickered.
This was the first time he had heard of such a profession.
But after giving it a little thought, it made perfect sense. Wherever there was demand, someone would always find a way to bridge the gap.
Daniel had always believed that if a problem could be solved with money, there was no need to waste his own time doing it personally.
"How do you charge?" he asked. "And what exactly can I get from you?"
The guide grinned.
"We make our living by selling information. Just tell me what you’re looking for, and I’ll point you in the right direction so you don’t wander this sanctuary blindly."
"After all, you both know this place is filled with all kinds of experts. Some people you can afford to offend..."
"...and some you absolutely cannot."
He deliberately paused, letting his gaze drift meaningfully between the two of them.
"As a complimentary piece of information, I can tell you that Lord Blaze, a Divine Descendant, intends to transfer ownership of his two-thousand-times time-flow sanctuary."
The moment those words left his mouth, Thorne’s curiosity was completely piqued.
He instinctively stepped forward.
"Name your price."
The guide answered unhurriedly.
"Information is priced according to its value. That depends on what you’re asking."
"I want to know where Blaze Divine Descendant’s sanctuary is."
The guide slowly raised five fingers.
"Five hundred cubic units of Origin Crystal."
"Once payment is made, I’ll give you Lord Blaze’s exact location."
Five hundred?
Even Daniel couldn’t help raising an eyebrow.
These guides certainly knew how to do business. A few sentences, and they had already earned a considerable sum.
Thorne hesitated for a moment before turning toward Daniel.
"Lord Faustus..."
Before he could continue, Daniel raised a hand to stop him.
"You don’t need to worry about me."
"I have other plans."
A sanctuary with only two thousand times the time acceleration...
That was nowhere near enough for him.
"If you want to buy it, just decide for yourself."
His tone remained completely calm.
Hearing that, Thorne secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
His original plan had been to partner with Daniel and seize the sanctuary by force. But now that the transaction had turned into a purchase, Daniel would naturally be left out.
After all, they hadn’t known each other long enough for Thorne to willingly pay double the price.
He had been wondering how to bring it up without sounding awkward.
Unexpectedly, Daniel had already seen through his thoughts and spared him the embarrassment.
As expected of Lord Faustus, Thorne thought.
Such generosity really is uncommon.
After offering a quick compliment, he hurriedly turned back toward the guide.
"How much Origin Crystal do I need to acquire Blaze Divine Descendant’s sanctuary? And is the defensive formation still intact?"
Now that he had received a customer, the guide naturally became extremely forthcoming.
People like him weren’t merely intelligence brokers—they also acted as intermediaries.
He could collect a commission from Thorne now, then turn around and receive another kickback from Blaze Divine Descendant later.
A profit from both sides.
"The current highest offer stands at 8,660 cubic units of Origin Crystal."
"You only need to bid higher than that."
"If no one raises the price within the next hour, the transaction will be finalized."
He continued,
"And Blaze Divine Descendant’s sanctuary still possesses its original defensive formation in perfect condition."
"Even an Oracle-grade expert would need considerable time to break through it."
"It’s an exceptionally safe location."
Thorne felt a sharp ache in his heart.
He had just spent ten thousand Origin Crystal to enter...
Now he was about to spend another ten thousand.
Still, after considering that this was for his breakthrough, he concluded the price was worth paying.
"I bid nine thousand Origin Crystal."
He gritted his teeth.
"Tell me where Blaze Divine Descendant is."
The guide immediately beamed with delight.
If this deal went through, his commission would be substantial.
He promptly provided the address.
Without wasting another second, Thorne departed immediately.
As long as no stronger bidder appeared within the next hour, the sanctuary would officially become his.
The guide then turned toward Daniel.
His experienced eyes lingered on him for a brief moment.
Years spent dealing with powerful experts had given him sharp instincts.
He was certain the man before him was anything but ordinary.
"My lord..."
"What kind of information are you looking for?"
Daniel blinked.
"I want to know whether any low-grade Oracle-grade cultivators occupy the ten-thousand-times time-flow sanctuaries."
The guide’s smile froze instantly.
A... a ten-thousand-times sanctuary?
This was definitely no ordinary Divine Sovereign.
This was someone who actually intended to compete directly with an Oracle-grade powerhouse.
Yet no matter how hard he thought, he simply couldn’t imagine what kind of Divine Sovereign would dare provoke an Oracle-grade expert.
Could this man possess an unimaginably powerful background?
"Please... give me a moment."
He quickly sorted through everything he knew.
"There is indeed one."
"A low-grade Oracle-grade currently occupies one of the ten-thousand-times sanctuaries."
"But what? Stop dragging it out."
"But that lord isn’t alone."
The guide studied Daniel carefully.
Daniel wasn’t even Oracle-grade...
Yet he wanted to challenge one.
The very idea sounded absurd.
More importantly, the Oracle-grade in question wasn’t an independent wanderer.
He belonged to a powerful organization.
That made all the difference.
Offending a lone cultivator meant making only one enemy.
You could go all out without worrying about consequences.
But offending someone backed by a major faction was another matter entirely.
Defeat the younger one...
The older generation would come.
Defeat them...
Even older monsters would appear.
It was an endless chain of retaliation.
Throughout the Endless Starsea, powerful cultivators almost always stood together in factions.
The guide wasn’t sure whether Daniel truly understood what he was getting into.
That was why he deliberately made the situation clear first, hoping Daniel would think carefully before making his decision.
"Just tell me everything you know about this Oracle-grade."
"The more detailed, the better."
Daniel remained completely unconcerned.
"I’m not short on Origin Crystal."
"One thousand cubic units of Origin Crystal."
"For that price, I’ll tell you everything I know."
The guide stopped hesitating.
The customer had already made his intentions perfectly clear.
If he refused the business, someone else would happily take it.
Daniel casually produced one thousand Origin Crystal.
To him, such an expense was practically insignificant.
The guide cleared his throat.
"The Oracle-grade lord is named Shar."
"He comes from Crown’s Summit, a faction based in the Violent Fish Star System within the Emberflow Star River."
"Lord Shar is a Second-Tier Oracle-grade. He advanced into that realm only a little over one million years ago."
"He is also the third-ranking elder of Crown’s Summit."
"He has two sworn brothers who are likewise elders of the organization."
"One has already reached the peak of the Second Tier."
"The other has advanced to the Third-Tier Oracle-grade."
"As for the ten-thousand-times sanctuary Lord Shar currently occupies..."
"He inherited it from its previous owner."
"The defensive formations and restrictions remain almost perfectly preserved, with virtually no damage."
Having finished speaking, the guide fell silent.
His eyes remained fixed squarely on Daniel.
The meaning behind his gaze was unmistakable.

If this deal went through, his commission would be substantial.
He promptly provided the address.
Without wasting another second, Thorne departed immediately.
As long as no stronger bidder appeared within the next hour, the sanctuary would officially become his.
The guide then turned toward Daniel.
His experienced eyes lingered on him for a brief moment.
Years spent dealing with powerful experts had given him sharp instincts.
He was certain the man before him was anything but ordinary.
"My lord..."
"What kind of information are you looking for?"
Daniel blinked.
"I want to know whether any low-grade Oracle-grade cultivators occupy the ten-thousand-times time-flow sanctuaries."
The guide’s smile froze instantly.
A... a ten-thousand-times sanctuary?
This was definitely no ordinary Divine Sovereign.
This was someone who actually intended to compete directly with an Oracle-grade powerhouse.
Yet no matter how hard he thought, he simply couldn’t imagine what kind of Divine Sovereign would dare provoke an Oracle-grade expert.
Could this man possess an unimaginably powerful background?
"Please... give me a moment."
He quickly sorted through everything he knew.
"There is indeed one."
"A low-grade Oracle-grade currently occupies one of the ten-thousand-times sanctuaries."
"But what?
Stop dragging it out."
"But that lord isn’t alone."
The guide studied Daniel carefully.
Daniel wasn’t even Oracle-grade...
Yet he wanted to challenge one.
The very idea sounded absurd.
More importantly, the Oracle-grade in question wasn’t an independent wanderer.
He belonged to a powerful organization.
That made all the difference.
Offending a lone cultivator meant making only one enemy.
You could go all out without worrying about consequences.
But offending someone backed by a major faction was another matter entirely.
Defeat the younger one...
The older generation would come.
Defeat them...
Even older monsters would appear.
It was an endless chain of retaliation.
Throughout the Endless Starsea, powerful cultivators almost always stood together in factions.
The guide wasn’t sure whether Daniel truly understood what he was getting into.
That was why he deliberately made the situation clear first, hoping Daniel would think carefully before making his decision.
"Just tell me everything you know about this Oracle-grade."
"The more detailed, the better."
Daniel remained completely unconcerned.
"I’m not short on Origin Crystal."
"One thousand cubic units of Origin Crystal."
"For that price, I’ll tell you everything I know."
The guide stopped hesitating.
The customer had already made his intentions perfectly clear.
If he refused the business, someone else would happily take it.
Daniel casually produced one thousand Origin Crystal.
To him, such an expense was practically insignificant.
The guide cleared his throat.
"The Oracle-grade lord is named Shar."
"He comes from Crown’s Summit, a faction based in the Violent Fish Star System within the Emberflow Star River."
"Lord Shar is a Second-Tier Oracle-grade.
He advanced into that realm only a little over one million years ago."
"He is also the third-ranking elder of Crown’s Summit."
"He has two sworn brothers who are likewise elders of the organization."
"One has already reached the peak of the Second Tier."
"The other has advanced to the Third-Tier Oracle-grade."
"As for the ten-thousand-times sanctuary Lord Shar currently occupies..."
"He inherited it from its previous owner."
"The defensive formations and restrictions remain almost perfectly preserved, with virtually no damage."
Having finished speaking, the guide fell silent.
His eyes remained fixed squarely on Daniel.
The meaning behind his gaze was unmistakable.

chapters.title: Chapter 411 -411-Forcing the Gate, Holy Spirit Manifestation
paragraphs: "Just name your price."
Considering that the information he had provided was indeed detailed, Daniel could not be bothered to argue with him.
The guide said, "2,000 units of Origin Crystal!"
"Most of what I told you earlier is already out in the open. Even if Lord Shar were to discover it through causal arts, he might not necessarily trace it back to me."
"But what I’m about to reveal next concerns his true foundation. Speaking of such matters comes with no small amount of risk!"
"Take it."
Daniel casually tossed over 2,000 units of Origin Crystal.
"Don’t worry. He won’t come after you."
The guide’s heart tightened.
Holy shit!
This man was probably planning to go hard against Lord Shar!
As for whether he could actually defeat Shar... what did that have to do with him?
Taking money to ease another man’s worries—that was the true duty of a guide.
As for the so-called risk he had mentioned earlier, it was merely an excuse to raise the price. In truth, guides like him had been jointly arranged by the various powers behind the sacred grounds.
Their purpose was to make another round of profit after people entered. In other words, they did not care at all whether they offended an Oracle-grade expert.
Thus, after pretending to hesitate for three seconds, he finally spoke.
"Lord Shar has just stepped into the second stage of Oracle-grade. He has mastered the Laws of Destruction, Strength, and Extreme Speed, and all three have already been raised to the ultimate tier."

"He excels in close-quarters combat. Most of his Sacred Arts are also designed for hand-to-hand slaughter. He carries several Primordial-grade defensive treasures, as well as one Primordial-grade offensive treasure..."
"In addition, within this sanctum, he is attended by several peak Divine-grade experts and two Divine Radiant experts..."
The guide revealed all the information in one breath.
"My lord, that is all I know."
Daniel nodded slightly.
It was enough.
The information was quite detailed. This payment of Origin Crystal could not be considered a loss.
"Tell me the location of his sanctum."
The inner space of the sacred grounds was as vast as a minor world.
Thousands of independent sanctums were scattered within.
The lower-grade sanctums on the outer edges had time flows of only several times or several hundred times the normal rate.
The deeper one went, the higher the grade of the sanctums became. At the very core stood the top-tier sanctums with ten-thousandfold time flow.
At this moment, Daniel had already arrived in the depths.
He hovered in midair, gazing at the sanctum ahead.
The entire sanctum was wrapped tightly in arrays and restrictions. The moment any living being intruded, the master inside would immediately sense the disturbance.
Daniel was not in a hurry to act, lest he alert the enemy too soon.
With that thought, his mind stirred.
Swish, swish, swish...
Ninety-nine clones appeared silently around Daniel.
At the same time, he took out the Banner of Destiny’s Judgment.
He split it into nine sub-banners. Each sub-banner was held by nine clones, for a total of ninety clones.
The remaining nine clones guarded Daniel at the center, ready to respond to any sudden change.
Nine blood-colored banners hovered above his head like nine hawks with their wings folded, waiting to take flight.
The Voidbound Grail and the Basin of Greed also emerged, quietly circling around him like two silent guardians.
Swish!
A pitch-black, olive-shaped object appeared in Daniel’s palm.
This was a one-time-use item he had just exchanged from Ivahpin World. Its function was similar to the Thunder God Orb, but its power was far greater.
A single one of these could unleash the full-force strike of a third-stage Oracle-grade expert. Although it was not very useful in direct combat, it was perfect for breaking arrays.
Just this one item had cost him more than two billion points. Daniel’s lavish spending was evident at a glance.
"Go."
He waved his hand.
The pitch-black object drifted leisurely into the array restrictions.
Whoosh!
The sanctum’s arrays and restrictions were instantly activated.
Countless killing arrays suddenly awakened, rearing their heads like a nest of serpents. Innumerable lethal attacks poured down like a torrential storm, rushing toward the treasure.
"Detonate."
Daniel’s mind moved.
Boom!
The Oracle-grade treasure exploded violently.
A raging tide of Strength erupted, tearing apart the sanctum’s layers upon layers of restrictions in an instant. In the end, only an empty gate remained exposed in the air.
Daniel nodded in satisfaction.
These points had not been spent in vain.
If he had done it himself, those countless killing arrays and restrictions alone would have given him a serious headache. He would inevitably have had to spend a great deal of effort and time.
He could not be bothered with that trouble.
He would rather spend points to open the way.
"Fuck!"
"Who dares disturb me?!"
At that moment, an enraged roar erupted from the depths of the sanctum.
Before the voice had even faded, a figure suddenly appeared at the gate.
Shar’s face was terrifyingly livid.
He had been at the critical juncture of his breakthrough, devoting himself fully to comprehension. He had been only one step away, yet someone had suddenly interrupted him.
It was like a starving man finally sitting down before a table full of delicacies, only to have the entire table flipped over the moment he raised his knife and fork.
How could he possibly swallow such rage?
His gaze swiftly swept over the intruders outside. After sensing Daniel’s grade, a savage smile appeared at the corner of his mouth instead.
"A Divine Sovereign? Am I seeing this correctly?"
"A mere ant dares disturb me?"
"State your name. I have no interest in crushing an ant without knowing who it is..."
Shar’s eyes remained cautious.
For a Divine Sovereign to provoke him like this was far too bizarre.
He was somewhat worried that this kid might be the inheritor of some superpower.
Otherwise, what Divine Sovereign would lose his mind and come challenge an Oracle-grade expert?
Boom!
His aura erupted violently.
The immense pressure of an Oracle-grade expert surged over like a massive wave, slightly warping the surrounding void.
Daniel snorted coldly and spoke in an indifferent voice.
"Before you die, remember my name—Faustus."
Before his words had even fallen, the law ripples of the Voidbound Grail spread out soundlessly, layer after layer.
The flow and extension of space-time throughout the entire area froze still.
Light swirled within the mouth of the Basin of Greed, making it look like a beast waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
At the same time, all ninety-nine clones poured Strength into the sub-banners. A steady stream of energy was devoured frantically by the battle banners.
Buzz!
At that moment, a deep tremor rang out from the sky.
The curtain of space twisted and distorted as if it were being torn apart.
A figure exuding an ancient and boundless aura flickered in and out of sight within the void, as though it had shattered the endless ages and descended here from the distant past.
It was the projection of an Ancient Holy Spirit!

He stood more than thirty thousand meters tall, his shoulders as broad as mountains. In his hand, he held a short axe, and the blade seemed to still carry the lingering embers of an ancient battlefield.
His eyes looked down upon Shar below, filled with nothing but cold, indifferent killing intent.
Swish!
The Holy Spirit Manifestation charged fiercely toward Shar.

Although Shar was a second-stage Oracle-grade expert, under Daniel’s activation, the Holy Spirit Manifestation could already unleash the strength of a peak first-stage Oracle-grade expert. Against Shar, it would not collapse in a single blow.
"Damn bastard! He’s actually serious?"
Shar roared, and a long saber appeared in his hand.
No matter how hard he thought, he could not understand what was going on with this Divine Sovereign before him.
Was this man truly insane?
He was an Oracle-grade expert!

chapters.title: Chapter 412 -412-Strike While He’s Down
paragraphs: Shar swung his blade in fury, charging straight toward the Holy Spirit Manifestation.
"It’s nothing more than a mere first-stage phantom. If its true body had descended, I’d kneel on the spot, all right?"
"But a mere phantom wants to show off in front of me? Isn’t that looking down on Oracle-grade a little too much?"
Daniel could not personally control the attacks of the Holy Spirit Manifestation, but that did not matter.
Buzz, buzz!
Shar took out two protective treasures, and Daniel’s eyes instantly lit up.
"Basin of Greed!"
The Basin of Greed had long since been starving for action. Light erupted from it, as though invisible hooks had locked firmly onto Shar’s two Primordial-grade treasures.
The two treasures struggled like birds caught by the throat, only to fall helplessly into the basin.
"What is that thing?"
"You damned bastard!"
Seeing his treasures taken away before his eyes, Shar flew into a towering rage.

While locked in battle with the Holy Spirit Manifestation, he turned his head and roared furiously, "You despicable rat! Other than stealing and scheming, what else can you do? Face me head-on if you dare!"
"Insane."
Daniel sneered.
Several Oracle-grade treasures suddenly appeared in his hand. Most of them were cheap items below the third stage—plentiful, affordable, and effective enough.
He had spent only a little over ten billion Golden Holy Mountain points to exchange for an entire stack of them.

Low-stage Oracle-grade treasures were relatively easy to acquire on the market, but high-stage Oracle-grade treasures were another matter entirely. Those were priceless treasures that money alone could not buy.
Daniel lacked many things, but points were not one of them.
As long as he was willing, he could exchange for hundreds of billions more at any time. This was the confidence that allowed him to wrestle with low-stage Oracle-grade experts.
He would use sheer spending power to smash them to death!

Each stage at Oracle-grade was a world unto itself. The gap between a high-stage Oracle-grade expert and a low-stage Oracle-grade expert was even more absurd than the gulf between a mortal and an ant.

Although Shar had only just entered the second stage, he was still suppressing the Holy Spirit Manifestation, which possessed peak first-stage strength. Yet the more he fought, the more uneasy he felt.
"This phantom is far too strange."
Shar did not feel proud just because he could suppress the phantom. Instead, chills kept crawling up his spine.
Logically speaking, a higher-stage Oracle-grade expert should be able to crush a lower-stage opponent with ease.
Yet against this Holy Spirit Manifestation, he still could not completely destroy it. At most, he could barely keep it suppressed. That alone was extremely unreasonable.

"But maintaining such a powerful phantom must consume an astonishing amount of energy. That kid is only a Divine Sovereign. I’d like to see how long he can last. Once his Strength runs dry, I’ll tear him to pieces with one finger and make him understand the price of offending an Oracle-grade expert."
Daniel’s Rank was merely Divine Sovereign. Shar had already confirmed that.
He refused to believe that a Divine Sovereign could maintain an Oracle-grade phantom for long. The moment Daniel exhausted himself would be the moment he died.
"And that kid also has a supreme treasure that can forcibly seize other treasures, that banner capable of summoning an Oracle-grade phantom, and that Holy Grail that can suppress space-time..."
"Tsk, tsk. Every single one of those is a rare treasure. Once I kill him, they’ll all be mine."
Thinking of this, Shar’s heart grew excited.
It was as if that pile of treasures was already within his grasp.
Crack!
At that moment, Daniel crushed an Oracle-grade treasure.
It was a treasure containing the full-force strike of a second-stage Oracle-grade expert. Immediately afterward, a pitch-black sphere appeared out of thin air.
Dense law aura swirled around it as it shot toward Shar with a sharp whoosh.
"Hm?"
Shar instantly sensed danger.
His right hand continued swinging his blade against the Holy Spirit Manifestation, while his left hand clenched into a fist and smashed toward the sphere.
The Law of Destruction radiated a terrifying aura from his fist.
He had immersed himself in the Law of Destruction for many years and had already pushed it to an extremely profound Rank.
But before his fist could touch the sphere, Daniel had somehow taken out a puppet.
The puppet rapidly transformed into Shar’s appearance. Daniel gripped a needle and stabbed it viciously into the puppet’s head!
Boom!
Shar felt a tearing pain explode deep within his mind.
It was as if countless venomous snakes were devouring his brain at the same time. The destructive light around his fist swiftly dimmed.
The black sphere slammed into him head-on, and the full force of its laws erupted.
Shar’s entire left arm was blasted into pieces, and a cloud of blood mist burst outward.
Boom!
A thunderous sound rang out.
Seizing this opening, the Holy Spirit Manifestation swung its axe and sent Shar flying with a direct strike.
Shar spat out a large mouthful of blood.
His Sacred Soul Origin had been heavily damaged, and his consciousness was now hazy and blurred.
"Hm. I have to admit, a second-stage Oracle-grade expert really is tough."
Daniel snorted coldly.
"This puppet of mine is a genuine third-stage Oracle-grade treasure. You actually took that hit and can still stand. Not bad at all."
"Unfortunately, I’m the kind of person who likes to strike while his enemy is weak!"
A sharp light flashed in Daniel’s eyes as his will transmitted outward.
The next moment, the Holy Spirit Manifestation caught up again and unleashed a storm of attacks. Every strike was aimed directly at Shar’s vital points.
Boom, boom, boom!
Explosions rang out one after another.
"Tsk, tsk. You really can take a beating, Lord Oracle-grade."
Daniel weighed the two remaining Oracle-grade treasures in his hand. Each one could unleash the full-force strike of a third-stage Oracle-grade expert, and their power was considerable.
He did not hesitate for long before activating both treasures at the same time.
Whoosh, whoosh!
Two streaks of light tore through the air.
One transformed into a blood-red eyeball, while the other condensed into a thin needle glowing with eerie green poison light.
The blood-red eyeball suddenly blinked.
Shar’s movements abruptly slowed, as if his entire body had been dragged down by an invisible Strength.
Immediately afterward, the thin needle pierced through the air and stabbed straight into his chest.
Bang!
A muffled explosion erupted from within his body. His chest began to rupture outward, cracks spreading rapidly across him.
Then the blood-red eyeball exploded violently. Dazzling bloodlight surged forth, swallowing Shar whole.
The Holy Spirit Manifestation pressed forward at once, launching another brutal assault against Shar, whose Sacred Soul had already shattered, until his entire body was completely beaten apart.
Second-stage Oracle-grade expert Shar had fallen.
At the same time, a cold system notification rang in Daniel’s ears.
[Ding! You have slain Oracle-grade Shar. You have obtained 300 million units of Origin Crystal. You have obtained experience...]
Yet Daniel’s expression remained completely calm.
He merely reached out and took the two treasures collected inside the Basin of Greed.
These two treasures had originally been only Primordial-grade, but after the Millionfold Boost, they had already advanced to Primordial Law-grade.
However, the current Daniel no longer cared much for such ordinary items. Keeping them and later selling them to the Golden Holy Mountain for points would be a decent deal.
He recalled all his clones and treasures. Without Strength to sustain it, the Holy Spirit Manifestation slowly dispersed into the void.
"I thought he would be more impressive than that..."
Daniel shook his head and turned his gaze toward the sanctum before him.
"A dignified Oracle-grade expert only had 300 million units of Origin Crystal. How disappointing."
"But now, this ten-thousandfold time-flow sanctum belongs to me."

Seizing this opening, the Holy Spirit Manifestation swung its axe and sent Shar flying with a direct strike.
Shar spat out a large mouthful of blood.
His Sacred Soul Origin had been heavily damaged, and his consciousness was now hazy and blurred.
"Hm.
I have to admit, a second-stage Oracle-grade expert really is tough."
Daniel snorted coldly.
"This puppet of mine is a genuine third-stage Oracle-grade treasure.
You actually took that hit and can still stand.
Not bad at all."
"Unfortunately, I’m the kind of person who likes to strike while his enemy is weak!"
A sharp light flashed in Daniel’s eyes as his will transmitted outward.
The next moment, the Holy Spirit Manifestation caught up again and unleashed a storm of attacks.
Every strike was aimed directly at Shar’s vital points.
Boom, boom, boom!
Explosions rang out one after another.
"Tsk, tsk.
You really can take a beating, Lord Oracle-grade."
Daniel weighed the two remaining Oracle-grade treasures in his hand.
Each one could unleash the full-force strike of a third-stage Oracle-grade expert, and their power was considerable.
He did not hesitate for long before activating both treasures at the same time.
Whoosh, whoosh!
Two streaks of light tore through the air.
One transformed into a blood-red eyeball, while the other condensed into a thin needle glowing with eerie green poison light.
The blood-red eyeball suddenly blinked.
Shar’s movements abruptly slowed, as if his entire body had been dragged down by an invisible Strength.
Immediately afterward, the thin needle pierced through the air and stabbed straight into his chest.
Bang!
A muffled explosion erupted from within his body.
His chest began to rupture outward, cracks spreading rapidly across him.
Then the blood-red eyeball exploded violently.
Dazzling bloodlight surged forth, swallowing Shar whole.
The Holy Spirit Manifestation pressed forward at once, launching another brutal assault against Shar, whose Sacred Soul had already shattered, until his entire body was completely beaten apart.
Second-stage Oracle-grade expert Shar had fallen.
At the same time, a cold system notification rang in Daniel’s ears.
[Ding!
You have slain Oracle-grade Shar.
You have obtained 300 million units of Origin Crystal.
You have obtained experience...]
Yet Daniel’s expression remained completely calm.
He merely reached out and took the two treasures collected inside the Basin of Greed.
These two treasures had originally been only Primordial-grade, but after the Millionfold Boost, they had already advanced to Primordial Law-grade.
However, the current Daniel no longer cared much for such ordinary items.
Keeping them and later selling them to the Golden Holy Mountain for points would be a decent deal.
He recalled all his clones and treasures.
Without Strength to sustain it, the Holy Spirit Manifestation slowly dispersed into the void.
"I thought he would be more impressive than that..."
Daniel shook his head and turned his gaze toward the sanctum before him.
"A dignified Oracle-grade expert only had 300 million units of Origin Crystal.
How disappointing."
"But now, this ten-thousandfold time-flow sanctum belongs to me."

chapters.title: Chapter 413 -413-Layers of Defense, the Prized Flying Fish
paragraphs: After Daniel dealt with the second-stage Oracle-grade expert Shar, he occupied the sanctum with ten-thousandfold time flow.
This method of seizing it seemed cold and ruthless, but in the Endless Starsea, such things were simply the norm.
This was what it meant for the strong to prey upon the weak. Whoever had the harder fist had the final say.
Although Daniel had not yet reached the level of an Oracle-grade expert, the resources in his hands were practically inexhaustible. That was his confidence.
So what if the one standing opposite him was an Oracle-grade expert?
As long as he had the strength, killing him was killing him. It was nothing worth making a fuss over.
Although Shar had two brothers ruling supreme over the Ravagerfish Star System, Daniel did not take them seriously at all.
After all, the trump cards in his hands were not just for show.
After entering the sanctum, Daniel frowned slightly.
This ten-thousandfold time flow sounded astonishing, but for living beings inside it, there was actually no noticeable difference at all.
In Daniel’s perception, nothing felt different.
Perhaps only existences at the level of high-stage Oracle-grade experts could sense the difference between the flow of time inside and outside.
"Wait!"
At that moment, Daniel suddenly realized something.
He had just flattened all the protective arrays. Surely he could not just let someone else walk straight in and deal with him later, right?
That would not be confidence. That would be stupidity.
With that thought, he simply decided to exchange for a complete set of arrays and restrictions. This was the benefit of joining a major power.
The Golden Holy Mountain had Ivahpin World, allowing him to enter and purchase supplies anytime, anywhere. Almost everything one could want could be found inside.
As long as one had points, one could make use of the countless foundations accumulated by the Golden Holy Mountain over the years.
Daniel immediately spent over a billion points and exchanged for a complete set of arrays and restrictions from the treasury.
This array set could unleash the offensive and defensive Strength of a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert. Unless one was at the fifth stage of Oracle-grade, breaking through it was impossible.
Even if a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert came personally, they would have to spend quite some time before they could force their way through.
As for a fourth-stage expert?
Heh...
There was no need to even mention it. Charging in by force would be courting death.
"Still, this alone doesn’t feel quite safe enough."
Daniel thought for a moment, then spent another ten billion points to exchange for several Oracle-grade treasures.
"Now this feels right. When it comes to sheer power, it has to be these things!"
Looking at the Oracle-grade treasures in his hands, he felt much more at ease.
Immediately afterward, he fused two fifth-stage Oracle-grade treasures directly into the array.
With this, even if a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert truly came knocking, they would lose a layer of skin even if they did not die.
Only after arranging all of this properly did he finally feel reassured enough to enter seclusion.
He was just pondering how to advance to Divine Descendant when, all of a sudden, an inexplicable throb surged up from within his heart.
Swish!
He unfolded the threads of karma before him. The invisible threads wove themselves into a vast net in front of his eyes.
He probed into the details, then gave a faint smile.
"Crown’s Summit... heh."
He paid it no further attention and turned around, sinking into secluded cultivation.
Ravagerfish Star System, Flying Fish Plane.
This was a great-world-level life world. At one end of the world stood a mountain known as Crown’s Summit.
This mountain was no ordinary peak. It was a blessed land that produced a famous kind of prized flying fish.
These flying fish were anything but simple. They were special lifeforms that lived in the sky.
They had six tails and six wings, and grew by absorbing the energy within space.
These flying fish were extremely special. If ordinary people ate them, they could even extend their lives by several hundred years.
Most importantly, the fins of these fish could be used as Divine-grade materials to craft equipment and weapons. One could imagine how rare they were.
But that was still not the key point.
Among all flying fish, there existed an even more precious variety.
The twelve-winged flying fish!
Even for Crown’s Summit, this was not something they could obtain whenever they wished.
Their numbers were exceedingly scarce. Among ten million six-winged, six-tailed flying fish, only one twelve-winged flying fish might possibly be born.
The crucial point was that the rarity of its fins was comparable to Sacred Artisan-grade materials.
It was said that a top dwarven master smith had once used the fins of a twelve-winged flying fish as the primary material to forge a Sacred Artisan Treasure.
That incident had once caused a great sensation, and it led countless experts to flock toward the twelve-winged flying fish with great eagerness.
A blessed land capable of continuously producing such valuable things naturally drew the envy of countless powers.
Before Crown’s Summit was established, this place had changed hands countless times.
It was only later, when the three Oracle-grade brothers joined forces and founded Crown’s Summit, that they finally occupied this place completely after countless battles.
At this moment, inside a hall on Crown’s Summit.
Whoosh!
The attendant responsible for guarding the soul candles suddenly saw Shar’s candle go out, and his face turned deathly pale in fright.
"What... what kind of joke is this?"
"That’s Lord Shar’s soul candle. It went... it went out?"
"This is bad!"
He did not dare delay for even a moment and hurriedly reported the news up layer by layer.
Before long, the news reached the ears of the Grand Lord.
The Grand Lord was named Ceric. He was a third-stage Oracle-grade expert who guarded Crown’s Summit year-round, only sending his clones to travel through the star sea.
The Second Lord was named Lucius. Like Shar, he followed the path of close-quarters combat.
However, at the moment, he was traveling through the star sea. Thus, the entire Crown’s Summit was currently guarded only by the Grand Lord Ceric.
The moment Ceric heard the news of Shar’s fall, he shot to his feet.
Shar was dead?
How was that possible?
Hadn’t he gone to a public sacred ground to seek advancement?
Who had made a move against him?
Could it have been experts from those other powers that coveted Crown’s Summit?
Cold light flickered in Ceric’s eyes, but he soon shook his head.

The three brothers had always been famous for their unity. Back then, they had seized Crown’s Summit precisely because the three of them had supported one another with utter disregard for their lives.
Everyone knew that provoking one of them meant offending all three.
Anyone with even a little sense would not deal with Shar so openly.
From another perspective, those who were not afraid of offending the three brothers would not look twice at Crown’s Summit anyway.
Then the question was, who had killed Shar?
"Shar has always been cautious. He rarely offends other experts. Could he have provoked someone he shouldn’t have while fighting over a sanctum?"
His thoughts were in chaos.
The reason Crown’s Summit could dominate the Ravagerfish Star System was because the three Oracle-grade brothers held the fort.
Now that one of them had fallen, those powers eyeing this fat piece of meat would surely begin to stir.
"Investigate."
He gave the order coldly.
"Send people to that sacred ground. You must find out exactly who killed Lord Shar. No matter who it was, this debt must be settled."
"As you command, my lord..."
Heh!
After Daniel finished looking through the cause and effect, he could not help but sneer.
He could not be bothered with them at all. He still had great confidence in the arrays and restrictions he had arranged.
If the two Oracle-grade experts from Crown’s Summit dared to come, then he would simply make sure they never returned.
He had plenty of trump cards in his hands. There was nothing for him to fear.
The only thing he needed to guard against was whether those high-stage Oracle-grade experts would also take an interest in this sanctum.
However, with a fifth-stage array plus fifth-stage treasures, it should be enough to handle most situations.
Thinking of this, Daniel entered Ivahpin World with considerable peace of mind.
He now enjoyed the treatment of a quasi-Oracle-grade member. As long as an Oracle-grade expert was expounding on the profound mysteries, he could go listen at any time.
Coincidentally, a high-stage Oracle-grade expert of the Golden Holy Mountain would soon be expounding on the mysteries. Daniel planned to seize this opportunity to farm another wave of divine energy.
There was nothing he could do about it.
He was far too short on divine energy!

chapters.title: Chapter 414 -414-Fifth-Stage Oracle-Grade Jevan
paragraphs: Ivahpin World.
The transmission of profound mysteries had already begun.

Opportunities to personally hear a high-stage Oracle-grade expert expound on profound mysteries were not common. The headquarters of the Golden Holy Mountain would occasionally put forward large amounts of points as rewards, encouraging high-stage Oracle-grade experts to give lectures to ordinary members.
This matter depended entirely on personal willingness, so every transmission was especially precious.
At this moment, the venue was already packed with countless experts. Even quite a few Oracle-grade experts were sitting obediently below and listening.
Daniel casually found a corner, sat down, and quietly listened.
On the platform, a Tier-7 Oracle-grade expert was explaining his comprehension of the profound mysteries of the laws.
At the same time, system notifications rang continuously in Daniel’s ears.
[Ding! You have listened to a high-stage Oracle-grade expert’s explanation of the profound mysteries of the laws. Divine energy +100,000...]
[Ding! You have listened to a high-stage Oracle-grade expert’s explanation of the profound mysteries of the laws. Divine energy +100,000...]
[Ding! You have listened to a high-stage Oracle-grade expert’s explanation of the profound mysteries of the laws. Divine energy +100,000...]
By the time he finished listening to a single transmission, he had accumulated several billion divine energy.
The gains were simply exaggerated!
After tasting such benefits, Daniel became even more reluctant to leave.
Over the following period, he stayed in Ivahpin World and listened to several more Oracle-grade transmissions of profound mysteries, accumulating hundreds of billions of divine energy in total.
Only after no high-stage Oracle-grade experts were giving lectures recently did he finally exit Ivahpin World.
Still, hundreds of billions of divine energy should be more than enough to help him break through to Divine Descendant.
After Daniel’s mind returned to the sanctum, he took out the Ring of Destiny.
From the moment he had obtained this thing, it had exuded an indescribably strange aura.
Although Dustin had said that it came from the Legacy Vault of the Chaos Humans, Daniel had always maintained a degree of caution toward it.
There was nothing he could do about it. This thing itself felt eerie. He had never seen a treasure whose entire information panel was filled with question marks.

Perhaps its grade was simply too high, so high that even the system could not fully see through its details. However, one thing was certain: this thing was definitely superior to a Primordial Supreme Treasure.
Daniel carefully examined the Ring of Destiny before him. Within it, he could see a complete and clear network of the Law of Reincarnation.
Countless threads flowed endlessly, as though forming a surging River of Fate.
Without a doubt, the Law of Reincarnation hidden within the Ring of Destiny had already reached a supreme-grade level that Daniel could not even begin to imagine.
He immediately sank his mind power into it and began exploring the true essence of the laws hidden in the depths of reincarnation.
Back when he was in the Astral Realm, he had received the gift of the world’s will. That gift had laid an unimaginably exaggerated foundation for him.
Before that, most of the abilities on his body had been directly handed to him by the system. The benefit was that it saved effort and allowed his strength to grow rapidly.

But now, he had the complete power of a world’s will supporting him. His foundation was so stable that it was almost unimaginable. Even without the system’s help, he could slowly study and comprehend law-based Sacred Arts on his own.
The gift that the world’s will of the Astral Realm had given him back then was truly no small matter.
Daniel immersed himself in his comprehension of the Law of Reincarnation. He could no longer tell how much time had passed, until a system notification suddenly rang out.
[Ding! You have comprehended a deeper level of the Law of Reincarnation. The Law of Reincarnation has advanced to mid-grade!]
"Not bad!"
The corners of Daniel’s mouth lifted.
"As expected, the Ring of Destiny really is a good thing!"

He paid attention to the time outside. Ten thousand years had already passed within the sanctum, while only one day had passed outside. In that time, he had already stepped across the threshold into mid-grade.
Daniel was delighted and continued his comprehension.
Another thirty thousand years passed in a flash, and the system notification rang out once more.
[Ding! You have comprehended a deeper level of the Law of Reincarnation. The Law of Reincarnation has advanced to high-grade!]
High-grade!
Daniel let out a long breath.
Now, the Law of Reincarnation could finally stand on equal footing with the Law of Causality. Both were high-grade, and beyond high-grade was transcendent—the step closest to Divine Descendant.
He was just about to continue comprehending and break through again when he suddenly sensed an unusual fluctuation from the threads of karma.
Something was happening!
Swish!
He spread out the threads of karma. With his high-grade Law of Causality, he could already see the connections with remarkable clarity.
"These guys came rather quickly."
A meaningful smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
"Interesting. Let me add a few strokes for them."
He reached out and gently plucked the threads of karma before him. The process was like playing a zither, slightly twisting the direction of fate by a tiny angle.
"Done. Now I’ll just wait for those people to deliver themselves to my door."
Inside the sacred grounds.
Jevan arrived at the sacred grounds with a large group of servants.
He was a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert. Among his servants, there were even several Oracle-grade experts as well: two at the third stage, five at the second stage, and eight at the first stage.
The Endless Starsea had always been a place where big fish devoured small fish. Even among Oracle-grade experts, one had to lower their head when encountering a higher-stage Oracle-grade expert.
Jevan was a famous lone traveler in the Flamefire Star River region. In the past, he had spent some time in the Chaos Faction.
Later, when the great army of the Chitin Universe attacked, he saw that the situation was turning unfavorable and quickly withdrew. From then on, he had wandered freely throughout the universe.
As a lone traveler, he had no real power backing him from behind. But living freely without restraints was comfortable in its own way.
Today, he had come to this public sacred ground. Since he was already here, he decided he might as well enter and take a look.
He did not even need to speak himself. An Oracle-grade servant immediately took the initiative to drag over a guide.
"Are there any sanctums with ten-thousandfold time flow still empty?"
"No," the guide shook his head repeatedly.
"Then are there any Oracle-grade experts willing to give theirs up?" the Oracle-grade servant asked again.
"None either," the guide said, sweat pouring down his forehead.
"No this, no that. Then let me ask you this—are there any Oracle-grade experts here whose strength isn’t particularly impressive?"
At this point, the Oracle-grade servant’s tone was already growing impatient.
His master was a dignified fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert. Of course he had to stay in a place with ten-thousandfold time flow.
Otherwise, if a mighty fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert went to a place with only thousandfold time flow, that would be far too humiliating.
"There is one... but..."
A troubled look appeared on the guide’s face.
"Take it. Stop wasting time."
The Oracle-grade servant waved his hand and threw over five hundred units of Origin Crystal.
"It’s like this. There is currently one ten-thousandfold time-flow sanctum occupied by a Divine Sovereign expert."
After receiving what he wanted, the guide no longer cared whether he would offend some great figure.
"A Divine Sovereign?!"
The Oracle-grade servant froze.
What was going on with this world?
A mere Divine Sovereign could occupy a sanctum with ten-thousandfold time flow now?
This was truly a rare sight.
"Explain it clearly."

The Oracle-grade servant had naturally not advanced to Oracle-grade by being an idiot. He knew that when something was abnormal, there had to be something strange behind it. If a Divine Sovereign could occupy a ten-thousandfold sanctum, then he must have something extraordinary about him.
"That Divine Sovereign expert only arrived a few days ago."
The guide stopped speaking at this point.
The Oracle-grade servant cursed inwardly and took out more Origin Crystal, handing it over.
"That place was originally the sanctum occupied by the Third Lord of Crown’s Summit. In the end, that Divine Sovereign killed him and seized it by force," the guide said truthfully.
"Hm? The Third Lord of Crown’s Summit? Isn’t that Shar?"

Daniel immersed himself in his comprehension of the Law of Reincarnation.
He could no longer tell how much time had passed, until a system notification suddenly rang out.
[Ding!
You have comprehended a deeper level of the Law of Reincarnation.
The Law of Reincarnation has advanced to mid-grade!]
"Not bad!"
The corners of Daniel’s mouth lifted.
"As expected, the Ring of Destiny really is a good thing!"
He paid attention to the time outside.
Ten thousand years had already passed within the sanctum, while only one day had passed outside.
In that time, he had already stepped across the threshold into mid-grade.
Daniel was delighted and continued his comprehension.
Another thirty thousand years passed in a flash, and the system notification rang out once more.
[Ding!
You have comprehended a deeper level of the Law of Reincarnation.
The Law of Reincarnation has advanced to high-grade!]
High-grade!
Daniel let out a long breath.
Now, the Law of Reincarnation could finally stand on equal footing with the Law of Causality.
Both were high-grade, and beyond high-grade was transcendent—the step closest to Divine Descendant.
He was just about to continue comprehending and break through again when he suddenly sensed an unusual fluctuation from the threads of karma.
Something was happening!
Swish!
He spread out the threads of karma.
With his high-grade Law of Causality, he could already see the connections with remarkable clarity.
"These guys came rather quickly."
A meaningful smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
"Interesting.
Let me add a few strokes for them."
He reached out and gently plucked the threads of karma before him.
The process was like playing a zither, slightly twisting the direction of fate by a tiny angle.
"Done.
Now I’ll just wait for those people to deliver themselves to my door."
Inside the sacred grounds.
Jevan arrived at the sacred grounds with a large group of servants.
He was a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert.
Among his servants, there were even several Oracle-grade experts as well: two at the third stage, five at the second stage, and eight at the first stage.
The Endless Starsea had always been a place where big fish devoured small fish.
Even among Oracle-grade experts, one had to lower their head when encountering a higher-stage Oracle-grade expert.
Jevan was a famous lone traveler in the Flamefire Star River region.
In the past, he had spent some time in the Chaos Faction.
Later, when the great army of the Chitin Universe attacked, he saw that the situation was turning unfavorable and quickly withdrew.
From then on, he had wandered freely throughout the universe.
As a lone traveler, he had no real power backing him from behind.
But living freely without restraints was comfortable in its own way.
Today, he had come to this public sacred ground.
Since he was already here, he decided he might as well enter and take a look.
He did not even need to speak himself.
An Oracle-grade servant immediately took the initiative to drag over a guide.
"Are there any sanctums with ten-thousandfold time flow still empty?"
"No," the guide shook his head repeatedly.
"Then are there any Oracle-grade experts willing to give theirs up?" the Oracle-grade servant asked again.
"None either," the guide said, sweat pouring down his forehead.
"No this, no that.
Then let me ask you this—are there any Oracle-grade experts here whose strength isn’t particularly impressive?"
At this point, the Oracle-grade servant’s tone was already growing impatient.
His master was a dignified fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert.
Of course he had to stay in a place with ten-thousandfold time flow.
Otherwise, if a mighty fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert went to a place with only thousandfold time flow, that would be far too humiliating.
"There is one... but..."
A troubled look appeared on the guide’s face.
"Take it.
Stop wasting time."
The Oracle-grade servant waved his hand and threw over five hundred units of Origin Crystal.
"It’s like this.
There is currently one ten-thousandfold time-flow sanctum occupied by a Divine Sovereign expert."
After receiving what he wanted, the guide no longer cared whether he would offend some great figure.
"A Divine Sovereign?!"
The Oracle-grade servant froze.
What was going on with this world?
A mere Divine Sovereign could occupy a sanctum with ten-thousandfold time flow now?
This was truly a rare sight.
"Explain it clearly."
The Oracle-grade servant had naturally not advanced to Oracle-grade by being an idiot.
He knew that when something was abnormal, there had to be something strange behind it.
If a Divine Sovereign could occupy a ten-thousandfold sanctum, then he must have something extraordinary about him.
"That Divine Sovereign expert only arrived a few days ago."
The guide stopped speaking at this point.
The Oracle-grade servant cursed inwardly and took out more Origin Crystal, handing it over.
"That place was originally the sanctum occupied by the Third Lord of Crown’s Summit.
In the end, that Divine Sovereign killed him and seized it by force," the guide said truthfully.
"Hm?
The Third Lord of Crown’s Summit?
Isn’t that Shar?"

chapters.title: Chapter 415 -415-Everything Goes Smoothly? Despair!
paragraphs: That Oracle-grade servant was also a second-stage Oracle-grade expert, and he had met Shar a few times before.
"Wait. Shar was actually killed by a Divine Sovereign?!"
He drew in a sharp breath.
A Divine Sovereign killing a second-stage Oracle-grade expert?
That was simply heaven-defying!
"But no matter how powerful he is, in the end, he is still only a Divine Sovereign. Before a fifth-stage master, he’s no different from an ant."
The Oracle-grade servant began calculating inwardly.
Shar was merely someone who had just entered the second stage. How could he possibly compare to his master?
As for that Divine Sovereign...
His master had a million ways to kill him without even letting him make a sound.
He immediately reported the news to Jevan. After hearing it, Jevan’s expression also changed slightly.
"Hm? A Divine Sovereign capable of killing a second-stage Oracle-grade expert?"
"Who exactly is such a strange expert? Does he have some great power backing him? What if there’s an extraordinary old monster standing behind him?"
Jevan had managed to reach the fifth stage on his own, so naturally, he was not someone easy to fool.
He did not underestimate Daniel in the slightest. His mind turned over the possible gains and losses again and again.
"No hurry. I’ll take a look first."
After thinking it over, Jevan still could not make up his mind. He was reluctant to give up on the ten-thousandfold sanctum, yet he could not determine Daniel’s background.
When in doubt, divine through astrology.
This was an old habit he had kept for many years.
He immediately took out an astrolabe and activated the Law of Fate to perform a divination.
"Hm?! Everything will go smoothly!"
Looking at the divination result, a smile instantly appeared on Jevan’s face.
He happened to have grasped a shallow understanding of the Law of Fate. However, this thing was far too profound. Even for him, he had only barely touched the threshold of low-grade.
Usually, he relied on this astrolabe to perform divination and avoid danger. This time, the result showed extreme smoothness, which meant there would be no real obstacles in carrying out his plan.
Thinking of this, Jevan immediately waved his hand toward the Oracle-grade servants and sage attendants beside him.
"Let’s go. We’ll take a look."
"As you command, Master."
The servants answered in unison. They all understood that their master was going to seize that sanctum.
Outside the sanctum occupied by Daniel.
Jevan descended with his many servants.
Just like Daniel had done before, he hovered at the edge of the arrays and restrictions, carefully examining the layered array barriers before him.
"Master, I am willing to scout the way for you."
One Oracle-grade servant was eager to earn merit and volunteered himself.
"Foolish!"
Jevan shouted coldly and stopped him.
"The arrays and restrictions here are extraordinary. If you enter, you’ll merely be throwing your life away."
Hearing Jevan’s rebuke, the Oracle-grade servant was shocked and could not help but take half a step back.
He did not doubt Jevan’s words at all. He simply had not expected this seemingly ordinary array to be so dangerous.
"Hmph!"
Jevan sneered.
"This array may look loose and ordinary, but it hides lethal killing intent. Even an ordinary fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert would not fare well after entering."
"Unfortunately for it, it has encountered me."
He believed he had already seen through the truth and weakness of this array.
"As it happens, I recently obtained a defensive treasure."
Jevan raised his hand and summoned a golden battle armor.
The golden armor instantly fitted itself over his body, emitting a hazy golden radiance.

"This is a Primordial-grade defensive treasure. Once activated by me, it can withstand the full-force strike of a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert. The power of this array is at most at the fifth-stage Oracle-grade level. It cannot do anything to me."
Jevan silently pondered.
If those foolish servants charged in recklessly, they would likely lose their lives.
Although they were servants, they were also his assets. He could not afford to lose them casually.
"I’ll handle this myself."
With that thought, he turned to his servants and said, "Wait here. I’ll break through these arrays and restrictions first."
"Once the array is broken, that Divine Sovereign inside will be mine to handle as I please!"
"Congratulations in advance on your smooth victory, Master!"
The servants spoke in unison.
Jevan nodded faintly.
That Divine Sovereign inside had probably exhausted everything he had just to kill a second-stage Oracle-grade expert.
But Jevan was a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert.
For him, crushing a second-stage Oracle-grade expert was easier than crushing an ant.
More importantly, his divination result showed great fortune and smooth success for this trip.
Swish!
Wearing the golden armor, Jevan calmly stepped into the arrays and restrictions.
None of the servants behind him were worried. A fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert was no random weakling.
Barring any accident, their master would surely return safely, just as he had in every past battle.
Buzz!
The instant Jevan stepped into the array, layers upon layers of restrictions were triggered.
Countless streams of law power surged like a tide, and the killing arrays activated.
"Hmph."
He remained unmoved and continued walking forward steadily.
Whoosh!
Suddenly, an extremely sharp aura erupted.
It was a fierce blade light, so fast that it was almost impossible to capture.
Jevan had no time to dodge. He could only rely on the golden armor to withstand it head-on.
Boom!
The blade light struck his body and sent him flying. The light on the golden armor instantly dimmed, then shattered into countless fragments.
"What kind of joke is this?!"
Jevan’s expression changed drastically.
That golden armor could withstand the full-force strike of a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert.
In other words, the power of that blade light just now had already surpassed the limit of fifth-stage Oracle-grade.
Although the golden armor had blocked the fatal strike, it had also been completely destroyed.
"That attack... was at least the full-force strike of a Tier-6 Oracle-grade expert!"
Cold sweat covered Jevan’s forehead, and his heart was filled with horror.
"It’s an Oracle-grade treasure! A Tier-6 Oracle-grade treasure!"
"So that’s how it is. No wonder that Divine Sovereign could kill a second-stage Oracle-grade expert. He actually has such a supreme treasure on him!"
His mind was spinning rapidly, but he still did not forget to encourage himself.
"No need to worry... the divination result showed great fortune... nothing will happen to me!"
The golden armor had already shattered, and the attacks from the killing arrays surged toward him like a tide, bombarding him layer after layer.
However, he did not suffer any serious harm.
After all, no matter what, he was a genuine fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert.
Although this array possessed power at the fifth-stage Oracle-grade level, in the end, it was still only a dead object.
But at that moment—
Whoosh, whoosh!
Two arrows tore through the air, one after the other, accurately locking onto his vital points. Their speed was so terrifying that there was no way to evade them.
"Damn it! Why are there Oracle-grade treasures again?!"
Jevan was about to go mad.
Oracle-grade treasures, things of immense value, were being poured out here as if they cost nothing.
And every single one of them was absurdly powerful!
Boom!
He activated a law-based Sacred Art and forcefully withstood the arrow coming from the front. However, he could no longer block the arrow behind him.
Whoosh... splurt!
The arrow stabbed viciously into his back, then exploded with a roar.
Jevan’s back was blasted into a bloody mess. Even white bone could be seen exposed beneath the torn flesh.
But at that very moment—
Whoosh, whoosh!
Another two arrows shot toward him, again one from the front and one from behind.
"Damn it! How could my divination result be wrong? Where exactly did the problem come from?!"
An ominous feeling surged in Jevan’s heart.
He knew that he had already fallen into a desperate situation.
There was a very real chance that he would die here!
And the earlier divination result of everything going smoothly now seemed unbearably glaring.
"Is this some kind of joke?!"
Jevan roared in despair.
Whoosh, whoosh!
Boom, boom!
The arrows struck again, blasting him violently away. He was already on the verge of death.
At that moment, another blade light tore through the air.
It was the judgment of finality!
Jevan stared blankly at the blade light, knowing that death was certain.
"That Divine Sovereign... just who is he?"
"What kind of existence have I provoked? Could there be an Eternal Sage standing behind him?"
Unwillingness filled his heart as he closed his eyes.
Swish!
The blade light flashed past.
His head fell to the ground.
