chapters.title: Chapter 416 -416-Transcendent Law of Reincarnation
paragraphs: [Ding!]
At the same time, a system notification rang in Daniel’s ears.
[You have slain a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert... You have obtained 89.8 billion units of Origin Crystal. You have obtained experience, equipment...]
[Ding! ... Sale behavior detected. Millionfold Boost triggered! You have obtained three Primordial Law-grade treasures and ten Primordial-grade treasures!]
Listening to the system notifications, a faint smile appeared at the corner of Daniel’s mouth.
The rewards far exceeded the cost.
A bloody profit!

Through the threads of karma, he had already seen through everything in advance. He had deliberately set up a pile of Oracle-grade treasures within the array, then plucked the threads of karma to distort the divination result and deceive Jevan’s foresight.
That was how he had tricked a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert to death.
The Origin Crystal alone was enough to make up for the cost of exchanging for those treasures, not to mention the dozen or so treasures he had gained on top of that.
This wave was pure profit.
"Those guys from Crown’s Summit are quite cautious."
Daniel smiled.
Within the threads of karma, there had not only been Jevan. The scouts from Crown’s Summit had also already gathered information about him.
However, they had chosen to remain still for now, waiting until he left before settling the score.
There was no need to worry about them for the time being.
For now, killing Jevan was already enough to deter those petty villains harboring malicious thoughts.
"My Law of Reincarnation will reach transcendent with one more advancement. I’m not far from Divine Descendant now. I just need more time."
Daniel slowly closed his eyes.
"Forget it. Whatever those people outside are thinking has nothing to do with me. Everything can wait until after I advance."
Outside Daniel’s sanctum.
Jevan’s servants suddenly felt the slave contracts connected to them in the unseen vanish.
In an instant, the expressions of all the experts changed drastically.
There was only one reason a slave contract would disappear.
Their master, Jevan, was dead!
He had died inside the arrays of that sanctum.
An array capable of killing a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert—just what kind of terrifying existence was that?
"Quick! Run!"
"Oh my god! Is this real?"
"That bastard Jevan is finally dead! We’re free!"
"Go! I’m returning to my homeland. I’ll never set foot in the star sea again..."
Jevan’s servants scattered in all directions.
At the same time, news of Jevan’s fall spread throughout this sacred ground.
Jevan had fallen.
He had died within arrays and restrictions set up by a Divine Sovereign.
One had to know that Jevan was a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert!
His servants quickly spread the news, and the entire sacred ground was instantly shaken.
Even those old monsters who had been cultivating in seclusion for years became curious about that Divine Sovereign.
"Have you heard? A ruthless figure has appeared in this sacred ground recently!"
This had become the most commonly heard opening line in the sacred ground over the past few days.

"I heard. There’s a ruthless Divine Sovereign-level existence. The moment he arrived, he killed a second-stage Oracle-grade expert and seized a ten-thousandfold sanctum by force. Later, he set up a terrifying killing array, and even a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert died inside it!"
"Hiss... that’s truly hard to imagine!"
"That Divine Sovereign-level existence is now one of the most untouchable figures in this sacred ground."
"Not only that, I heard many experts deliberately went over just to observe from afar, but none of them dared to approach."
"What’s that? I even heard that some Oracle-grade experts take detours when passing by that place."
Just as the experts in the sacred ground said, many people had indeed come outside Daniel’s sanctum, wanting to see that legendary Divine Sovereign-level expert for themselves.
However, none of them dared disturb an existence capable of easily slaying Oracle-grade experts.
They only dared watch from afar.
Some Oracle-grade experts who needed to pass by the area even chose to take a detour, afraid of angering this Divine Sovereign.
Just hearing about such a thing was absurd enough.
Yet it was truly happening.
At the same time, the two Lords of Crown’s Summit had gathered within the sacred ground and received the news as well.
Jevan had tried to seize that ten-thousandfold sanctum, only to pay the price with his life.
The two Lords, who had originally planned to settle accounts with Daniel after he came out, were instantly filled with shock and fear.
Even a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert had died.
And he had died at the hands of that Divine Sovereign!
One of them was a third-stage Oracle-grade expert, while the other was only a peak second-stage Oracle-grade expert. And they still wanted revenge?
Wasn’t that simply courting death?
They immediately extinguished all thoughts of retaliation and slunk back to their lair, no longer daring to entertain even the slightest idea.
However, just because they did not dare act did not mean Daniel was willing to let them go so easily.
A grudge had already been formed between both sides.
Their current retreat was not out of goodwill, but fear.
In other words, if Daniel had been weak, then the only thing awaiting him would have been death.
Daniel understood the power of the Law of Causality very well.
Since the cause had already appeared, it was necessary to completely strangle the bitter fruit before it could ripen.
Inside the sanctum.
Daniel had already sensed that his Law of Reincarnation had reached a bottleneck.
He had spent a full eighty thousand years advancing within the sanctum, equivalent to eight days passing in the outside world.
He only had two days left.
"This Ring of Destiny... something isn’t right."
Daniel had no choice but to interrupt his advancement process.
That was because he had discovered that if he continued advancing, he would trigger the trial of the Ring of Destiny.
At the same time that the Law of Reincarnation advanced to transcendent, he might have to face an unavoidable test.
That test would certainly be extremely difficult.
This was his intuition.
But for all powerful experts, intuition itself was a gift from the heavens.
It allowed living beings to foresee impending danger and avoid it to a certain extent.
Moreover, the stronger a living being was, the more seriously they had to treat such intuition.
After all, not just any danger could make a top expert feel a sense of crisis.
Daniel understood this point very well.
"However..."
"The path of battle means facing difficulties head-on and remaining unyielding. Only then can one possess a fearless heart."
Daniel pondered for a moment, then quickly chose to accept the trial calmly.
He immediately sank his mind power into the Ring of Destiny.
Boom!
A thunderous explosion rang out in Daniel’s mind.
The next moment, the scene before his eyes changed dramatically, as though he had been dragged into a strange world.
This place was layered with clouds and mist, filled with hazy spiritual vapor.
At the same time, the bottleneck preventing him from advancing the Law of Reincarnation to transcendent was broken.
He successfully advanced the Law of Reincarnation to transcendent.
[Ding! Your Law of Reincarnation has advanced to transcendent!]
Listening to the system notification in his ears, Daniel slowly unfolded his sage rank.
At this moment, the Law of Reincarnation within this supreme sage rank had already reached the ultimate tier.
"Now that I have comprehended the transcendent Law of Reincarnation, I should have the ability to raise the limits of my supreme sage rank."
Daniel thought to himself.
The Law of Reincarnation within his supreme sage rank allowed him to overlap the Strength of three micro-instants across three micro-instants.
But that was still not enough.
Now that he had mastered the transcendent Law of Reincarnation, he could absolutely use it as a foundation to further advance his supreme sage rank.
With that thought, he summoned the Ring of Destiny.
Swish!
The Ring of Destiny appeared before him.

Immediately afterward, Daniel used the Law of Reincarnation within his supreme sage rank as the guide and his own transcendent Law of Reincarnation as the foundation, engraving something onto the Ring of Destiny.
Micro-instant, second, minute, hour, day...
Crack!
At that moment, the Ring of Destiny suddenly let out a crisp cracking sound.
Daniel could no longer continue engraving.
But this was already enough!
He had successfully engraved up to "day."
That was already his limit.

sentences.text: [Ding!]
At the same time, a system notification rang in Daniel’s ears.
[You have slain a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert...
You have obtained 89.8 billion units of Origin Crystal.
You have obtained experience, equipment...]
[Ding! ...
Sale behavior detected.
Millionfold Boost triggered!
You have obtained three Primordial Law-grade treasures and ten Primordial-grade treasures!]
Listening to the system notifications, a faint smile appeared at the corner of Daniel’s mouth.
The rewards far exceeded the cost.
A bloody profit!
Through the threads of karma, he had already seen through everything in advance.
He had deliberately set up a pile of Oracle-grade treasures within the array, then plucked the threads of karma to distort the divination result and deceive Jevan’s foresight.
That was how he had tricked a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert to death.
The Origin Crystal alone was enough to make up for the cost of exchanging for those treasures, not to mention the dozen or so treasures he had gained on top of that.
This wave was pure profit.
"Those guys from Crown’s Summit are quite cautious."
Daniel smiled.
Within the threads of karma, there had not only been Jevan.
The scouts from Crown’s Summit had also already gathered information about him.
However, they had chosen to remain still for now, waiting until he left before settling the score.
There was no need to worry about them for the time being.
For now, killing Jevan was already enough to deter those petty villains harboring malicious thoughts.
"My Law of Reincarnation will reach transcendent with one more advancement.
I’m not far from Divine Descendant now.
I just need more time."
Daniel slowly closed his eyes.
"Forget it.
Whatever those people outside are thinking has nothing to do with me.
Everything can wait until after I advance."
Outside Daniel’s sanctum.
Jevan’s servants suddenly felt the slave contracts connected to them in the unseen vanish.
In an instant, the expressions of all the experts changed drastically.
There was only one reason a slave contract would disappear.
Their master, Jevan, was dead!
He had died inside the arrays of that sanctum.
An array capable of killing a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert—just what kind of terrifying existence was that?
"Quick!
Run!"
"Oh my god!
Is this real?"
"That bastard Jevan is finally dead!
We’re free!"
"Go!
I’m returning to my homeland.
I’ll never set foot in the star sea again..."
Jevan’s servants scattered in all directions.
At the same time, news of Jevan’s fall spread throughout this sacred ground.
Jevan had fallen.
He had died within arrays and restrictions set up by a Divine Sovereign.
One had to know that Jevan was a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert!
His servants quickly spread the news, and the entire sacred ground was instantly shaken.
Even those old monsters who had been cultivating in seclusion for years became curious about that Divine Sovereign.
"Have you heard?
A ruthless figure has appeared in this sacred ground recently!"
This had become the most commonly heard opening line in the sacred ground over the past few days.
"I heard.
There’s a ruthless Divine Sovereign-level existence.
The moment he arrived, he killed a second-stage Oracle-grade expert and seized a ten-thousandfold sanctum by force.
Later, he set up a terrifying killing array, and even a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert died inside it!"
"Hiss... that’s truly hard to imagine!"
"That Divine Sovereign-level existence is now one of the most untouchable figures in this sacred ground."
"Not only that, I heard many experts deliberately went over just to observe from afar, but none of them dared to approach."
"What’s that?
I even heard that some Oracle-grade experts take detours when passing by that place."
Just as the experts in the sacred ground said, many people had indeed come outside Daniel’s sanctum, wanting to see that legendary Divine Sovereign-level expert for themselves.
However, none of them dared disturb an existence capable of easily slaying Oracle-grade experts.
They only dared watch from afar.
Some Oracle-grade experts who needed to pass by the area even chose to take a detour, afraid of angering this Divine Sovereign.
Just hearing about such a thing was absurd enough.
Yet it was truly happening.
At the same time, the two Lords of Crown’s Summit had gathered within the sacred ground and received the news as well.
Jevan had tried to seize that ten-thousandfold sanctum, only to pay the price with his life.
The two Lords, who had originally planned to settle accounts with Daniel after he came out, were instantly filled with shock and fear.
Even a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert had died.
And he had died at the hands of that Divine Sovereign!
One of them was a third-stage Oracle-grade expert, while the other was only a peak second-stage Oracle-grade expert.
And they still wanted revenge?
Wasn’t that simply courting death?
They immediately extinguished all thoughts of retaliation and slunk back to their lair, no longer daring to entertain even the slightest idea.
However, just because they did not dare act did not mean Daniel was willing to let them go so easily.
A grudge had already been formed between both sides.
Their current retreat was not out of goodwill, but fear.
In other words, if Daniel had been weak, then the only thing awaiting him would have been death.
Daniel understood the power of the Law of Causality very well.
Since the cause had already appeared, it was necessary to completely strangle the bitter fruit before it could ripen.
Inside the sanctum.
Daniel had already sensed that his Law of Reincarnation had reached a bottleneck.
He had spent a full eighty thousand years advancing within the sanctum, equivalent to eight days passing in the outside world.
He only had two days left.
"This Ring of Destiny... something isn’t right."
Daniel had no choice but to interrupt his advancement process.
That was because he had discovered that if he continued advancing, he would trigger the trial of the Ring of Destiny.
At the same time that the Law of Reincarnation advanced to transcendent, he might have to face an unavoidable test.
That test would certainly be extremely difficult.
This was his intuition.
But for all powerful experts, intuition itself was a gift from the heavens.
It allowed living beings to foresee impending danger and avoid it to a certain extent.
Moreover, the stronger a living being was, the more seriously they had to treat such intuition.
After all, not just any danger could make a top expert feel a sense of crisis.
Daniel understood this point very well.
"However..."
"The path of battle means facing difficulties head-on and remaining unyielding.
Only then can one possess a fearless heart."
Daniel pondered for a moment, then quickly chose to accept the trial calmly.
He immediately sank his mind power into the Ring of Destiny.
Boom!
A thunderous explosion rang out in Daniel’s mind.
The next moment, the scene before his eyes changed dramatically, as though he had been dragged into a strange world.
This place was layered with clouds and mist, filled with hazy spiritual vapor.
At the same time, the bottleneck preventing him from advancing the Law of Reincarnation to transcendent was broken.
He successfully advanced the Law of Reincarnation to transcendent.
[Ding!
Your Law of Reincarnation has advanced to transcendent!]
Listening to the system notification in his ears, Daniel slowly unfolded his sage rank.
At this moment, the Law of Reincarnation within this supreme sage rank had already reached the ultimate tier.
"Now that I have comprehended the transcendent Law of Reincarnation, I should have the ability to raise the limits of my supreme sage rank."
Daniel thought to himself.
The Law of Reincarnation within his supreme sage rank allowed him to overlap the Strength of three micro-instants across three micro-instants.
But that was still not enough.
Now that he had mastered the transcendent Law of Reincarnation, he could absolutely use it as a foundation to further advance his supreme sage rank.
With that thought, he summoned the Ring of Destiny.
Swish!
The Ring of Destiny appeared before him.

Immediately afterward, Daniel used the Law of Reincarnation within his supreme sage rank as the guide and his own transcendent Law of Reincarnation as the foundation, engraving something onto the Ring of Destiny.
Micro-instant, second, minute, hour, day...
Crack!
At that moment, the Ring of Destiny suddenly let out a crisp cracking sound.
Daniel could no longer continue engraving.
But this was already enough!
He had successfully engraved up to "day."
That was already his limit.

chapters.title: Chapter 417 -417-A Pinnacle Legend of the Star Sea
paragraphs: "Measured in days..."
Daniel’s eyes flickered.

"Three hundred and sixty-five days. In other words, I can overlap my Strength from the previous three hundred and sixty-four days and the next three hundred and sixty-four days. Together, that makes seven hundred and twenty-eight days!"
"I can now borrow all of my Strength from seven hundred and twenty-eight different points in time—not merely the power of my sage rank, but every bit of Strength I possess!"
Daniel understood just how enormous the difference was.
Before his Law of Reincarnation reached transcendent, he could only use his supreme sage rank to reincarnate through three micro-instants in the past and future.
Within those three micro-instants, he could overlap the power of his sage rank.
But now, he could stack the Strength of seven hundred and twenty-eight versions of himself from the past and future!
And that Strength was not limited to his sage rank. It included the entirety of his power.
With the Strength of seven hundred and twenty-eight Daniels stacked into a single body, he felt terrifyingly powerful!
Within the mysterious realm, dense clouds and mist churned together before gradually condensing into a humanoid figure.
Seeing this, Daniel’s gaze shifted slightly. He took out the Ring of Destiny and raised his guard.
"So... this is the trial I have to face?"
He stared at the figure emerging from the mist, and his heart abruptly sank.
"No. That’s a T9 Oracle-grade!"
His pupils contracted sharply, and his heartbeat accelerated.
He was merely a Divine Sovereign.
What had he possibly done to deserve a challenge against a T9 Oracle-grade expert?
Faced with Daniel’s shock, the mist-formed expert merely smiled faintly.
Then, the aura radiating from his body began to fall continuously until it reached Divine Sovereign level.
He had voluntarily suppressed his strength to Divine Sovereign?
Daniel raised an eyebrow, completely unable to understand what this meant.
At that moment, the figure opposite him spoke, a playful smile tugging at the corner of his mouth.
"Defeat me, or... die here."
Daniel snorted softly.
"You intend to fight me using only Divine Sovereign-level strength?"
The corners of his mouth also curved upward.
"I’m afraid... that won’t be enough."
"Oh?"
The figure’s smile deepened, and a trace of interest appeared in his eyes.
"Throughout the countless eras within my memory, I have never encountered anyone who dared boast before me. You are the first!"
"My name is Reo. Across the countless prodigies and innumerable eras of the Endless Starsea, I had already become the strongest Divine Sovereign at the age of eight!"
Boom!
It was as though a thunderbolt had exploded inside Daniel’s mind.
R-Reo?!
Daniel had once read that name in ancient records.
There might be many experts named Reo throughout the Endless Starsea, but there was only one whose name the entire star sea remembered.
Unless he was mistaken, the figure before him was that very person.
According to legend, Reo had been a reincarnated T9 Oracle-grade expert. By the age of eight, he had already suppressed the prodigies of countless eras and become the strongest Divine Sovereign!
He had been truly unrivaled beneath the heavens!
Daniel drew a deep breath.
This man was a genuine cheat-level existence!
A T9 Oracle-grade expert had reincarnated with all his memories intact and begun advancing while he was still in his mother’s womb.
He had crushed everyone of the same Rank throughout his journey and walked an invincible path, only to ultimately fall before the final Eternal Tribulation.
In that regard, his life bore some resemblance to Daniel’s.
Reo’s most dazzling period had been when he was a Divine Sovereign.
Daniel had once read in the records that, as a Divine Sovereign, Reo had swept through the entire Divine-grade Rank without a single defeat.
After that, he had challenged Oracle-grade experts, defeating one hundred and twenty-four first-stage Oracle-grade experts and eighteen second-stage Oracle-grade experts.
For Oracle-grade, where every stage represented an entirely different realm, Divine Sovereign Reo had been an existence who shattered all conventional rules.
And now, this monster was Daniel’s opponent!
"Still, the Reo before me should only be a strand of remnant soul left behind from when he was a Divine Sovereign."
Daniel quickly understood.
Reo’s true body had fallen long ago.
For some unknown reason, the Ring of Destiny had drawn a strand of his remnant soul from somewhere within the River of Time and brought it here.
Daniel studied Reo.
Reo was also studying him.
Suddenly, Reo moved!
Boom!
His sage rank unfolded violently.
Its range was as vast as a great world. It was only slightly inferior to Daniel’s supreme sage rank and was still capable of contending against it directly.
Reo stretched out his hand, and the surrounding mist condensed into a long spear.
He wanted to fight at close range?
"What a coincidence. I also enjoy... bullying close-combat fighters!"
Daniel chuckled.
"Voidbound Grail!"
The Holy Grail emerged and hovered in the air. Ripples of law spread outward, continuously weakening Reo’s Strength.
"Interesting!"
Reo sensed his power being constantly suppressed, yet he paid it no mind.
"As long as I retain even a trace of Strength, I can still display the absolute limit of Divine Sovereign!"
That was Reo’s confidence.
He had once stood at the summit of the star sea and feared no form of suppression.
"Hah!"
Reo charged toward Daniel with his spear.
"Ring of Destiny!"
Daniel activated the power of the sacred ring.
Swish, swish, swish...
The Law of Reincarnation rippled around him.
In a single instant, he overlapped a total of seven hundred and twenty-eight days from his past and future, borrowing the Strength of seven hundred and twenty-eight versions of himself!
Boom!
Daniel’s aura surged violently, like a dormant volcano erupting without warning.
"Celestial Grasp!"
The Celestial Grasp he unleashed now was on an entirely different level from before!
After gathering the full Strength of seven hundred and twenty-eight Daniels, the energy contained within it had been pushed to an unimaginable extreme.
Even Daniel himself could not estimate what level it had reached.
Buzz, buzz!
A colossal palm that blotted out the sky appeared with a thunderous rumble.
Every line across its surface contained terrifying energy, as though countless worlds were revolving within its palm.
The enormous hand descended like the collapse of the heavens.
Before it had even fallen, the terrifying energy it radiated caused Reo’s expression to change.
"Something’s wrong..."
A violent sense of danger surged through him. Gritting his teeth, he roared, "Break!"
Boom!
Laws wrapped around the tip of his spear. The forces of destruction and devastation intertwined, attempting to annihilate everything before them.
The colossal palm and the spear collided head-on.
Amid a heaven-shaking explosion, Reo was sent flying backward like a ball that had been violently kicked away.
Every cell in his body trembled and began to collapse!
"This Strength..."
Reo’s eyes were filled with disbelief.
"Even I can’t withstand it?!"
Even when he had been a Divine Sovereign, he had never possessed Strength like this.
Could it be that even he, the publicly acknowledged peerless Divine Sovereign, was inferior to this man?
"No wonder the Ring of Destiny chose him... He truly is an unparalleled monster."
A bitter smile appeared at the corner of Reo’s mouth.
"Unfortunately, I am only a strand of remnant soul now. Had my true body been here, I could have fought him properly."
The injuries across his body instantly recovered.
However, before he could react—
Swish, swish, swish, swish!
Four more colossal palms descended, sealing off his escape routes from the front, back, left, and right.
Every palm contained enough Strength to crush the stars!
"Fight!"
Reo roared, and his entire body trembled.
The next moment, six arms grew from his back, each gripping a long spear!
The instant the spears collided with the colossal palms, deafening explosions shook the heavens. Terrifying waves of Strength burst outward in every direction.
Caught between the colossal palms, Reo’s entire body began to dissipate uncontrollably.
He was just about to activate a Sacred Art to restore himself.
This was the trump card upon which his survival depended.
But at that moment, countless more colossal palms surged toward him!
"Star Dome Shattering!"
This time, phantoms of vast star rivers were contained within the palms, increasing their power by several hundredfold!

chapters.title: Chapter 418 -418-Crushing the Invincible Divine Sovereign
paragraphs: Swish, swish, swish...
Rumble!
Reo was completely submerged beneath an ocean of colossal palms.
Every single palm posed a threat no weaker than a fatal strike from an Oracle-grade expert.
The palms surged forward like an endless tide, completely swallowing his figure.
Had this been a battle between their true bodies, Reo would already be dead.
Daniel watched the scene calmly.
He had not even used his full strength. He had not summoned a single clone, yet Reo—the legendary expert said to have suppressed the prodigies of countless eras—had already lost.
"So this is the power of transcendent reincarnation. Truly unbelievable."
Daniel drew a deep breath.

The reason he had been able to completely crush Reo today was that he had comprehended the transcendent Law of Reincarnation. He had then linked the Law of Reincarnation to the advancement limit of his supreme sage rank, allowing it to leap directly from "micro-instants" to "days."
The limit of a year was three hundred and sixty-five days.

Although he could only reincarnate and overlap the Strength of three hundred and sixty-four days, he could draw upon both the past and the future, stacking the Strength of three hundred and sixty-four days from each direction.
By engraving this power into the Ring of Destiny, he effectively gained the combined Strength of seven hundred and twenty-eight versions of himself.
That was an unimaginably terrifying level of Strength.
Even someone as powerful as Reo could only be utterly crushed beneath it.
Swish!
The clouds and mist before Daniel gathered once more, reforming Reo’s figure.
At this moment, Reo’s aura had returned to the level of a T9 Oracle-grade expert. He studied Daniel with a deep gaze.
Then, he suddenly smiled.
"You are very strong. Had we lived in the same era, even I would have had no choice but to admit defeat."
"Unfortunately, I have already fallen."
Hearing this, Daniel knew that he had passed the trial and could continue comprehending the Ring of Destiny.
"Reaching transcendent is enough for now. Once I advance the Law of Causality to transcendent as well, I’ll be able to formally step into Divine Descendant."
Daniel silently calculated.
There would probably be another trial when that happened.
However, there was still one thing he was curious about.
"My lord, you are only a strand of remnant soul. Had your true body been here, I doubt I could have defeated you so easily."
Daniel smiled faintly.
"Why did you remain here?"
"In the end, I failed to take that final step and was completely annihilated within the Eternal Tribulation."
Reo sighed.
"I do not know why the Ring of Destiny drew a strand of my remnant soul from the River of Time and brought it here."
"The Eternal Tribulation was something even my previous life could not overcome. I reincarnated in an attempt to escape it and delay its arrival, yet I still failed to avoid it..."
"The Eternal Tribulation..."
Daniel fell into thought.
Oracle-grade experts had to endure nine Holy Tribulations.
Beyond those nine trials, there was also the deadliest of them all—the Eternal Tribulation.
Those who survived it would become Eternal Sages, transcend the River of Time, and gain the power to roam freely throughout the Endless Starsea.
Above Eternal Sage lay the Endless Tribulation...
This was why the closer one came to the pinnacle, the fewer experts remained.
Even someone as powerful as Reo had fallen within the Eternal Tribulation and become nothing more than dust in the star sea.
"It was only before my death that I finally understood one truth."
Reo gazed meaningfully at Daniel.
"The stronger you are, the easier the Eternal Tribulation does not necessarily become."
"I hope you will remember that."
Daniel froze for a moment, then nodded.
Swish!
The scene before his eyes suddenly changed.
In the next instant, he found himself back inside the sanctum.
"Now, only the Law of Causality remains."
Daniel drew a deep breath and took out the Chronoverse Prologue Codex.
"Deduce a law."
He only hoped that this deduction would produce the Law of Causality.
That way, he could comprehend its transcendent form more easily and advance to Divine Descendant.
[Prompt: Confirm the consumption of ten billion Primordial Spirits to deduce a forbidden law?]
"Confirm!"
[Ding! Deduction successful! This deduction has produced the Law of Causality!]
Daniel listened to the system notification.
Although he was surprised, it was not entirely unexpected.
Over the years, he had continuously deduced laws but had never encountered the Law of Causality.
Now, it seemed the time for his reward had finally arrived.
[Prompt: The Law of Causality has already been detected. Would you like to fuse them? Upon successful fusion, the Law of Causality will advance!]
"Fuse!"
Daniel did not hesitate.
This was precisely the moment he had been waiting for.
[Ding! Fusion successful. The Law of Causality has advanced successfully.]
[Prompt: The current level of the Law of Causality is transcendent!]
Daniel immediately examined his law tree.
As expected, the Law of Causality had reached transcendent.
Once the Law of Causality reached transcendent, it could directly erase a target through the threads of karma.
Back then, the Oracle-grade expert Justin had possessed the transcendent Law of Causality.
At the request of the Angel King, he had attempted to erase Daniel through the threads of karma while Daniel was still weak.
However, Daniel had already condensed the Fortune Points of his race at the time.
Not only had Justin failed, but he had also suffered backlash from those Fortune Points.
And now, Daniel had mastered the same ability.
If he also gained control over the Laws of Space and Time, then as long as he was willing to pay the necessary price, he could even erase a target from every point in space-time.
Not even an Eternal Sage would be able to resurrect them.
"The transcendent Law of Causality and the transcendent Law of Reincarnation."
Now that both of Daniel’s two great laws had reached transcendent, he was already standing at the threshold of Divine Descendant.
Divine Descendants were infinitely close to Oracle-grade.
One could even say that an Oracle-grade expert was simply a Divine Descendant who had undergone a complete sublimation.
The only difference between the two was that one had survived a Holy Tribulation, while the other had yet to face it.
"The sage rank of a Divine Descendant becomes a world’s will unto itself."
Daniel recalled the profound mysteries taught by high-stage Oracle-grade experts, along with the knowledge recorded in ancient texts.
A Divine Descendant’s sage rank was comparable to a world’s will.
That meant Divine Descendants stood above the will of an individual world, yet beneath the Greater Cosmic Will.
The Holy Tribulation was both a test and a shackle imposed upon Divine Descendants by the Greater Cosmic Will.
The Strength of an Eternal Sage was already comparable to the Greater Cosmic Will.
A Supreme Sage was an existence that surpassed even the Greater Cosmic Will.
The Greater Cosmic Will could never tolerate a living being surpassing it.
Therefore, it would retaliate madly, setting traps and attempting to annihilate those who threatened its supremacy.
This process already began the moment a Divine Descendant attempted to cross into Oracle-grade.
What Daniel needed to do now was advance to Divine Descendant.
He had to transcend the will of a world and transform his supreme sage rank into an existence comparable to a world’s will.
At the same time, he would accept the nourishment fed back by his sage rank, strengthening his body until his own power also surpassed the level of a world’s will.
"Fortunately, I have tens of billions of divine energy. It should be enough!"
Daniel no longer hesitated.
He poured all of his divine energy into his sage rank.
At the same time, he activated the Law of Causality and the Law of Reincarnation with all his power.
Swish...
One water lily after another bloomed within his supreme sage rank.
At last, even the largest water lily at the very center slowly opened.
Countless streams of gray aura condensed into illusory water lilies, which then poured into Daniel’s body one after another.
He enjoyed the nourishment fed back by his sage rank as his entire body was completely transformed from the inside out.
At this moment, he could clearly sense immense energy contained within every cell.
Every strand of his genetic structure was undergoing a qualitative transformation.
Although the external structure of his body remained unchanged, its inner nature had been completely reborn.
In terms of mass, the density of his current body already surpassed that of countless life-bearing planets.
In terms of energy, the Strength contained within each individual cell was comparable to an entire minor world.
At the same time, his sage rank also began to change.
Back in the Astral Realm, the world’s will had willingly annihilated itself, carrying with it an immeasurable amount of World Origin power to help Daniel construct his sage rank.
And now, within that sage rank, a new spirit of world will had actually been born.
However, this spirit possessed neither independent mind power nor consciousness.
That was because Daniel’s mind power was its will.
It was merely a projection of Daniel himself.

Rumble!
Reo was completely submerged beneath an ocean of colossal palms.
Every single palm posed a threat no weaker than a fatal strike from an Oracle-grade expert.
The palms surged forward like an endless tide, completely swallowing his figure.
Had this been a battle between their true bodies, Reo would already be dead.
Daniel watched the scene calmly.
He had not even used his full strength.
He had not summoned a single clone, yet Reo—the legendary expert said to have suppressed the prodigies of countless eras—had already lost.
"So this is the power of transcendent reincarnation.
Truly unbelievable."
Daniel drew a deep breath.
The reason he had been able to completely crush Reo today was that he had comprehended the transcendent Law of Reincarnation.
He had then linked the Law of Reincarnation to the advancement limit of his supreme sage rank, allowing it to leap directly from "micro-instants" to "days."
The limit of a year was three hundred and sixty-five days.

Although he could only reincarnate and overlap the Strength of three hundred and sixty-four days, he could draw upon both the past and the future, stacking the Strength of three hundred and sixty-four days from each direction.
By engraving this power into the Ring of Destiny, he effectively gained the combined Strength of seven hundred and twenty-eight versions of himself.
That was an unimaginably terrifying level of Strength.
Even someone as powerful as Reo could only be utterly crushed beneath it.
Swish!
The clouds and mist before Daniel gathered once more, reforming Reo’s figure.
At this moment, Reo’s aura had returned to the level of a T9 Oracle-grade expert.

"You are very strong.

"Unfortunately, I have already fallen."
Hearing this, Daniel knew that he had passed the trial and could continue comprehending the Ring of Destiny.
"Reaching transcendent is enough for now.

"In the end, I failed to take that final step and was completely annihilated within the Eternal Tribulation."

I reincarnated in an attempt to escape it and delay its arrival, yet I still failed to avoid it..."
"The Eternal Tribulation..."
Daniel fell into thought.
Oracle-grade experts had to endure nine Holy Tribulations.
Beyond those nine trials, there was also the deadliest of them all—the Eternal Tribulation.
Those who survived it would become Eternal Sages, transcend the River of Time, and gain the power to roam freely throughout the Endless Starsea.

This was why the closer one came to the pinnacle, the fewer experts remained.
Even someone as powerful as Reo had fallen within the Eternal Tribulation and become nothing more than dust in the star sea.

Reo gazed meaningfully at Daniel.

In the next instant, he found himself back inside the sanctum.

"Confirm!"
[Ding!
Deduction successful!
This deduction has produced the Law of Causality!]

Upon successful fusion, the Law of Causality will advance!]

[Ding!
Fusion successful.
The Law of Causality has advanced successfully.]

chapters.title: Chapter 419 -419-Divine Descendant, Sacred Creation!
paragraphs: No one knew how much time had passed before all the Gray Lotuses within Daniel’s supreme sage rank slowly closed.
The sublimation of his body was complete.
He had successfully advanced to Divine Descendant!
Divine Descendant!
Daniel clenched his fist.
Feeling the tremendous surge of Strength within his body, a smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
"Divine Descendant... I should still be able to instantly kill anyone at the same Rank!"
Advancing to Divine Descendant did not strengthen merely one aspect of his power.
His sage rank, physical body, and mind power had all undergone a comprehensive leap.
There were only two paths of advancement in the Endless Starsea—the body and the soul.
The highest standard of the physical path was to forge one’s body into an existence comparable to an Eternal Supreme Treasure.
A body at that level could open up a world with a single palm strike and shatter stars with a single punch!
Advancement along the soul path, meanwhile, required one to focus on the sage rank.
Daniel leaned more toward the soul path, placing greater emphasis on forging his supreme sage rank.
This was probably related to the fact that he had chosen the archer class back when he was still inside the game.
However, although he had deliberately specialized in one direction, his overall foundation remained extraordinarily solid.
Even in a direct clash of physical bodies, he could still crush powerful opponents at the same Rank.
It could be said that Daniel possessed no obvious weaknesses.
Once he advanced to Oracle-grade and his supreme sage rank completely fused with his physical body, he would be able to unleash the greatest power he truly possessed.
As for the physical path, he could cultivate that alongside it as well.
"I have practically endless resources. Tempering my body will be effortless."

"And my foundation is already thick enough. Even without deliberately tempering it, my body is far stronger than those of others at the same Rank. With only a little refinement, I’ll surpass the overwhelming majority of experts by a huge margin."
"I now control two transcendent laws—the Law of Causality and the Law of Reincarnation—as well as the low-grade Laws of Space and Time. At the Divine Descendant Rank, I am already invincible!"
Daniel stroked his chin thoughtfully.
In truth, however, his greatest trump card was still his seemingly limitless supply of resources.
With the Millionfold Boost system, his resources were practically inexhaustible!
Behind him stood the accumulated foundation of the Golden Holy Mountain, built over countless eras by innumerable Oracle-grade experts.
Even when facing powerful Oracle-grade or high-stage Oracle-grade experts, he had nothing to fear.
"The future looks promising!"
Daniel could hardly imagine any unexpected event capable of interrupting his legendary path of invincibility.
At that thought, he suddenly remembered the system quest—Chaos Starfire!
The quest required him to occupy an entire star system.
"Wait. Occupy a star system?"
Daniel blinked.
"The star system where Crown’s Summit is located seems like a pretty good choice!"
He had already set his sights on Crown’s Summit.
Since the karmic grudge between them had already been formed, he might as well go all the way and eliminate them completely.
Daniel traced forward along the threads of karma, clearly observing the entanglement between himself and Crown’s Summit.
The causality connecting them had long since become a tangled mess.
He might as well destroy them and complete the Chaos Starfire quest along the way.
With his current strength, challenging low-stage Oracle-grade experts above his Rank was no longer difficult.
Crown’s Summit was merely a power formed by several low-stage Oracle-grade experts huddling together for protection.
It would not be much of a problem.
With that thought, Daniel had already formed a plan.
"It’s time to leave."
He looked around, then laughed despite himself.
Ten days had passed in the outside world.
Within the sanctum’s ten-thousandfold time flow, however, he had spent a full one hundred thousand years!
Daniel clenched his fist and felt the immense, weighty Strength flowing through his body.
The gains from this seclusion had far exceeded his expectations.
Beep, beep, beep... beep!
At that moment, the Ivahpin Scroll in his robes began sounding urgently.
"Hm?"
"Oh! So the time has finally come!"
Daniel’s heart stirred.
He remembered the matter he had previously entrusted to that dwarven grandmaster.

Back at the Golden Holy Mountain, he had spent an enormous number of points and several priceless Divine-grade materials, handing the Star Relic he had obtained from the Chaos Starsea and the black stele over to the most renowned dwarven grandmaster of the Golden Holy Mountain.
That grandmaster was a T7 Oracle-grade expert and the craftsman with the greatest chance of forging a Primordial Supreme Treasure in the entire starfield!
Now that the grandmaster had contacted him, the treasure had most likely been completed.
Daniel sank his mind into Ivahpin World.
The moment the high-stage Oracle-grade expert saw him, a smile appeared on his face.
"Faustus, your treasure has been successfully forged!"
As he spoke, he summoned the treasure.
It was shaped like a stone tablet. Its entire body was pitch-black, and its surface was as smooth as a mirror. It bore neither writing nor patterns and appeared plain and unremarkable.
"This treasure is the work I am proudest of throughout my entire forging career."
"Its quality has already reached the level of a Primordial Supreme Treasure, and it far surpasses ordinary Primordial Supreme Treasures. Take a look."
Daniel accepted the stone tablet.
It was only the size of his palm and floated weightlessly above his hand.
With a thought, he attempted to sell it.
[Ding! You are about to sell the Nameless Treasure to the Doom Guild for one copper coin. Confirm?]
"Confirm!"
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
The next moment—
[Ding! Sale behavior detected. Millionfold Boost triggered...]
[You have obtained the Origin Supreme Treasure: Nameless Stone Tablet!]
Daniel hurriedly examined its detailed information.
[Nameless Stone Tablet]
[Grade: Origin Supreme Treasure]
[Status: Nameable]
[Type: Growth / All-Purpose]
[Effects:]
[1. Endless Projection: Can endlessly project a Shadow possessing exactly the same strength as the true body. The current space-time limit is one.]
[Note: Only one Shadow may exist at a time, but it may be projected an unlimited number of times.]
[2. Infinite Detonation: The treasure may self-detonate. Its destructive power is determined by the strength of its wielder and its target.]
[3. Impervious to All Laws: Can resist all law power below the level of the Greater Cosmic Will.]
[4. Untouched by Causality: Ignores karma and causality. No matter how many beings it kills, it will incur neither karmic ties nor karmic consequences.]
[5. Endless Lawbreaking: Ignores all law power below the level of the Greater Cosmic Will. The actual effect depends on the difference in strength between the wielder and the target.]

[6. Source of Destruction: The treasure itself contains the power of the ultimate-tier Law of Destruction. Anyone injured by this treasure will inevitably suffer damage to their Origin. At best, their Origin will be heavily damaged. At worst, they will die instantly. The actual effect depends on the difference in strength between the wielder and the target.]
[7. Infinite Growth: By devouring treasures of the same tier or higher, this treasure has a chance of advancing.]

[Special Description: This treasure has surpassed numerous Primordial Supreme Treasures and reached the realm of an Origin Supreme Treasure. It has yet to be named. Please name this treasure and take full control of it.]

[This treasure has already touched the pinnacle of the Origin Supreme Treasure tier. Even more remarkably, it possesses limitless potential for growth. It is exceptionally rare and precious beyond measure...]
After reading the treasure’s description, Daniel felt as though a thunderbolt had struck his mind.
A priceless treasure?
A supreme treasure?
No.
This was an unparalleled masterpiece!
With Daniel’s current standards, he no longer even considered Primordial Law-grade treasures worth his attention.
Over the years, he had obtained countless treasures, yet he had consistently relied on only two of them.
The Voidbound Grail and the Basin of Greed!
He could not even be bothered to look at many of the other treasures.
It was not because he had no need for them, but because his standards had been raised far too high.
Yet the treasure before him captivated him so completely that he could not look away.
Every word of praise seemed pale and powerless before such a masterpiece.
Only the name "Sacred Creation" was worthy of it.
[Prompt: You have named this supreme treasure Sacred Creation. Confirm?]
"Confirm!"
[Ding! Supreme treasure renamed: Sacred Creation!]
Daniel was completely satisfied.
After bidding farewell to the dwarven grandmaster, his mind returned to the sanctum.
He took out the supreme treasure once more and carefully admired it.

chapters.title: Chapter 420 -420-Departure, Settling Old Scores
paragraphs: The first ability of Sacred Creation—Endless Projection!
This was the ability it had inherited from the Star Relic.

Only one Projection could exist within the current space-time. Although it could create Projections endlessly, they had to be summoned one at a time. It could not instantly fill the entire void with them.
Combined with its second ability, Infinite Detonation, the upper limit of the treasure’s self-destruction depended on the wielder’s strength.
However strong Daniel was, the detonation would be equally powerful.
It was effectively another inexhaustible method of self-destruction on top of his exploding clones.
The third ability was Impervious to All Laws.
This meant that methods capable of forcibly seizing treasures, such as the Basin of Greed, would be ineffective against Sacred Creation.
Even laws governing fate, causality, space, and time could not affect Sacred Creation.
That was the true essence of being impervious to all laws!
The fourth ability was Untouched by Causality.
It allowed Sacred Creation to ignore both causality and karma.
Slaughter between living beings accumulated karma. The heavier one’s karma became, the fiercer one’s Holy Tribulation would be, multiplying the difficulty of overcoming it several times over.
A Holy Tribulation that could originally have been survived with ease might end in failure because of overwhelming karmic entanglement.
Yet when Sacred Creation killed a target, it incurred neither karmic ties nor karmic consequences. Others would be unable to trace any connection back to Daniel through the deceased.
The fifth ability was Endless Lawbreaking.
It could ignore all laws and Sacred Arts below the level of the Greater Cosmic Will, using overwhelming force to suppress every elaborate technique.
Once Sacred Creation appeared, countless laws would bow before it!
The sixth ability was Source of Destruction, which contained the power of the ultimate-tier Law of Destruction.
Within the Endless Starsea, the Law of Destruction possessed the greatest offensive power among all tangible laws—without exception.
Anyone struck by it would inevitably suffer damage to their Origin.
The seventh ability was Infinite Growth!
This ability concerned the future of Sacred Creation—a height that was almost without limit!
After reviewing each ability, Daniel gained a clear understanding of the treasure.
With his current strength, he was still far from being able to unleash its full potential.
"Perhaps only after reaching Oracle-grade will I be able to fully wield all of its power."
He thought about it but felt no urgency.
Advancing to Oracle-grade meant beginning the path of tribulation.
Once that happened, it was like having a death warrant stamped upon oneself.

Holy Tribulations would descend at fixed intervals, and there would be no way to hide from them. If one failed to advance within the required time, the next Holy Tribulation would be forced upon them regardless.
Fortunately, Divine Descendants did not yet receive such "special treatment."

Daniel opened his palm.
The black stone tablet slowly rotated above it like a dormant star.
Originally, he would already have been satisfied with obtaining a single Primordial Supreme Treasure.
He had never imagined that the Millionfold Boost would produce such an extraordinary treasure!
Daniel drew a deep breath and suppressed the excitement surging within his heart.
His strength had now reached an entirely new level. For the time being, he no longer needed to consider advancing further.
With a wave of his hand, he dismantled the restrictions outside the sanctum.
He had no intention of abandoning that array formation. It could still be used again in the future.
Afterward, he transformed into a streak of light and flew out of the sanctum.
Daniel left without warning, yet his departure sent ripples throughout the entire sacred ground.
The guides who made their living by trading information were the first to notice.
When they discovered that the arrays and restrictions outside Daniel’s sanctum had been removed, the news spread like wildfire.
Discussions about Daniel erupted once more.
"Latest news! That supreme Divine Sovereign has left!"
"Oh, of course I’ve heard. That great figure departed without making the slightest sound. I imagine he must have returned with tremendous gains."
"What an enormous regret! I never had the chance to witness that existence with my own eyes. For someone like him, even a single distant glimpse would be enough to remember for a lifetime."
"Regret? My friend, in my opinion, that is actually a stroke of good fortune!"
"Why?"
An expert looked puzzled.
"It is better not to encounter an existence like that at all! Wherever such people go, they stir up towering waves, sweeping away everything in their path like a passing storm."
"For insignificant beings like us, the wisest choice is to retreat quietly into the distance and remain silent spectators."
"You must understand—curiosity is often the fastest road into the abyss!"
"Your insight is certainly unique!"
The guides struck while the topic was hot and heavily promoted the sanctum where Daniel had cultivated.
They embellished Daniel’s deeds until they sounded almost mythical, attracting Oracle-grade experts who needed a place to advance.
As a result, the value of the sanctum skyrocketed.
At its peak, the price was driven all the way up to fifty thousand units of Origin Crystal for ten days.
The reason was simple.
Daniel’s battle record was far too monstrous!
While still a Divine Sovereign, he had killed a second-stage Oracle-grade expert. He had then set up a killing array and trapped a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert to death.
Such a ferocious record naturally filled countless Oracle-grade experts with admiration and longing.
After leaving the sacred ground, Daniel did not contact Thorne.
The two had merely met by chance.
Although they both belonged to the Golden Holy Mountain, the organization itself was extremely loose.
Back in the Astral Realm, there had even been a Divine-grade member of the Golden Holy Mountain who wanted to kill him.
After completing the mission and obtaining ten thousand points, Daniel departed alone.
Coincidentally, the seal over the Chaosverse was currently loosening.
Had he emerged a day earlier, he might not have been able to travel wherever he pleased.
The mysterious Black Coffin was still locked in an endless struggle with the Bell of Destiny.
However, the Bell of Destiny had consistently maintained the upper hand, crushing the Black Coffin throughout their battle.
As a result, the Chaosverse’s seal continued alternating between complete closure and temporary relaxation.
Daniel summoned the Imperial Bow Ark, sat inside its cabin, and spread out a starfield map.
"Zhongneng Starfield, Flamefire Star River, Ravagerfish Star System, Flying Fish Plane... Crown’s Summit is located there."
He quickly locked onto his destination.
He was already within the Flamefire Star River, so reaching the Flying Fish Plane would not take too long.
While the Imperial Bow Ark flew onward, Daniel entered Ivahpin World and began reviewing information about Crown’s Summit.
"So the Ravagerfish Star System is actually quite a valuable star system."
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
With the Millionfold Boost system, the best way to maximize his benefits was to continuously acquire resources.
When others obtained one share, they received only one share.
When Daniel obtained one share, he received a million!
Originally, he had intended to deal with Crown’s Summit solely to settle their grudge and complete his mission.
He had not expected to discover such valuable territory.
The Ravagerfish Star System was rich in flying fish, which were Divine-grade materials.
Divine-grade materials meant resources.
Resources meant points.
And points meant combat power!
His mission required him to occupy a star system.
Since the Ravagerfish Star System was so valuable, there was no need to waste effort searching elsewhere.
Rather than occupy some barren territory, he might as well choose this place.
"The Flying Fish Plane occupied by Crown’s Summit produces large numbers of six-winged flying fish..."
Daniel continued reading through the records.
"It is second only to the Skywing Plane, which can reliably produce twelve-winged flying fish."
"And there is also a major power stationed within the Ravagerfish Star System."
Daniel pondered briefly.
The Chaosverse was different from other universes.
Other universes were at least somewhat stable, while the level of chaos within the Chaosverse was in a category of its own.
What other universe could compare to a cosmic war involving over ten thousand Oracle-grade experts?
Therefore, the ranking of powers within the Chaosverse was completely different from that of other universes.
The Chaos Humans, for example, were considered a superpower.
They had a T8 Oracle-grade expert holding the fort and possessed an immensely profound foundation.
A major power, meanwhile, was one that had at least a T6 Oracle-grade expert.

chapters.title: Chapter 421 -421-Taking On Crown’s Summit Alone
paragraphs: There was a major power within the Ravagerfish Star System.
A T7 Oracle-grade expert guarded it. However, that expert spent nearly all his time in secluded cultivation and rarely showed himself.
Rumor had it that the time for his next Holy Tribulation was fast approaching, so he was racing against time to accumulate as much strength as possible.
Otherwise, once the Holy Tribulation descended, he would very likely be reduced to ashes!
Meanwhile, one of his clones had joined the war in the Chaosverse and was currently fighting against the armies of the Chitin Universe.
Aside from that T7 Oracle-grade expert, numerous other Oracle-grade experts served beneath him and managed the entire star system.
In other words, if Daniel wanted to occupy the Ravagerfish Star System, a direct confrontation with that T7 Oracle-grade expert would be unavoidable.
"But why would I be stupid enough to charge straight at him and fight him head-on?"
Daniel laughed inwardly.
"I’ll enter first, kick Crown’s Summit out of the way, and establish a foothold. I can deal with everything else gradually."
"Besides, that T7 Oracle-grade expert’s Holy Tribulation is almost here. If he fails to survive it, then he’ll be finished for good."
Once that happened, the Oracle-grade experts beneath him would surely descend into chaos.
Daniel could take advantage of the turmoil and fish out a few valuable prizes.
Wasn’t that far more profitable than confronting them directly?
Besides, if the people of Crown’s Summit could establish themselves here and rule like kings, then surely no one would object if Daniel suddenly eliminated them and took their place.
While Daniel was setting his sights on Crown’s Summit—
Flying Fish Plane, Crown’s Summit.
"Big Brother, the latest news!"
Lucius, the Second Lord of Crown’s Summit, strode quickly into the hall with joy written across his face.
"News has arrived from the sacred ground. That Divine Sovereign has already left. We’re safe!"
He had left?
The Divine Sovereign who had killed Shar had departed so soon?
Rather than feeling relieved, Grand Lord Ceric frowned deeply.
Seeing his second brother’s delighted expression, he could not help but rebuke him.
"What are you so happy about?"
Lucius froze.
"That Divine Sovereign has already left. Doesn’t that mean we’re safe?"
"What an idiot!"
Ceric cursed under his breath.
"You think we’re safe just because he left?"
"You truly are a fool. This only means we’re in even greater danger!"
"Hm?"
Lucius was completely dumbfounded.
"You really do have the brain of a pig."
Ceric sighed heavily.
"Until that existence’s destination is confirmed, we remain in danger. You have no idea whether he intends to come here and settle the score with us!"
"That shouldn’t happen, Big Brother."
Lucius was unconvinced.
"We’re already showing him mercy by not going after him. Would he really dare come after us?"
"I truly want to kick you to death."
Ceric glared at him furiously.
"That existence can even kill a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert. Where did you get the courage to believe he would be afraid of us?"
"Have you always been this brave?"
Lucius’s face instantly turned deathly pale.
The reason everyone treated that existence so seriously was precisely because he could kill even a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert!
Crown’s Summit did not possess so much as a single fourth-stage Oracle-grade expert, much less someone at the fifth stage.
Even Ceric, the strongest among them, was only at the peak of the third stage.
If that Divine Sovereign truly came looking for them...
Lucius shuddered involuntarily.
Deep within the Zhongneng Starfield.
A starship tore through the void at tremendous speed. Space rolled apart on either side of it like an ocean split by a sharp blade.
The border of the Flying Fish Plane lay directly ahead.
Countless starships moved through this territory, transporting cargo and leaving trails of light in their wake.
Daniel put away his starship and descended at the edge of the Flying Fish Plane.
He raised his gaze toward the region ahead.
"So this is Crown’s Summit’s stronghold?"
The next moment, his figure flickered and passed directly through the planar barrier.
Crown’s Summit.
A hazy layer of light surrounded the outskirts of the faction’s territory.
Layers of restrictions wound around the mountain, combining concealment and defense into a single system.
The moment mind power probed too deeply, the entire defensive network would be triggered.
Daniel hovered at the edge of the restrictions, the corner of his mouth lifting slightly.
In the past, he would have needed to waste an Oracle-grade treasure to open a path.
Now, that was no longer necessary.
"Sacred Creation."
A black stone tablet suddenly appeared.
In the blink of an eye, it expanded until it stretched across the void like an enormous mountain.
Boom!
The stone tablet smashed toward the protective array with unstoppable momentum.
Sacred Creation possessed the ability Impervious to All Laws.
Although the array before him was of a high grade, it could not obstruct the treasure in the slightest.
Rumble!
The arrays and restrictions of Crown’s Summit were fully activated.
Countless law-based Sacred Arts erupted like a raging tide. Killing arrays and restrictions activated simultaneously.
Even a high-stage Oracle-grade expert would have to treat such defenses with caution.
However, Sacred Creation was an Origin Supreme Treasure.
Even high-stage Oracle-grade experts would have to tread carefully before it!
Daniel silently uttered a single word.
"Break."
Sacred Creation expanded once more, growing until it spanned millions of miles.
It resembled an ancient behemoth suddenly unfurling its body, crushing the layered arrays and restrictions into fragments.
The entire defensive system collapsed in an instant.
At the same time, countless streaks of light shot out from within Crown’s Summit.
One figure after another revealed themselves, staring blankly at the scene before them.
Someone was attacking Crown’s Summit?
Daniel stood atop Sacred Creation, looking down from above at the experts gathering below.
Among them were numerous Divine-grade and Oracle-grade experts.
"How dare you!"
Lucius, the Second Lord of Crown’s Summit, roared and was just about to attack when he suddenly thought of something.
He turned toward his elder brother.
"Big Brother, is he that supreme existence?"
"But wasn’t that person a Divine Sovereign?"
"He looks like a Divine Descendant now... Hm? Big Brother, why does your face look so terrible?"
Ceric wanted nothing more than to slap his brother across the face.
Was this idiot blind?
What ordinary Divine Descendant would come and challenge Crown’s Summit for no reason?
More importantly, could an ordinary Divine Descendant possibly destroy arrays and restrictions capable of withstanding T7 Oracle-grade power?
That existence had occupied the sanctum precisely because he wanted to advance.
Wasn’t it perfectly normal that he had now become a Divine Descendant?
"He is that Divine Sovereign."
Ceric let out a long sigh, his voice filled with the weariness of someone who had accepted his fate.
"The grudge between us will be settled today."
"We should never have entertained that thought in the first place. The moment the intention arose, we had already committed the sin."
This was how the Endless Starsea operated.
When dealing with powerful experts, merely thinking of harming them could become an original sin.
The moment such a thought appeared, causality was formed.
Unlike in the mortal world, one did not need to take actual action before consequences arose.
A powerful expert could create a world with a single thought and destroy one just as easily.
A thought itself was Strength!
Since Crown’s Summit had once intended to act against Daniel, they naturally had to bear the possible consequences.
As an Oracle-grade expert, Ceric understood this clearly.
He raised his head and looked toward Daniel.
His body trembled slightly, separating into three clones.
Each clone looked identical to his true body.
The instant they appeared, they attacked decisively without the slightest hesitation.
"Attack!"
Ceric’s true body and three clones charged forward simultaneously.
Law-based Sacred Arts poured down like a storm, while the light of numerous treasures exploded throughout the void.
Seeing his elder brother take action, Lucius also roared.
His body suddenly swelled, making him resemble an enraged bull as he charged toward Daniel.
Daniel watched everything coldly and lightly stepped down.
"You overestimate yourselves."
Sacred Creation descended toward the two Lords with overwhelming force.
Its Impervious to All Laws ability easily blocked Ceric’s law-based Sacred Arts before knocking his treasures away.
"Voidbound Grail!"
"Basin of Greed!"
Daniel activated both treasures simultaneously.
The Voidbound Grail sealed the surrounding space, leaving the enemies nowhere to retreat.
The Basin of Greed released a vast wave of light, forcibly collecting every treasure below Primordial Law-grade.
A cold smile appeared on Daniel’s face.
"Detonate."
Boom!
Without the slightest warning, Sacred Creation exploded violently.
The raging Strength caused the entire plane to tremble.
Heaven and earth changed color, as though the apocalypse had descended.
Sacred Creation could create Endless Projections.
That also meant it could detonate itself without limit.

The raging Strength caused the entire plane to tremble.
Heaven and earth changed color, as though the apocalypse had descended.
Sacred Creation could create Endless Projections.
That also meant it could detonate itself without limit.

chapters.title: Chapter 422 -422-Sacred Creation Shatters
paragraphs: Boom! Boom! Boom!
Explosions erupted one after another throughout the surrounding space.
Every time Sacred Creation shattered, a new stone tablet immediately condensed into existence.
Once the cycle of Infinite Detonation began, it would not stop until every enemy had been completely destroyed!
Even more terrifyingly, Sacred Creation inherently contained the immensely destructive Law of Destruction. Even Oracle-grade experts could not completely ignore its power.
Ceric and Lucius were thrown into chaos by the repeated explosions, barely managing to withstand the waves of impact.
Fortunately, the Constitution and law-based Sacred Arts of Oracle-grade experts were far beyond the ordinary, allowing them to endure most of the damage.
This was also because Daniel was still unable to unleash Sacred Creation’s full potential.
Once he stepped into Oracle-grade one day, the two of them would not merely be left in such a miserable state.
"Clones!"
"Banner of Destiny’s Judgment!"
Daniel’s clones appeared and took out the Banner of Destiny’s Judgment.
The void twisted violently, and an expert radiating an ancient aura stepped forth.
The Ancient Holy Spirit!
However, the Ancient Holy Spirit was no longer at the first stage of Oracle-grade as it had been before.
It had reached the second stage of Oracle-grade!
Thud! Thud! Thud!
The moment its body fully condensed, it strode toward Lucius and launched a ferocious attack.
Lucius was only a second-stage Oracle-grade expert himself, and the repeated detonations of Sacred Creation had already left him seriously injured.
How could he possibly be a match for the Ancient Holy Spirit, which could display the strength of a peak second-stage Oracle-grade expert?
After only a few exchanges, the Ancient Holy Spirit restrained him.
It seized both of Lucius’s shoulders and pulled with tremendous force, tearing his entire body in half!
Lord Lucius had fallen!
"Lucius!"
Ceric’s eyes nearly split apart when he witnessed the scene.
Daniel merely glanced at him indifferently.
"Why the hurry? You’re next."
A blade talisman appeared in Daniel’s hand.
It was an Oracle-grade treasure created by a fourth-stage Oracle-grade expert and could unleash that expert’s full-force strike.
At the same time, the Ancient Holy Spirit had already charged toward Ceric.
Its entire body was as tough as a Primordial Treasure. In close-quarters combat, it gave Ceric no chance to catch his breath.
Sacred Creation also transformed into a colossal mountain and descended from above.
From the other side, a heaven-shaking blade light slashed toward him from the flank.
It carried the aura of a fourth-stage Oracle-grade expert!
Ceric was trapped between them with nowhere to escape.
"I finally understand how he killed Shar... and how he killed that fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert."
Only after being driven into a desperate situation did Ceric truly understand how those fallen Oracle-grade experts had felt.
A mere Divine Sovereign had possessed methods capable of contending directly against Oracle-grade experts, along with an endless supply of Oracle-grade treasures.
Forget a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert.
What difference would even a T9 Oracle-grade expert make?
With so many Oracle-grade treasures protecting him, where in the vast Endless Starsea could Daniel not go?
Who could truly harm him?
Swish!
The blade light arrived first despite being launched later, killing one of Ceric’s clones with a single slash.
Ceric still had other clones, but two more blade lights followed immediately and wiped them out as well.
Sacred Creation blocked Ceric’s Sacred Arts from the front.
The Ancient Holy Spirit restrained most of his combat power.
At this moment, Ceric was like a mortal with his hands and feet bound.
Only one final strike was needed to end his life.
Whoosh!
The blade light that filled him with despair flashed once more, cleanly splitting him apart.
Grand Lord Ceric had fallen!
The deaths of the two Lords occurred almost one after the other.
At the same time, two cold system notifications rang in Daniel’s ears.
[Ding! You have slain a second-stage Oracle-grade expert. You have obtained 32.4 billion units of Origin Crystal, one Primordial Law-grade Treasure, five Primordial Treasures...]
[Ding! You have slain a third-stage Oracle-grade expert. You have obtained 41.3 billion units of Origin Crystal, two Primordial Law-grade Treasures, eight Primordial Treasures...]
Daniel calmly collected all the spoils.
His indifferent voice echoed throughout the entire plane.
"The Lords of Crown’s Summit had a personal grudge with me. Now that our causality has been settled, I bear no hatred toward the rest of you and will not slaughter the innocent."
"You now have two choices. Submit to me, or leave the Flying Fish Plane."
Crown’s Summit possessed several hundred Divine-grade experts, several thousand quasi-sages, tens of thousands of supreme-grade experts, and an incalculable number of god-grade beings.
These were the foundations the faction had accumulated over countless years.
Now that the three Lords were dead, Daniel would also need manpower to take over this territory.
Therefore, he had no intention of exterminating everyone.
His words soon reached the ears of every expert with perfect clarity.
Many of those present had personally witnessed the entire process of him killing the two Lords.
"They died just like that? All the Lords are dead..."
The Divine-grade servants stared in stunned silence.
"A Divine Descendant killed Oracle-grade Lords. Am I still dreaming?"
"I choose to submit. Following a leader like this should offer a far brighter future."
"I agree. This young existence clearly possesses limitless potential. At the very least, he’ll become a high-stage Oracle-grade expert in the future!"
"We submit! We are willing to submit!"
Daniel did not particularly care what the Divine-grade experts chose.
He flew directly into Crown’s Summit.
From this moment onward, this mountain and the entire plane belonged to him.
"My esteemed lord!"
A quick-witted Divine-grade expert appeared in time and bowed respectfully.
"I am one of the administrators of Crown’s Summit. I have long awaited your arrival and am willing to submit to you."
Daniel nodded.
"Lead the way."
"As you command."
The administrator guided him to the treasury entrance before tactfully withdrawing.
Daniel entered the treasury alone.
Before long, system notifications began ringing one after another.
[Ding! Would you like to sell all resources within the treasury?]
"Yes!"
[Ding! Sale behavior detected. You have obtained thirteen Primordial Law-grade Treasures, one hundred and three Primordial Treasures, two hundred and sixty-six Sacred Artisan Law-grade Treasures...]
Daniel harvested all the treasures and items inside the treasury, leaving behind only a portion required to maintain normal trade operations.
This was yet another enormous harvest.
By the time Daniel walked out of the treasury and arrived at the main hall, a large group of Divine-grade experts had already gathered outside.
The Divine Radiant expert at their head stepped forward and spoke on behalf of the others.
They were willing to submit!
Daniel nodded.
"From this moment onward, your compensation will be increased by fifty percent. Everything else will continue as before."
The Divine Radiant expert was overjoyed and hurriedly bowed.
"Thank you, my lord! My name is Pierce. My family has lived here for generations. Should you ever have any orders for me, I will carry them out even at the cost of my life."
"That’s perfect. I have something for you to handle."
Daniel continued, "From today onward, this place will be renamed the Sanctum of Triumph. You will temporarily take charge of reorganizing the faction under its new name."
"As you command."
Pierce was inwardly shocked.
What tremendous ambition!
This lord had immediately established a new faction of his own.
His vision and bearing were far beyond anything the former Lords of Crown’s Summit had possessed.
"There is one more question."
Daniel suddenly asked, "How did Crown’s Summit previously pay taxes to the power above it?"
The Flying Fish Star System was guarded by a T7 Oracle-grade expert.
The faction belonging to that expert was known as Mistral Manor!
In truth, they exercised complete control over the entire star system.
Every year, Crown’s Summit had been required to hand over seventy percent of all resources it earned.
"Seventy percent," Pierce answered truthfully. "At a fixed time each year, Mistral Manor sends people to inspect the accounts. We simply pay according to the profits recorded in the ledgers."
