chapters.title: Chapter 423 -423-Oracle-Grade Experts Swear Allegiance
paragraphs: Seventy percent.
What an enormous appetite!
Daniel frowned slightly but showed no reaction on his face.
"Now that I’ve killed the Lords of Crown’s Summit and taken their place, will Mistral Manor hold me responsible?"
"No!"
Pierce answered with certainty.
"The T7 Oracle-grade Forefather of Mistral Manor has remained in secluded cultivation for years, preparing for his Holy Tribulation. All mundane affairs are handled by his servants."
"As long as the annual tribute is no lower than in previous years, no one will interfere."
"When will that Forefather face his tribulation?"
"According to the rumors, sometime this year."
Daniel nodded and dismissed Pierce, but his thoughts began turning.
Barring any unexpected development, that Forefather’s chances were probably grim.
If he had been confident of surviving the Holy Tribulation, he would not have remained in seclusion for so long.
Once that expert fell, the balance of power throughout this starfield would likely change.
But even if he successfully survived, Daniel was not afraid.
It would merely mean that Daniel had to pay a greater price.
News of Crown’s Summit’s occupation spread rapidly.
A Divine Descendant had seized the faction by force and replaced its former rulers.
More importantly, that Divine Descendant was already a widely renowned figure.
For a time, fresh waves surged through the Flamefire Star River, which had already been filled with hidden undercurrents.
To the billions of living beings within the Flying Fish Plane, it merely meant that the sky above their heads had changed ownership.
To the trading powers, the replacement of a few Lords would not reduce the price of prized flying fish by even a single coin.
Even so, many experts were shaken by the news.
Inside a sanctum with several-thousandfold time flow, a second-stage Oracle-grade lone traveler emerged from seclusion.
His name was Vito.
He was an interstellar warrior who had always wandered the star sea alone.
After hearing that Daniel had established his own faction, he hesitated briefly before quickly making up his mind.
That existence had already planted his banner within the Flying Fish Plane.
If Vito joined him now, he would surely receive considerable importance.
That was how Vito saw it.
Back when that existence was merely a Divine Sovereign, he had already been capable of killing second-stage and fifth-stage Oracle-grade experts.
Now, he had destroyed Crown’s Summit with swift and decisive methods.
As long as someone with such potential and determination did not fall prematurely, his future accomplishments would inevitably be extraordinary.
Furthermore, according to the rumors, that expert did not yet have any Oracle-grade followers.
If Vito pledged himself now, he would become the first.
It was just like joining a mortal king before his empire began to rise—the earlier one pledged allegiance, the greater the future rewards.
Vito intended to become the first follower to attach himself to that rising sacred throne.
"I only managed to advance to Oracle-grade because I stumbled upon the inheritance of a powerful expert."
Vito repeatedly weighed the matter in his heart.
"My foundation is pitifully weak. Whether I can survive my next Holy Tribulation is already uncertain."
"Even with the title of Oracle-grade, it’s difficult for me to obtain any real benefits. I’m not even strong enough to enter a sanctum with ten-thousandfold time flow!"
"Among Oracle-grade experts, I stand at the very bottom. If I want to change my fate, I can only attach myself to a power."
He had already tried joining several major powers.
However, the internal struggles there were equally dangerous. Choosing the wrong side could result in being neglected at best or losing one’s life at worst.
"I’ve been free and undisciplined for too long. I can’t endure the restraints of a major power."
"Joining a smaller faction is the better choice. And what better option could there be than following that existence?"
The Endless Starsea valued potential above all else.
Although that expert was currently only a Divine Descendant, he possessed the potential to become a high-stage Oracle-grade expert—or even an Eternal Sage.
There was no shame in submitting to someone like that!
Vito thought far ahead.
Once he reached his decision, he immediately departed for the Flying Fish Plane.
There were quite a few Oracle-grade experts who shared his thoughts.
However, most of them were only at the first or second stage. There were no third-stage Oracle-grade experts among them.
Once someone reached the third stage of Oracle-grade, they were already a respected figure with considerable status.
They would not easily lower themselves and pledge allegiance to another.
Flying Fish Plane, inside the Sanctum of Triumph.
Daniel had not begun recruiting members on a large scale.
Only players were qualified to become official members of the Sanctum of Triumph.
The entire factional structure had been designed specifically for players.
Once a player reached the peak of quasi-sage, they would graduate from Triumph Academy and directly join the Sanctum of Triumph.
The system resembled the relationship between a football academy and its first-team club.
As for the Divine-grade experts, they could only be considered peripheral employees of the Sanctum of Triumph.
The time was not yet ripe.
Tens of millions of players were currently pioneering Daniel’s exclusive secret realm.
Furthermore, the order within the Flying Fish Star System had not yet collapsed.
There was no suitable battlefield for the players to display their abilities, so Daniel had no intention of releasing them for the time being.
At that moment, Pierce hurried over.
"My lord, several Oracle-grade experts have come to pledge allegiance!"
Daniel raised an eyebrow.
"Oracle-grade experts? Bring them in."
Pierce accepted the order and left.
Before long, he returned with several Oracle-grade experts.
"Greetings, my lord."
The Oracle-grade experts adopted extremely humble postures, taking the initiative to bow the moment they entered.
Daniel nodded and looked toward Pierce.
Pierce understood and began introducing them.

"This is Ian Hartmann, a native first-stage Oracle-grade expert of the Flying Fish Star System. He previously worked for Mistral Manor and has come to pledge allegiance because he greatly admires your achievements."

"This is Aldrich Winst, a second-stage Oracle-grade expert from the Highwater Star River. He has traveled throughout our Flamefire Star River for many years and was once a member of a major power in the Highwater Star River. He deliberately left his former master in order to pledge himself to you."

"This is Vito Orlando, a second-stage Oracle-grade expert from the Deep Shore Star River. He is a lone traveler who came here specifically after hearing that you had established a sanctum within the Flying Fish Plane."
After completing the introductions, Pierce tactfully stepped aside and closed his mouth.
As he introduced them, each of the Oracle-grade experts released a trace of their aura, allowing Daniel to clearly sense that their strength was genuine.
Daniel nodded.
Oracle-grade servants...
Back when the master of Starvault Sanctum had expounded upon the profound mysteries, both Divine-grade and Oracle-grade servants had busied themselves around him.
Even Jevan, that fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert, had possessed several Oracle-grade followers.
It was not unusual for Oracle-grade experts to serve as followers within the Endless Starsea.
There were only so many resources beneath this starry sky, and the competition for them was exceptionally brutal.
Although Oracle-grade experts gathered together for mutual protection, they still had to endure the suppression of the Greater Cosmic Will.
They might possess tremendous strength, but there were never enough resources to go around.
Ultimately, the Endless Starsea valued potential.
Yet living beings with genuine potential were exceedingly rare.
Such experts could enjoy preferential treatment and vast amounts of resources even before reaching Oracle-grade.
Daniel was the perfect example.
Once he became an Oracle-grade expert, the resources he received would unquestionably surpass those available to many ordinary Oracle-grade experts.
This was only natural.
Even those Oracle-grade experts themselves would have nothing to say about it.
Strength reigned supreme!
Therefore, ordinary Oracle-grade experts were placed in the most difficult position and had no choice but to find ways to survive.
One path was to become the follower of a high-stage Oracle-grade expert or an extraordinarily talented prodigy.
High-stage Oracle-grade experts stood far above others and naturally possessed the greatest amount of resources.
The master of Mistral Manor, for example, was a T7 Oracle-grade expert who could effortlessly claim the output of an entire star system.
As for monstrous prodigies, their present strength might still be insufficient, but given enough time, they would inevitably become high-stage Oracle-grade experts.
They could likewise provide resources to their followers.
Ultimately, everything came down to resources.
Even ordinary Oracle-grade experts within major powers would receive nothing unless they completed missions.
Holy Tribulations directly determined whether an Oracle-grade expert lived or died.
No Oracle-grade expert would dare hold anything back when preparing for one.
And the result of going all out was the complete exhaustion of everything they had accumulated.
Although Daniel did not fully understand every hidden rule involved, he could infer most of the situation.
"Do you sincerely submit to me?"
His voice was calm as he asked the question.
The three Oracle-grade experts answered in unison.
"We are willing to serve you, Master, and swear to follow you unto death!"

As he introduced them, each of the Oracle-grade experts released a trace of their aura, allowing Daniel to clearly sense that their strength was genuine.
Daniel nodded.
Oracle-grade servants...
Back when the master of Starvault Sanctum had expounded upon the profound mysteries, both Divine-grade and Oracle-grade servants had busied themselves around him.
Even Jevan, that fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert, had possessed several Oracle-grade followers.
It was not unusual for Oracle-grade experts to serve as followers within the Endless Starsea.
There were only so many resources beneath this starry sky, and the competition for them was exceptionally brutal.
Although Oracle-grade experts gathered together for mutual protection, they still had to endure the suppression of the Greater Cosmic Will.
They might possess tremendous strength, but there were never enough resources to go around.
Ultimately, the Endless Starsea valued potential.
Yet living beings with genuine potential were exceedingly rare.
Such experts could enjoy preferential treatment and vast amounts of resources even before reaching Oracle-grade.
Daniel was the perfect example.
Once he became an Oracle-grade expert, the resources he received would unquestionably surpass those available to many ordinary Oracle-grade experts.
This was only natural.
Even those Oracle-grade experts themselves would have nothing to say about it.
Strength reigned supreme!
Therefore, ordinary Oracle-grade experts were placed in the most difficult position and had no choice but to find ways to survive.
One path was to become the follower of a high-stage Oracle-grade expert or an extraordinarily talented prodigy.
High-stage Oracle-grade experts stood far above others and naturally possessed the greatest amount of resources.
The master of Mistral Manor, for example, was a T7 Oracle-grade expert who could effortlessly claim the output of an entire star system.
As for monstrous prodigies, their present strength might still be insufficient, but given enough time, they would inevitably become high-stage Oracle-grade experts.
They could likewise provide resources to their followers.
Ultimately, everything came down to resources.
Even ordinary Oracle-grade experts within major powers would receive nothing unless they completed missions.
Holy Tribulations directly determined whether an Oracle-grade expert lived or died.
No Oracle-grade expert would dare hold anything back when preparing for one.
And the result of going all out was the complete exhaustion of everything they had accumulated.
Although Daniel did not fully understand every hidden rule involved, he could infer most of the situation.
"Do you sincerely submit to me?"
His voice was calm as he asked the question.
The three Oracle-grade experts answered in unison.
"We are willing to serve you, Master, and swear to follow you unto death!"

chapters.title: Chapter 424 -424-Forefather Mistral Falls—Chaos Is About to Erupt
paragraphs: "Very well. I happen to be short of manpower at the moment. Since you’re willing to join me, you may stay."
Naturally, Daniel had no reason to reject the allegiance of several Oracle-grade experts.
As for how many resources they would consume, he did not care.
No matter how much they used, it would never catch up to the speed at which he acquired resources.
After all, he possessed the Millionfold Boost talent.
That kind of power simply defied all reason.
At that thought, Daniel suddenly remembered that there seemed to be an unspoken rule within the Endless Starsea.
Whenever an Oracle-grade expert chose to pledge allegiance, they could refuse to sign a life-and-death contract.
This custom had been established long ago, after a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert fell and the other Oracle-grade experts under his command refused to follow him into death.
After all, those Oracle-grade experts had joined him only for resources and opportunities to increase their strength.
There was no possibility that they would truly accompany a powerful master into the grave.
They might even turn around and pledge allegiance to a new master immediately after the old one died, willingly risking their lives and dying on the battlefield for the new master.
Even so, they retained control over their own lives. They would never willingly kill themselves merely because their former master had died.
Within the Endless Starsea, most Oracle-grade experts signed only ordinary retainer contracts that imposed little sense of permanent belonging.
Such contracts could ensure that they would not betray their master, but they could not force them to obey excessively harsh demands.
As long as they paid a certain price, they could terminate the contract and regain their freedom.
This was how most powers in the Endless Starsea recruited Oracle-grade experts.
After all, they needed Oracle-grade experts to guard their territories and fight their wars.
They did not need a group of slaves.
Naturally, Daniel had no intention of breaking this convention.
He waved his hand lightly.
"Very well. Sign the contracts."
He did not care whether they were willing to die alongside him.
"Thank you, my lord!"
The three Oracle-grade experts secretly breathed sighs of relief.
Pierce, who had been watching for some time, could not help but feel envious when he saw this scene.
Who would not want to become Daniel’s follower?
Unfortunately, he had yet to reach Oracle-grade. Even if he wanted to become one, he was not qualified.
"My lord’s momentum is at its peak. He has only just established his faction, yet three Oracle-grade experts have already joined him..."
Pierce thought silently.
"Once the master of Mistral Manor fails his advancement, my lord will be able to rise completely."
The destruction of Overlord Mountain had alarmed many powers throughout the starfield.
Unlike the Myriad Worlds Alliance, which still stood within the Myriad-Star Cosmos, the Flying Fish Star System possessed only one superpower—Mistral Manor.
The remaining factions were merely ordinary powers occupying their own corners of the star system.
Each ordinary power was guarded by an Oracle-grade expert, and they generally did not interfere with one another.
As for the medium-sized and minor powers, there were almost no rules governing them at all.
Countless supreme-grade and quasi-sage experts acted however they pleased within those territories, never worrying that an Oracle-grade expert might come looking for them.
The regions controlled by those smaller powers could not bear the descent of truly powerful Oracle-grade existences. Only the territories of major factions were capable of accommodating such experts.
Because of this, the supreme-grade and quasi-Divine-grade experts of this universe were far stronger than those of the same Rank in other universes.
These people felt almost no fear toward Oracle-grade experts.
However, there was one exception.
Faustus!
"Faustus is someone we absolutely cannot provoke."
Within a Stellar Plane of the Flying Fish Star System, a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert solemnly warned his subordinates, lingering fear still visible in his eyes.
He had heard of Daniel’s battle record and had long been extremely wary of him.
Because of this, he had even warned every Oracle-grade and Divine-grade expert within his faction that they were not permitted to harbor the slightest disrespectful thought toward Daniel.
After all, at their Rank, even a single thought could form causality.
And as the leader of those experts, the resulting causality would eventually be settled upon him.
Silvermoon Plane.
"Forefather Mistral is currently attempting his advancement. We must act cautiously!"
The fourth-stage Oracle-grade expert who ruled this place was equally wary of Daniel.
No matter how abundant the resources of the Flying Fish Plane were, he did not dare make a move against it.
The world was about to fall into chaos.
There was never any harm in being more cautious.
"That ruthless figure who emerged from the sacred ground has now occupied the Flying Fish Universe and destroyed Overlord Mountain."
Crimson Mist Universe.
Several Oracle-grade experts exchanged information with one another and concluded that their newly arrived "neighbor" would not be easy to deal with.
Since that was the case, they could only temporarily avoid his edge.
Because Daniel’s fearsome reputation had already spread far and wide, the disturbance caused by his occupation of the Flying Fish Universe soon died down.
However, an even greater period of chaos was about to begin.
Not long ago, rumors began spreading that Forefather Mistral had started his advancement and was preparing to face his Holy Tribulation!
No one knew where the Forefather was undergoing his advancement, but news would most likely emerge after some time.
At that moment, both the Flying Fish Universe and the Blooming Flower Universe were waiting for news of Forefather Mistral.
Daniel was waiting as well.
Several days later, Vito returned from gathering information.
"Master."
He first offered a respectful greeting.
"Speak."
Daniel waved his hand lightly.
"Master, according to the information your subordinate has gathered, Silvercrown Fortress of the Ancient God Universe is preparing to send two fifth-stage Oracle-grade experts to Mistral Manor."
Vito spoke in a solemn voice.
"I obtained this information through an informant I stationed in the Stellar Plane. He negotiated with one of the leading local powers."
"The leading faction of the Stellar Plane has already made contact with Silvercrown Fortress."
Daniel raised an eyebrow when he heard this.
He had heard a little about Silvercrown Fortress.
It was a top power of the Ancient God Universe and was guarded by a T7 Oracle-grade expert.
However, its overall foundation was lacking, so its ruler stood one level below Forefather Mistral.
Before Forefather Mistral began preparing for his advancement, Silvercrown Fortress had always been forced to avoid his territory.
Yet now, it was sending two fifth-stage Oracle-grade experts at once.
What that meant was self-evident.
Furthermore, the leading faction of the Stellar Plane had already begun making contact with them...
Daniel quickly reached a conclusion.
"I’m afraid Forefather Mistral has already failed his advancement and fallen completely."
Vito strongly agreed.
At the same time, he could not help but sigh inwardly.
A legendary overlord had fallen just like that.
That was a T7 Oracle-grade expert!
He had dominated the Flying Fish Universe for countless years, yet now he had simply died...
Daniel, however, felt nothing.
After all, he had personally seen that even Reo, a T9 Oracle-grade expert, had fallen beneath the tribulation of advancement.
The struggle for the Great Path never cared about one’s former glory!
"In that case, the T7 Oracle-grade expert of Silvercrown Fortress probably sensed Forefather Mistral’s death immediately."
Vito continued his analysis.
"That is why they sent two experts to establish contact at the earliest opportunity."
"It also explains why the Stellar Plane dared to meet with them."
Daniel nodded slightly.
"Silvercrown Fortress is located within the Ancient God Plane, not far from the Stellar Plane. Naturally, they would want to seize that region before anyone else."
"However..."
His eyes flickered.
"The other powers probably won’t allow Silvercrown Fortress to get its way."
Daniel issued his order.
"Go. Continue gathering information."

chapters.title: Chapter 425 -425-All Perish Before a Single Sword
paragraphs: "Yes, Master!"
Vito responded respectfully before swiftly withdrawing.
He had always held Daniel in the highest regard.
After all, this young man was extraordinarily generous with resources. Nearly every kind of cultivation resource was freely available to those under his command.
A superior like him was almost impossible to find anywhere in the Flying Fish Plane.
Vito could only consider himself fortunate to have encountered Daniel.
Watching Vito’s figure gradually disappear, Daniel’s gaze deepened.
"This region is about to descend into chaos. And when it does, that will be the perfect time for me to act."
He had long anticipated everything that was happening now.
Therefore, he felt no panic whatsoever.
The next moment, his figure flickered and entered a special space.
Many of his subordinates were already training there, awaiting his commands.
"Master, you’re here."
Camille appeared before him, his expression filled with excitement.
"Can we finally make our move?"
Daniel nodded slightly.
"That’s right. The time has come."

Now that he knew the T7 Oracle-grade expert of Mistral Manor had failed his advancement and fallen completely, while Silvercrown Fortress of the Ancient God Universe was preparing to invade, the entire region was certain to descend into chaos.
Naturally, Daniel intended to take action as well.
He would seize the entire starfield in one stroke!
With that thought, Daniel issued his orders.
"Camille, lead a portion of the academy’s forces directly toward the minor powers throughout this starfield."
"Eliminate every last one who resists. Leave none alive."
"I will send others to deal with the medium-sized powers."
"As for the major powers, do not provoke them for the time being."
"First, establish complete dominance over the minor and medium-sized factions."
"Understood!"
Camille immediately withdrew.
He had long since become familiar with the players within this space and understood their strength extremely well.
He even knew that the players possessed a "system."
Therefore, there was no one more suitable to lead them.
Furthermore, Daniel controlled the core of these players’ system.
Through that system core, he could issue all kinds of missions to them.
He could even replace the rewards and punishments within those missions!
Therefore, although the players possessed the ability to revive, they were still ultimately restricted by Daniel.
However, as long as they did not make any serious mistakes, Daniel was willing to grant them the opportunity to revive indefinitely.
Because of this, the players had long since become utterly loyal to him.
They also had no fear of dying permanently.
After all, Daniel would always grant them another chance to return.
In exchange, a portion of every resource they obtained from killing monsters would be handed over to Daniel.
Camille looked down at the players below, his heart surging with excitement.
During this period, he had led these extraordinary individuals in using their overwhelming numerical advantage to kill one quasi-Divine-grade creature after another.
In his eyes, these special beings were just like his master.
They had no fear of death.
They were simply not as powerful as Daniel.
Now that his master had ordered him to lead these people into war, he would naturally obey.
With such a force, it would not be long before the entire starfield belonged to them!
"The Flying Fish Starfield shall belong to us!"
Celestial River Universe.
It was one of the more powerful regions within the Flying Fish Starfield.
The entire universe had always been controlled by its native Divine-grade experts.
Due to the restrictions imposed by the universe itself, they feared no Oracle-grade expert.
That was because Oracle-grade experts below T6 could not enter this region at all.
But today—
They encountered an extraordinarily powerful and unusual enemy!
Bzzzt! Bzzzt! Bzzzt!
Wormholes opened one after another.
Under Camille’s command, countless players surged out like a raging tide.
The disturbance caused by their combined auras quickly alarmed the experts of the Celestial River Universe.
When they saw Camille, who radiated a Divine Radiant aura, leading what seemed to be an endless army of players into their territory, their expressions immediately turned grim.
"Invaders!"
A furious roar suddenly rang out.
A Divine Radiant figure charged out from the Celestial River faction.
He glared at Camille with rage burning in his eyes.
"You are not welcome here! Get out immediately!"
The next moment, deafening cries erupted from the Celestial River forces below.
"Get out!"
"You are not welcome here!"
"Remain any longer and you will be killed without mercy!"
However, Camille remained completely unmoved.
He smiled as he stared at them, having already seen through the fear hidden within their hearts.
In his eyes, these people had already been marked for death.
Their current behavior was nothing more than the desperate barking of doomed beasts.
It was not worth taking seriously.
At that moment, a low hum sounded.
The players had finished establishing their revival points and portals.
Camille immediately raised his hand.
"Now, I will give you two choices."
"First, surrender."
"Second, die!"
The Celestial River faction instantly erupted.
"We will never surrender!"
"Kill us all if you have the ability!"
"You think you’re worthy?!"
Their cries of resistance were all the same and held no interest whatsoever.
The players sneered one after another, some impatiently rolling their shoulders and cracking their necks.
Back in the Myriad-Star Cosmos, they had already destroyed every minor and medium-sized plane within the Azure Lotus Starfield.
The Celestial River Universe was hardly worth mentioning by comparison.
Seeing their response, Camille no longer hesitated.
He decisively unfolded his sage rank!
Rumble!
With a thunderous roar, the enormous sage rank instantly spread across the region.
The expression of the Divine Radiant expert on the opposing side changed drastically, and he immediately released his own sage rank to resist.
Behind him, thousands of smaller sage ranks lit up one after another.
However—
"No one can withstand this sword."
Camille murmured softly.
The next moment, a sword appeared in his hand.
As a master of the sword path, he did not even need to swing it.
The blade suddenly lit up.
Its radiance descended through his sage rank, transforming into a sword light that covered the entire territory!
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The sword light howled across the battlefield.
Every being caught within it was slain without exception.
The so-called Divine-grade experts fell in rows like wheat beneath a scythe.
Camille’s mastery of the sword path had long since allowed him to crush all opponents at the same Rank.
Furthermore, the amplification provided by his sword was extraordinarily powerful.
Even compared with James and Mosi, Camille was not inferior in the slightest.
And what kind of existences were those two?
They were peerless prodigies!
The fact that Camille could stand alongside them proved that his strength was anything but weak.
These Divine-grade enemies could not withstand even a single blow.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The sword light swept across the battlefield, killing hundreds of Divine-grade experts on the spot.
But this was still far from its limit.
"Sword Domain—Unfold!"
Camille finally swung his sword.
A sword light of unbearable brilliance instantly slashed outward.
In the blink of an eye, the bodies of every Divine-grade enemy were annihilated beneath its radiance.
After a single sword strike, not one Divine-grade expert remained before him.
Camille sheathed his sword and waved toward the players beside him.
"Hansen, the rest is up to you."
Hansen was one of his most capable subordinates.
He was also among the strongest players in this army.
Upon hearing Camille’s command, Hansen immediately thumped his chest and declared confidently,
"Leave it to us, Lord Camille!"
"With the combat power and revival abilities of us players, a minor place like this is nothing."
"Three days!"
"Within three days, we will take this entire universe!"

Camille’s mastery of the sword path had long since allowed him to crush all opponents at the same Rank.
Furthermore, the amplification provided by his sword was extraordinarily powerful.
Even compared with James and Mosi, Camille was not inferior in the slightest.
And what kind of existences were those two?
They were peerless prodigies!
The fact that Camille could stand alongside them proved that his strength was anything but weak.
These Divine-grade enemies could not withstand even a single blow.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
The sword light swept across the battlefield, killing hundreds of Divine-grade experts on the spot.
But this was still far from its limit.
"Sword Domain—Unfold!"
Camille finally swung his sword.
A sword light of unbearable brilliance instantly slashed outward.
In the blink of an eye, the bodies of every Divine-grade enemy were annihilated beneath its radiance.
After a single sword strike, not one Divine-grade expert remained before him.
Camille sheathed his sword and waved toward the players beside him.
"Hansen, the rest is up to you."
Hansen was one of his most capable subordinates.
He was also among the strongest players in this army.
Upon hearing Camille’s command, Hansen immediately thumped his chest and declared confidently,
"Leave it to us, Lord Camille!"
"With the combat power and revival abilities of us players, a minor place like this is nothing."
"Three days!"
"Within three days, we will take this entire universe!"

chapters.title: Chapter 426 -426-When the Players March, Nothing Remains
paragraphs: Thanks to the experience they had gained in the Myriad-Star Cosmos, the players already knew exactly how to conquer an entire starfield.
To them, the only real threats within the Celestial River Universe were its Divine-grade experts.
However, Camille had already eliminated every visible threat for them.
Even if some hidden Divine-grade expert emerged later, they would be erased by the sword light Camille had left behind at the cosmic level.
Therefore, bringing the entire Celestial River Universe under their control was merely a matter of time.
Camille watched the players charge toward the Celestial River forces, the corner of his mouth curving upward.
To be safe, he decided to make one more preparation.
He raised his hand and waved.
The next moment, an extremely powerful sword aura descended.
A terrifying sword presence now permeated the entire universe.
Should any hidden Divine-grade expert reveal themselves, the sword aura would immediately lock onto them and kill them instantly!
After all, this sword aura was one of the earliest techniques Camille had comprehended and contained nearly half the strength of his true body.
With Camille’s mastery of the sword path, even half his power was enough to instantly kill any Divine-grade expert.
Only after completing this arrangement did Camille feel reassured.
Buzz!
He directly tore open a spatial rift and departed for another universe to eliminate its Divine-grade experts.
This time, Faustus had deployed tens of millions of players at once, launching simultaneous expeditions into dozens of universes and planes.
The Divine-grade experts within those regions all had to be cleared out personally by Camille.
It sounded like an enormous workload, but in reality, not every Divine-grade expert would resist to the bitter end like those of the Celestial River Universe.
Most Divine-grade experts feared death.
Once they witnessed Camille’s overwhelming Strength, they would choose to surrender.
In the face of absolute power, no fool would reject the chance to submit and survive.
Celestial River Universe.
After Camille left, Hansen immediately put the prepared conquest plan into action.
"Split into three armies!"
"Kill!"
The vast player army immediately poured into the Celestial River Universe!
Deep within the Celestial River Universe.
The Danube Kingdom.
As the central empire of the Celestial River Universe, the Danube Kingdom was ruled by King Asura.
At this moment, however, Asura was not seated upon his throne.
He had personally led his army onto the battlefield and was fighting desperately against the player forces that had appeared without warning.
"Die!"
Asura abruptly raised his hand.
The next moment, an imperial seal appeared in his palm!
He tossed it into the air, and the seal rapidly expanded.
Within only a few breaths, it had grown to span tens of thousands of miles.
Terrifying pressure poured downward, threatening to crush every foreign enemy below.
But at that moment—
A deathly pale sword light emerged from beyond the battlefield.
It was faster than the imperial seal!
And stronger!
The sword light instantly pierced through the seal and shattered it into pieces.
Without losing any momentum, it continued forward and penetrated Asura’s chest.
Terrifying sword aura tore apart all vitality within his body.
His figure instantly disintegrated into a cloud of blood mist.
Everyone from the Danube Kingdom who witnessed the scene was horrified.
It felt as though the heavens had collapsed above them.
"The King..."
"The King is dead!"
"It’s over!"
Panic immediately swept through the Danube Kingdom’s army.
Nearly every soldier lost their composure, no longer knowing what to do.
Seeing this, Hansen’s eyes lit up.
"The opportunity is here!"
He immediately gave the order.
"Charge straight into their formation! Break them apart!"
Countless players surged forward.
In an instant, they smashed through the Danube Kingdom’s military formation.
The Danube Kingdom could no longer offer any effective resistance.
Its forces were scattered in every direction, and signs of total collapse appeared across the battlefield.
Facing an endless army of players who did not even fear death, they were forced to retreat again and again.
No matter how many soldiers the Danube Kingdom possessed, they could never defeat the players.
After all, the players carried revival points with them wherever they went!
"We’ve completely lost!"
The generals of the Danube Kingdom fell into despair.
They discarded their armor and weapons and swiftly fled the battlefield.
Once the generals ran, the soldiers lost whatever desire to fight they had left.
Their morale had already been unstable. Now, they had lost all courage to continue resisting.
The fact that they had lasted this long was already a miracle.
Whether in strength, morale, or equipment, the players completely surpassed the armies of the Danube Kingdom.
At this point, there was no possibility of victory.
Their only option was to flee for their lives.
"Kill!"
"Hahaha! Don’t run!"
Seeing the Danube Kingdom’s army collapse completely, the players became incredibly excited.
They transformed the battlefield into a hunting ground and began slaughtering the enemy forces without restraint.
Those soldiers became experience, equipment, and various items for the players!
The battle ended soon afterward.
Hansen led the players back in triumph.
They had taken complete control of the central region of the Celestial River Universe.
However, he had no intention of stopping.
He immediately redirected the army toward the western territories and continued the conquest.
The player forces fought and plundered along the way, while an endless stream of resources was handed over to Daniel.
Sun Erosion Plane.
A fierce battle was still underway.
The player army and the native coalition had confronted each other for a long time, with neither side able to gain a decisive advantage.
"Kill!"
Severn suddenly roared.
The player army below immediately changed formation.
They brought out a domain-grade treasure, summoning the magnificent figure of a Divine-grade expert.
The Divine-grade figure immediately struck out with a palm.
The next moment, a Divine-grade figure also appeared within the forces of the Sun Erosion Plane.
"Heh. Do you truly believe the Sun Erosion Plane has no one capable of stopping you?"
The Divine-grade expert was just about to attack when he discovered in horror that he could no longer move.
Only then did he realize how vast the gap between himself and the opposing figure truly was.
He did not even have the opportunity to resist before he was instantly killed!
With no Divine-grade expert left to block it, the enormous palm continued toward the coalition army.
The Sun Erosion forces had originally been brimming with confidence, believing their own Divine-grade expert to be invincible.
But then they watched that very expert get killed in an instant!
Their morale descended into chaos.
The senior commanders were the first to realize that disaster was imminent.
They immediately left clones behind and decisively fled.
Once the high-ranking commanders escaped, it triggered a chain reaction.
Many of the Sun Erosion Plane’s leaders quickly discovered what had happened.
They were both shocked and furious.
They had never expected an army they had nurtured for so long to be so utterly unreliable.
But after the anger came fear.
Watching the players’ relentless offensive, they immediately made their decision.
"We cannot defeat them!"
"At this point, our only choices are surrender or escape!"
After hurriedly leaving behind orders to withdraw, they either surrendered or fled.
The clones left behind by the senior commanders soon collapsed and were discovered by the soldiers of the Sun Erosion coalition.
The moment the soldiers realized the truth, their morale shattered completely.
They lost all will to resist.
Within only a few minutes, the entire Sun Erosion coalition learned that their commanding officers had abandoned them.
Their defensive lines collapsed entirely, leaving them helpless before the slaughter of the player army.
However, Severn had already predicted this outcome perfectly.
After all, the players were not merely fearless and equipped with superior gear.
They also possessed Faustus’s support.
The Divine-grade figure summoned just now had been a clone left behind by Faustus!
The instant it attacked, it had crushed everyone on the battlefield.
"Heh."
"Those who oppose us have only one path—death!"
Severn sneered.

chapters.title: Chapter 427 -427-Preparing to Declare War
paragraphs: "Kill them all. Leave no survivors."
Severn spoke coldly.
As one of the top players who had followed Daniel for many years, Severn had received an enormous amount of resources from him.
He had always enjoyed access to the finest leveling resources, equipment, and cultivation materials.
As a result, whether in Rank, personal combat power, skills, or equipment, Severn stood among the very best of the entire player population.
And there were many others like him among the players.
Edmund and Lydia, for example.
They had long since become leaders of their respective player factions, each capable of commanding a player army to conquer an entire universe!
At this moment, the player armies throughout the various universes were frantically harvesting the lives and resources of the local coalitions.
One cosmic army after another fell or surrendered.
There was simply no one capable of preventing them from plundering resources!
At the same time.
Flying Fish Universe, above the Stellar Plane.
Daniel set down the report in his hand and placed it atop the stack of documents on the desk.
One system notification after another rang in his ears.
[Ding! Millionfold Boost triggered!]
[You have obtained 10 million units of Domain Origin Crystal!]
[You have obtained 10,381 Sacred Land fragments!]
[You have obtained 2.02083 billion tons of specialty resources from various universes!]
At this point, even Daniel no longer knew how many resources were stored in his warehouses.

The resources the player armies had plundered for him during this period alone were enough for him to casually exchange for hundreds of billions—or even trillions—of points from the Golden Holy Mountain.
To Daniel, resources had already become nothing more than numbers.
It did not matter how much he consumed.
His player armies could earn it all back for him within minutes anyway.
"Master!"
At that moment, Vito suddenly appeared before him.
Daniel immediately looked up.
"You have news?"
Vito nodded and began reporting the intelligence he had just gathered.
"Master, according to the information I have collected, Mistral Manor has rejected Silvercrown Fortress’s request for a visit."
"The Oracle-grade experts there were originally Forefather Mistral’s contracted servants."
"Among them are one fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert, three fourth-stage Oracle-grade experts, and more than ten low-stage Oracle-grade experts."
"Logically speaking, after the Forefather’s death, they should have begun pledging allegiance to new powers one after another."
"However, they have instead chosen to band together and collectively reject the olive branch extended by Silvercrown Fortress."
At this point, Vito’s expression became somewhat strange.
"Furthermore, it is said that Mistral Manor is preparing to send Oracle-grade delegations to visit the various major powers."
"Heh."
Hearing this, Daniel could not help but laugh.
Given Mistral Manor’s current situation, they still dared reject Silvercrown Fortress, which was guarded by a T7 Oracle-grade expert?
They truly did not know whether they lived or died!
Did they still believe themselves to be the superpower they once were, capable of sitting comfortably while others fought around them?
Still, many superpowers were indeed interested in annexing Mistral Manor.
If several of them extended olive branches at the same time, Mistral Manor might truly be able to sell itself for an excellent price.
With that thought, Daniel issued an order.
"Send people into Mistral Manor to investigate immediately."
"Remember—do not conceal yourselves. Enter openly and conduct your investigation in broad daylight!"
"Uh... understood, Master."
Although Vito did not understand the purpose behind the order, he still bowed and accepted it.
A cold smile appeared on Daniel’s face.
"A mere Mistral Manor dares put on airs."
"In my opinion, it would be better for us to take their seat instead!"
"In the future, our faction will undoubtedly dominate the entire Flying Fish Universe."
"War with them is only a matter of time. Displaying some strength now will bring us nothing but benefits!"
Realization dawned on Vito.
"Master is wise!"
Daniel waved his hand.
"Go. For the time being, you will receive any outsiders who come to visit."
"Also, summon Ian and Aldrich to see me."
Not long afterward, Ian and Aldrich arrived in response to his summons.
"Greetings, Master!"
After offering their respects, the two stood to one side and waited for Daniel’s instructions.
Daniel’s gaze swept over them as he asked in a solemn voice,
"You two have enjoyed a great many resources during this period."
"Next, I intend to launch a war that will sweep across the entire star system."
"Are you prepared to accompany me into battle?"
Ian and Aldrich exchanged a glance.
Then, both men dropped to one knee at the same time.
"We are willing to follow Master into battle!"
Neither of them showed the slightest fear.
They understood that with Daniel’s strength, there was almost no possibility of defeat.
Furthermore, this was the perfect opportunity to demonstrate their loyalty.
If they showed even the slightest cowardice, Daniel might eliminate them from his inner circle, leaving them as insignificant peripheral figures in the future.
Neither of them wanted to fall into such a position.
Under Daniel, they could obtain enormous quantities of resources every day—resources they would never even have dared dream of possessing before.
Their strength had been advancing at an astonishing speed!
Now that their master required them to prove their usefulness, it was only natural that they step forward.
Daniel ordered,
"Go. Gather your subordinates."
"We are going to declare war on every major power!"
The two men’s hearts trembled.
They had never expected their master to be so aggressive that he would immediately declare war on every major faction!
They quickly accepted the order and withdrew.
After the two departed, Daniel’s eyes flickered as he muttered inwardly,
"Judging by the time, the player armies should already have killed the coalition forces of numerous universes."
"Their overall strength should have increased considerably."
"Once this campaign is completely concluded, the mission objective should also be fulfilled."
As long as ten million players reached quasi-Divine-grade, he would complete the mission.
After that, he could continue sending them into the various planes of the Flying Fish Universe.
They would not stop until they had completely replaced Mistral Manor!
Once that happened, he would obtain the clue he sought.
At that thought, Daniel’s gaze grew intense.
"Time waits for no one. I must complete the mission immediately."
"After all, the forbidden land Chanelle mentioned will open before long!"
Flying Fish Star System.
Several commercial starships that had departed from the Stellar Starfield had barely left its territory when another fleet intercepted them.
Even after they displayed the banner of the Stellar Starfield, the opposing fleet showed no intention of withdrawing.
Seeing this, the person in charge of the commercial ships narrowed his eyes.
"What’s going on?"
"We’ve only just left the jurisdiction of the Stellar Starfield, and we’ve already encountered cosmic pirates?"
He keenly sensed that something was wrong and immediately gave the order.
"Turn around at full speed! Return immediately!"
As long as they returned to the territory of the Stellar Starfield, they would be safe.
This journey was meant to earn money.
If they were robbed before they had even properly set out, their merchant association would probably become a laughingstock.
Just as the starships were about to turn around—
Suddenly—
Boom!
A domineering figure appeared before them.
It was Vito!
He sneered.
"Trying to run already?"
The next moment, a Divine-grade treasure appeared in his hand.
The treasure resembled a thin sheet of paper and rapidly expanded, covering the commercial starships.
Before long, all of the ships were drawn inside it and completely trapped, unable to escape.
"Mission accomplished."
After dealing with them, Vito’s figure flickered and vanished from the spot.

The treasure resembled a thin sheet of paper and rapidly expanded, covering the commercial starships.
Before long, all of the ships were drawn inside it and completely trapped, unable to escape.
"Mission accomplished."
After dealing with them, Vito’s figure flickered and vanished from the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 428 -428-Overrunning the Stellar Starfield
paragraphs: Stellar Starfield, Odin Vein.
As the largest mining region within the Stellar Starfield, the ores excavated from this vein were extraordinarily valuable.
Across the entire universe, its value was second only to the flying fish industry.
Naturally, the true controller of this mineral vein was the leading power—Mistral Manor.
Ordinary factions were not even qualified to set foot within the Odin Vein.
Swish!
Two figures suddenly appeared, bringing the Odin Vein a pair of visitors whose hostility was unmistakable.
They were none other than Ian and Aldrich.
After receiving Daniel’s orders, they had rushed here immediately.
The moment they arrived, they stood above the void of the mineral vein and released their Covenanter auras without restraint.
Because they made no attempt to conceal themselves, the two Covenanter auras instantly descended from the heavens, their terrifying pressure covering almost the entire sky.
The moment the miners and Mistral Manor experts stationed within the vein sensed those horrifying auras, their hearts trembled.
"Enemies?"
The Covenanter guarding this place was named Sebastian.
He looked up in alarm. When he saw the two figures, shock and confusion appeared on his face.
The Stellar Starfield was still standing.
How could two unfamiliar Covenanters dare openly invade this place?
With a thought, Sebastian tore through the void and shot into the sky.
His calm gaze swept across the two figures opposite him.
His expression darkened, and his tone was distinctly hostile.
"Gentlemen, are you unaware that this mineral vein belongs to the Stellar Starfield?"
"This place is not open to outsiders. I assume the two of you must have taken a wrong turn."
At a glance, he could tell that these two Oracle-grade experts were only at the first and second stages.
Sebastian was confident that he could crush opponents of their level with ease.
Hearing this, Aldrich sneered.
"No. We haven’t taken a wrong turn."
"We came specifically for you."
The next moment, he turned his palm over, revealing a treasure.
Without the slightest hesitation, the treasure transformed into a streak of light and shot directly toward Sebastian.
Sebastian was startled when he realized that it was a Primordial Law-grade treasure.
It resembled an enormous ruler whose entire surface shimmered with flowing light.
Although Sebastian was surprised, he did not panic in the slightest.
He immediately struck his own chest, activating the sacred law scripture within his body.
Sebastian slowly raised a finger.
Specks of golden light appeared at its tip and spread across the entire finger within seconds.
The next moment, that finger expanded violently, growing until it covered the entire sky and reached a terrifying length of a million meters.
The vault of heaven was pierced apart by the colossal finger.
Sebastian swept it forward, smashing it directly against the approaching Primordial Law-grade treasure.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
One deafening explosion followed another.
The ruler-shaped Primordial Law-grade treasure was forcibly knocked away by the enormous golden finger.
It was blasted toward the horizon, crashing through several mineral ridges before finally falling to the ground.
Sebastian sneered.
"It seems your treasure is nothing impressive."
"Now, take a look at mine."
He waved his hand.
An enormous puppet immediately appeared within the void.
Dense murderous energy poured from the puppet’s body, making it resemble an ancient beast awakening from a long slumber.
The pressure radiating from it surged outward like a vast tsunami.
The moment it appeared, it released an aura no weaker than that of a third-stage Oracle-grade expert.
In other words, Sebastian alone was capable of contending against two third-stage Oracle-grade experts.
Ian’s pupils contracted when he saw this.
He immediately spoke in a rapid voice.
"We should use the trump card Master specifically gave us before we departed."
As soon as he finished speaking, a black pill appeared in his hand.
This was the Oracle-grade treasure Daniel had personally entrusted to him before the mission.
It could cause any Oracle-grade expert below the fifth stage to instantly lose ninety percent of their strength.
It could only be described as a poison specifically designed for Oracle-grade experts.
Ian flicked his finger.
The pill shot forward at tremendous speed.
While spinning rapidly, it dissolved midway through its flight, transforming into a layer of black mist that covered an area spanning millions of miles.
The mist precisely enveloped Sebastian and his puppet.
The instant Sebastian came into contact with it, he felt his Strength being rapidly dissolved by the strange black fog.
"Damn it! This is a poisonous mist specifically targeting Oracle-grade experts!"
He could feel his strength plummeting.
Even his puppet was affected.
As the dark mist continued to erode them, the power of both Sebastian and the puppet was drastically reduced.
Ian and Aldrich exchanged a glance.
Both immediately activated the Divine-grade treasures they carried, along with their terrifying laws.
Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!
A tsunami of destructive attacks poured madly into the black mist.
They launched an indiscriminate bombardment across the entire area.
Once everything finally fell silent, the black fog gradually dispersed.
Sebastian’s corpse was revealed, as weak and lifeless as a candle extinguished by the wind.
His puppet had disappeared without a trace.
Aldrich shrugged, looking completely relaxed.
"It appears our mission is complete."
"We should take the corpse as well. It may still be useful to Master."
As he finished speaking, he raised his hand.
Sebastian’s corpse immediately vanished from where it lay.
Ian turned his gaze toward the mineral vein below.
"I’ll take control of all the operations here."
Although the two of them were not particularly powerful on their own, they had received Oracle-grade treasures bestowed by Daniel.
Even when facing two Covenanter enemies one minor stage above them, they had nothing to fear.
This was the kind of enhancement Daniel could provide to those who followed him!
At the same time, on the opposite side of the Stellar Starfield.
An abnormal disturbance appeared within the planetary protection array of the Stellar Throne.
Its outer edges trembled continuously like ripples spreading across the surface of water.
Boom!
Following a deafening explosion, the array—which was powerful enough to withstand a high-stage Oracle-grade expert—was forcibly blasted open.
Amid the clouds of white smoke, a familiar figure appeared.
It was Daniel.
He had personally descended upon this place.
Expressionless, he advanced step by step, breaking through every obstacle before him and forcibly entering the territory of the Stellar Throne.
The next moment, countless experts cultivating in seclusion deep within the Stellar Throne sensed that the array had been destroyed.
They immediately transformed into streaks of light and revealed themselves.
Daniel’s expression remained indifferent as information regarding the Stellar Throne surfaced within his mind.
"The Stellar Throne..."
"If I remember correctly, it was established by the native Covenanters of the Stellar Starfield."
"The strongest among them is Forefather Stellar, a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert. There are also numerous fourth-stage and third-stage Oracle-grade experts."
"In addition, they possess no shortage of Divine-grade experts, while their supreme-grade experts are practically countless."
"In that regard, they are different from Crown’s Summit of the Flying Fish Universe, which controlled only a single plane."
"There are also many medium-sized and minor powers throughout the Stellar Starfield."
"All of them are governed by the Stellar Throne."
"From this alone, it is clear that the Stellar Throne was able to dominate an entire region because its internal forces are remarkably united."

chapters.title: Chapter 429 -429-The Sacred Bow’s Instant Kill
paragraphs: While Daniel was still lost in thought, he had already unknowingly ventured deep into the Stellar Throne.
At this moment, countless experts who had been cultivating in seclusion had already emerged. They stood throughout the void, forming a vast and imposing formation.
Some of the Divine-grade experts had even linked their powers together in advance, constructing enormous battle arrays.
The man standing at the very front was none other than the long-secluded master of the Stellar Throne.
Behind him stood dozens of Oracle-grade experts.
"Forefather, an enemy must have invaded our starfield!"
An Oracle-grade expert beside him spoke with both shock and fury.
The master of the Stellar Throne cast him a cold glance.
"Do you take me for a blind man? I can already sense that our visitor has come with hostile intentions."
The Oracle-grade expert smiled awkwardly.
"Forefather, what kind of enemy could possibly break through the defensive array of our Stellar Throne?"
The master of the Stellar Throne pondered briefly.
"There is only one."
The other Oracle-grade experts froze upon hearing this.
What did he mean by only one?
The master of the Stellar Throne explained calmly,
"He dared invade us alone and was even able to break through our array with ease."
"That can only mean one thing—he possesses an extraordinary number of trump cards and does not fear us in the slightest!"
Everyone fell silent.
They had never imagined that a single person had been responsible for destroying their defensive formation.
The master of the Stellar Throne continued,
"Wait for my orders. You will attack only when I command you to."
"Under no circumstances are you to act on your own."
He possessed a wealth of experience and would never underestimate an opponent simply because that opponent had come alone.
He had seen far too many people who believed themselves powerful, only to fall before enemies who appeared weaker than them.
He would not repeat their mistakes.
Just as the master of the Stellar Throne was contemplating his next move, a familiar figure appeared on the distant horizon.
It was Daniel.
He seemed to approach at an unhurried pace, yet his speed was astonishing as he advanced directly toward the gathered experts.
"Could that be the intruder?"
The moment the master of the Stellar Throne saw the figure, his heart skipped a beat.
There was something strangely familiar about him.
After observing for several moments, he finally recognized the approaching figure.
"Daniel?!"
The master of the Stellar Throne was overwhelmed with shock.
He had never forgotten Daniel’s terrifying achievements.
Back when that ruthless figure was still only at Divine-grade, he had already crossed Ranks and single-handedly slain the Oracle-grade expert Logan!
"Damn it! Why has he appeared in the Stellar Starfield?"
The master of the Stellar Throne’s expression changed drastically.
He immediately swung his arm and roared,
"Everyone, attack!"
His courage had already been completely shattered.
Without hesitation, he ordered every expert present to surround and kill Daniel.
His subordinates, who had never personally witnessed Daniel’s ruthlessness, had no idea why their Forefather was so frightened.
The moment they heard his command, they charged forward together.
In an instant, countless streaks of light appeared throughout the void.
They were formed from all manner of law-based Sacred Arts and Divine-grade treasures, all surging toward Daniel.
The thickest and most powerful streak of light was the attack unleashed by the master of the Stellar Throne himself.
That single strike was likely powerful enough to annihilate most of the minor and medium-sized factions within the Stellar Star System.
Yet Daniel’s expression did not change in the slightest.
He merely smiled and raised one hand.
The next moment, a barrier of light appeared around his body, completely shielding him.
The barrier looked so thin that it was almost invisible, resembling a transparent film.
Yet at this moment, it became the most terrifying defense imaginable.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The countless attacks struck the barrier surrounding Daniel.
They failed to move his true body even by half a step.
This was the power of an Oracle-grade treasure!
Moreover, it was a T7 Oracle-grade treasure!
Daniel had plundered vast quantities of resources and exchanged for countless Oracle-grade treasures.
Once a T7 defensive treasure like this was activated, even an assault more than ten times stronger than the one before him would be incapable of harming him.
"What a laughable bunch."
When the dazzling light of the attacks finally dispersed, Daniel’s completely unharmed figure was revealed.
Everyone’s face turned deathly pale.
They finally understood why the master of the Stellar Throne had been so afraid.
Even an attack of that magnitude had failed to injure Daniel.
Just what kind of monstrous defense was this?
At that moment, Daniel spoke calmly.
"If that was the limit of your abilities, then it is my turn."
A completely new Oracle-grade treasure appeared in his hand.
With a thought, the treasure transformed into the shape of a bow.
It was a T6 Oracle-grade treasure.
However, its quality far surpassed that of ordinary T6 Oracle-grade treasures.
In terms of value, it was nearly comparable to a T7 treasure.
Yet Daniel displayed no reluctance whatsoever when using it.
He handled it as casually as though it were an ordinary bow.
He slowly drew the bowstring.
Arrows began condensing out of thin air upon the sacred bow.
When he released the string—
Swish! Swish! Swish!
Although only a single arrow had been formed, the moment it was fired, it split into countless streaks of arrow light.
The entire sky was filled with their afterimages.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The instant the arrow lights reached the experts of the Stellar Throne, their bodies burst apart like fireworks.
Divine-grade, Oracle-grade, or supreme-grade—it made no difference before the storm of arrows.
The moment their bodies came into contact with the arrow lights, they were pierced through and erased.
Even more terrifyingly, the arrows continued surging forward as though they were inexhaustible!
Even the Forefather of the Stellar Throne was forcibly wounded by the arrow storm.
Each arrow carried a terrifying layer of the Law of Causality.
Combined with their endless numbers, there was nowhere for him to evade.
The arrows were also infused with the Law of Destruction, making their killing power even more horrifying.
No one knew what kind of T6 Oracle-grade expert could have forged such a terrifying treasure.
The master of the Stellar Throne could only endure the arrow tide head-on, desperately waiting for the treasure’s energy to be exhausted.
What he did not know was that the reason this T6 treasure could be compared to a T7 treasure lay precisely in its core ability—
Its energy was inexhaustible.
Several minutes passed.
Every structure of the Stellar Throne behind him had already been razed to the ground.
His Oracle-grade and Divine-grade subordinates had long since been reduced to nothingness.
Yet the number of arrows showed no sign of decreasing.
"As expected of the All-Heavens Reincarnation Annihilation Bow."
Daniel looked at the sacred bow, which continued releasing arrow lights automatically, and smiled.
He had previously spent one billion Golden Holy Mountain points to exchange for it.
Judging from its performance now, those points had been well spent.
Feeling that the time was right, Daniel raised his hand and recalled the sacred bow.
The endless arrow lights vanished with it.
Only a single figure remained within the ruins of the Stellar Throne.
It was the master of the Stellar Throne.
He had already been gravely wounded and was barely clinging to life.
His eyes had long since been destroyed.
The moment he sensed that Daniel had stopped attacking, he hurriedly shouted in a hoarse voice,
"Stop! Please, stop!"
"Spare my life!"
"I am willing to become your slave and sign a master-servant contract with you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 430 -430-The Manor Falls Silent
paragraphs: "I have no need for you."
Daniel rejected him without even sparing him another glance.
He was merely a fifth-stage Oracle-grade combatant. Even if he were one stage stronger, he would still be of little use to Daniel.
What mattered most to Daniel was ensuring that the Stellar Throne ceased to exist.
Besides, weeds had to be pulled out by the roots.
As the master of the Stellar Throne, only his death could truly put Daniel at ease.
With a thought—
The sacred bow suddenly erupted with a terrifying arrow light.
The master of the Stellar Throne’s face turned deathly pale. Before he could even attempt to resist, the arrow light struck him and annihilated him completely.
From this moment onward, not a single living being remained within the Stellar Throne.
Daniel lowered his gaze toward the countless severed limbs and corpses below.
With a thought, he descended onto a relatively intact altar of the Stellar Throne.
He raised one hand slightly, collecting every Oracle-grade corpse scattered throughout the ruins.
Before coming here, he had already learned that the bodies of Oracle-grade experts possessed many valuable uses.
After all, an Oracle-grade expert possessed enough Strength to create an independent secret realm.
Even after death, the energy hidden within their body was still comparable to the combined energy of an entire star system.
Even if the physical body had been badly damaged, as long as fragments of the Origin and Divine Soul remained, replenishing the Origin could rapidly restore the corpse to its peak combat strength.
Alternatively, the corpse could be buried directly within the earth, transforming an entire secret realm into fertile land.
Such land could be used specifically to cultivate various Origin-grade medicinal herbs.
This was how the major top powers normally handled the bodies of their fallen Oracle-grade experts.
After Daniel collected all the Oracle-grade corpses, a series of system notifications immediately rang in his ears.
[Ding! Congratulations, Player. You have slain a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert...]
Daniel could not even be bothered to listen.
His figure flickered, and he descended into the depths of the earth.
Although all the structures on the surface had been destroyed, the underground treasury of the Stellar Throne remained relatively intact.
The treasury had been the strongest structure within the entire faction. It was also hidden deep underground, so the various treasures stored inside had survived without damage.
The moment Daniel entered, he was greeted by the radiance of countless Origin Crystals, Oracle-grade treasures, forging materials, and other rare items.
In the past, Daniel would certainly have been overjoyed and pounced upon them like a starving wolf spotting fresh meat.
But his standards had risen far too much.
These ordinary Oracle-grade treasures were no longer worthy of his attention.
With a casual wave, he swept everything into his warehouse.
He could distribute them among the players as rewards in the future.
As for the other ordinary resources, they were only useful for exchanging for points from the Golden Holy Mountain.
They were like scraps of meat on a mosquito’s leg—hardly satisfying, yet still too wasteful to discard.
After completely razing the Stellar Throne, Daniel summoned Aldrich, who had just finished his own mission.
The second-stage Oracle-grade expert would remain behind to guard this territory in Daniel’s place.
Furthermore, Daniel had made no attempt to conceal his intentions.
News of the Stellar Throne’s destruction quickly spread across the various universes.
Every universe throughout the Flying Fish Star System was shaken to its core without exception.
The native factions all felt an immense sense of danger and began sending inquiries to Mistral Manor.
After all, Mistral Manor was now the only top power capable of contending against Daniel.
Not long ago, Mistral Manor had rejected the recruitment offer from Silvercrown Fortress.
The master of Silvercrown Fortress was undoubtedly furious, yet for some unknown reason, he had not made a move against Mistral Manor.
Anyone with a discerning eye could see that Mistral Manor was attempting to maintain its position through negotiations between multiple powers.
Yet Daniel had suddenly appeared out of nowhere, annexed the Stellar Throne, and established himself within the Flying Fish Star System, making him half a native of the region.
His actions clearly demonstrated that he did not take Mistral Manor seriously.
In the past, when Forefather Mistral had first established the manor, he had divided the territories among the various factions.
None of the factions were permitted to interfere with one another.
Anyone who violated that rule would be punished by Mistral Manor.
But now, Daniel had openly broken a law that had remained in force for tens of millions of years.
He had even directly annexed numerous minor and medium-sized factions.
His ambitions were already obvious to everyone.
Therefore, countless factions were now watching to see how Mistral Manor, the regional overlord, would deal with this arrogant newcomer.
At this moment, within Mistral Manor’s territory on the Apex Fish Plane.
Several Oracle-grade experts answered a summons and gathered inside the council hall.
The Oracle-grade expert Logan was the first to speak.
"Tell me. What exactly happened at the Youth Training Grounds?"
"We sent envoys to establish contact not long ago, yet they brushed us aside."
"Could the Youth Training Grounds be planning to make an enemy of Mistral Manor?"
Sorys, who sat opposite him, shook his head.
"Now is not the time to focus on the Youth Training Grounds."
"The current situation is extremely complicated. Silvercrown Fortress, the Everlight Order, and other powers of the same level all wish to absorb us."
"We have only barely managed to maneuver between them and create a situation in which we can remain seated calmly while waiting for the highest bidder."
"One careless move could ruin everything and leave us surrounded by enemies."
"Before that happens, it would be best for us to take no action whatsoever."
Logan and Sorys were both fifth-stage Oracle-grade experts.
They had also been among the original founders of Mistral Manor.
Before attempting his advancement, Forefather Mistral had vaguely sensed that he might fail and fall.
Worried that the manor would be left without a high-stage expert after his death, he had instructed the two of them to maintain control of the manor and protect his descendants if he perished.
Even the current balance between the surrounding powers had been arranged by the Forefather in advance.
He had long known that Silvercrown Fortress coveted Mistral Manor.
Therefore, he had supported the rise of the Everlight Order and the Sanctum of Triumph to counterbalance it.
This now allowed Mistral Manor to sit back and wait for the highest bidder.
After losing its Forefather, Mistral Manor no longer possessed a high-stage Oracle-grade expert.
Its eventual annexation was inevitable.
Everyone present had already prepared themselves mentally for that outcome.
Sorys pondered before speaking.
"To be honest, based on my personal judgment, I believe Silvercrown Fortress is our best option."
Logan nodded as well.
"I agree. Silvercrown Fortress does indeed satisfy our requirements."
Silvercrown Fortress was located relatively close to the Apex Fish Plane, and the two sides had maintained commercial relations for many years.
It had therefore naturally become their preferred choice.
The only reason they had not yet declared their position was that they wanted Silvercrown Fortress to offer a higher price.
The outside world, however, had no idea what Mistral Manor truly intended.
They only knew that the manor had remained completely silent after Daniel openly destroyed the established order.
This bizarre response immediately filled the various factions with panic and confusion.
"How could this happen?"
"The Stellar Throne was still a major power, yet it was directly wiped from existence."
"And Mistral Manor hasn’t made a single statement?"

chapters.title: Chapter 431 -431-Easily Subduing Two Great Planes
paragraphs: "That’s right. Even the fifth-stage Oracle-grade master of the Stellar Throne was slain by Daniel. His strength absolutely cannot be underestimated."
"Underestimated? If Mistral Manor still refuses to act, there may soon be no one left in the entire Flying Fish Star System capable of opposing him."
Daniel paid no attention whatsoever to the condemnation coming from the various factions.
The howls of the defeated were no different from the barking of stray dogs by the roadside.
They were not worth his attention.
He continued ordering the player armies to march against the various factions.
Anyone who resisted was annihilated without exception.
The combat power displayed by the players was so ferocious that even the major powers had no choice but to send envoys to the Flying Fish Plane to investigate their movements.
Daniel could not be bothered with these irritating flies.
They could investigate all they wanted.
Sooner or later, his armies would arrive at their doors as well.
During this period, Daniel’s glorious battle record attracted a large number of cultivation-focused Oracle-grade experts who valued his strength and potential.
They came one after another to pledge allegiance.
Naturally, Daniel did not worry about whether these newcomers harbored ulterior motives.
He accepted all of them as followers.
Before absolute power, what difference would it make even if every one of them were a spy?
He could suppress them all just the same.
Daniel’s faction began expanding at a terrifying rate, like a rapidly inflating balloon.
"Nearly all the minor and medium-sized factions have been cleared out."
"Our next targets are the Moonlight Plane and the Redmist Plane."
Daniel looked over the victory reports arriving from every region and silently considered his next move.
The ruler of the Moonlight Plane was also a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert, while the master of the Redmist Plane was only at the fourth stage.
Both planes possessed abundant resources, second only to those of the Flying Fish Plane.
There were very few Oracle-grade experts within the two planes, as most of them preferred to cultivate alone.
The pillars of their leading factions were primarily ordinary Divine-grade experts.
They could be considered two relatively easy targets.
Daniel immediately summoned Pierce.
"Send delegations to those two planes at once."
"Tell their rulers that they may live if they surrender."
"If they insist on resisting, the fate of the Stellar Throne will become their fate as well."
In the past, Pierce would never have dared carry out such an openly threatening mission.
But Daniel’s power now stretched across the entire star system.
His reputation had also reached its peak.
This gave Pierce immense confidence, and he immediately accepted the order and dispatched the necessary forces.
Moonlight Plane.
A spatial rift opened, and a fleet emerged within the plane.
"My lord has taken an interest in your territory."
Pierce’s voice rang out across the region.
"You now have two choices."
His words immediately drew out a large number of experts from the Moonlight Plane.
They stared blankly at Pierce, unsure of how to respond.
Pierce continued,
"First, submit to us, and you will be allowed to live."
"Second, offer meaningless resistance and wait for death."
Such arrogant words instantly enraged the experts of the Moonlight Plane.
They began shouting furiously.
"Who do you think you are, daring to threaten us within the Moonlight Plane?"
"Do you even know how many experts our plane possesses? A mere lackey like you dares borrow another’s authority to act arrogantly here?"
"There’s no need to waste words on him. Kill every last one of them and make sure none leave alive!"
Pierce remained calm as he listened to their curses.
There was no fear on his face.
He looked directly at the newly arrived Lord of Moonlight and sneered.
"I advise you to think carefully."
"It would be unfortunate if you ended up sharing the fate of the Stellar Throne."
The Lord of Moonlight stared at him coldly.
"Why should I listen to you?"
Pierce replied indifferently,
"You don’t have to."
"The example of the Stellar Throne is already before you."
"Their overall strength far surpassed yours, yet our forces still razed them to the ground."
Although Pierce’s personal strength was inferior to that of the other party, he still stood tall with his head held high.
In this region, status was determined by the strength of one’s master.
Even if the entire Moonlight Race joined forces, they would still be unable to withstand a single finger from Daniel.
As Daniel’s subordinate, Pierce could naturally borrow that authority and look down upon the Moonlight experts.
After hearing his words, the Lord of Moonlight’s expression shifted repeatedly.
Eventually, he gritted his teeth.
"Very well. In that case, I want to meet your master personally."
Pierce readily agreed.
He quickly sent a request to Daniel, who responded almost immediately.
The Lord of Moonlight was soon invited into the spatial rift and taken to meet Daniel.
Not long afterward, Redmist Plane.
"We are willing to submit to the Master."
Faced with Pierce’s threat, the Lord of Redmist offered almost no resistance before choosing to surrender.
Pierce was delighted.
He had not expected the matter to proceed so smoothly.
Since the Lord of Moonlight was already going to meet Daniel, he might as well bring this man along as well.
Pierce immediately said,
"In that case, come with me to meet the Master."
The Lord of Redmist nodded.
He felt no shame whatsoever over his surrender.
He understood the situation perfectly.
Daniel could casually kill even a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert.
Meanwhile, he himself was only at the fourth stage.
He possessed no ability to resist whatsoever.
Rather than die pointlessly, it was far wiser to submit and preserve his life.
Flying Fish Plane.
Within the territory that had once belonged to the Stellar Throne, all the old structures had been erased and replaced by entirely new buildings.
Not a single trace of the former Stellar Throne remained.
The Lord of Redmist and the Lord of Moonlight entered the palace respectfully.
There, they saw the figure seated upon the throne.
The Lord of Redmist immediately dropped to his knees.
"The entire Redmist Race is willing to submit to the great and supreme Master. We humbly ask you to accept our allegiance."
The Lord of Moonlight’s eyelids twitched when he witnessed such decisiveness.
After gritting his teeth, he also knelt.
"The Moonlight Race is likewise willing to surrender all of its territories."
"I only ask that the Master grant my people a certain degree of freedom."
Daniel naturally had no intention of quibbling over such a minor request.
He agreed without hesitation.
However, even after receiving this concession, the Lord of Moonlight still appeared conflicted.
After remaining silent for a moment, he gritted his teeth and asked,
"Master, what should we do if Mistral Manor regards our surrender as an act of betrayal and attacks us?"
Daniel looked completely unconcerned.
He waved his hand.
"Don’t worry. They won’t dare attack us."
"For now, you only need to cooperate with my armies in the conquest of the other planes."
"I will handle everything else."
After receiving Daniel’s assurance, the two Lords finally felt reassured.
They respectfully withdrew and began preparing to cooperate with Daniel’s subordinates in completing the transfer of control over their two planes.
