chapters.title: Chapter 432 -432-The Final Battle
paragraphs: Without losing a single soldier, Daniel had successfully forced two planes to submit.
By now, his faction had expanded to a terrifying scale.
At the same time, he continued sending Pierce to visit the various planes, using either threats or incentives to persuade them to surrender.
Daniel’s reputation was currently at its peak. Faced with his pressure, many factions chose to submit.
Some remained hesitant and continued observing the situation, but none dared offend him directly. They merely delayed by claiming that they needed more time to consider.
However, Daniel had no intention of allowing them to stall forever.
If they continued refusing to give him an answer, their territories would eventually be conquered by force.
For a time, the various factions began closely monitoring one another, eager to learn which of them had chosen to submit to Daniel.
Some powers became so frightened that they proactively sent people to contact Mistral Manor.
Unfortunately, Mistral Manor was already trapped in a bidding struggle involving Silvercrown Fortress, the Everlight Order, and the Sanctum of Triumph.
They had no spare attention to deal with the chaos unfolding throughout the Flying Fish Universe.
Even when they finally felt that their dignity had been damaged too severely, they merely sent a single envoy to Daniel’s territory to issue a warning.
Such intimidation was practically meaningless.
Daniel could not even be bothered to meet the envoy personally. He casually sent an unfamiliar NPC to intercept and receive them.
Afterward, he summoned Vito.
"Master, you called for me?"
Vito had been exceptionally pleased with himself recently.
Under his leadership, the player armies had achieved victory after victory. At present, he was the foremost contributor within Daniel’s faction.
Anyone who met him had to respectfully address him as Marshal Vito.
After spending so many years without truly tasting the pleasures of authority, he had finally learned what it meant to enjoy power.
However, before Daniel, he remained the same humble servant as ever.
Daniel waved his hand.
"Gather everyone who remains available."
"Many more experts have joined us recently. Have all of them assemble here."
"Next, I intend to purge every major faction that has still refused to submit."
Excitement appeared in Vito’s eyes.
He immediately withdrew to make the necessary arrangements.
Before long, more than a dozen Oracle-grade experts appeared before Daniel.
Aside from Ian and Aldrich, who were stationed in the Redmist Plane and Moonlight Plane, every Oracle-grade expert who had joined during this period was present.
Daniel looked across the group.
"Your next targets are the Thunder Plane, Overlord Plane, Claire Plane, and the other major powers."
"They have still refused to submit, which clearly means they intend to resist."
"The strongest among them is only a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert. With your combined strength, destroying them will be more than easy enough."
"I will assign a player army to each of you. You will each lead one force and launch your own conquest."
"This battle permits only victory, not defeat."
"If I learn that any of you have lost, prepare yourselves for punishment."
"Understood!"
No one dared object.
They accepted their orders one after another and began leading their armies against the various planes.
For a time, raging flames of war spread across the entire Flying Fish Universe.
Daniel’s faction expanded at a terrifying speed.
Under the leadership of Oracle-grade experts, the players were nearly unstoppable.
Within only a few days, every plane in the Flying Fish Universe had become Daniel’s subordinate territory.
Only Mistral Manor, located within the Flying Fish Plane, remained unconquered.
Through this relentless annexation, the number of Oracle-grade followers under Daniel’s command rapidly expanded into the dozens.
Among them were one fourth-stage Oracle-grade expert, eight at the third stage, more than ten at the second stage, and several dozen at the first stage.
As for ordinary Divine-grade experts, they were far too numerous to count.
Nearly every expert at Divine-grade or above throughout the Flying Fish Universe had been brought under Daniel’s command.
Inside a magnificent palace, the Divine-grade experts who had either been forcibly subdued or voluntarily pledged themselves during this period knelt on one knee.
Some lowered their heads, while others gazed respectfully toward the figure seated upon the throne.
Daniel looked down at the gathered experts and spoke calmly.
"At present, only one region of the Flying Fish Universe remains outside our control."
"Next, I intend to attack the Flying Fish Plane."
"What are your thoughts?"
The entire hall fell silent.
Nearly everyone drew in a sharp breath at the same time.
Mistral Manor was currently being courted by several top powers.
There were multiple T7 Oracle-grade experts whose factions had set their sights on that plane.
Attacking Mistral Manor now would be equivalent to making enemies of all those powers.
The risks were extraordinarily high.
As the strongest Oracle-grade expert currently serving Daniel, the Lord of Crimson Martial was the first to speak.
"No, Lord Daniel."
"We have only just unified the various factions. We are nowhere near ready to begin such a war."
"Our foundation has not yet been stabilized."
"If we declare war against several T7 Oracle-grade powers at the same time, every force currently under our command may be completely destroyed."
"My recommendation is that we accumulate strength gradually and fully digest the resources we already possess before considering our next move."
After he spoke, the other followers nodded one after another.
They all urged Daniel not to attempt reaching the summit in a single step.
It would be far wiser to develop slowly.
Daniel merely shook his head.
He had already made his decision long ago.
Even if it meant becoming the enemy of every power throughout the Flying Fish Starfield, he would not waver.
"There is no need to say anything more."
"My decision has been made."
"All forces, heed my command."
"Mobilize immediately and set your blades toward Mistral Manor."
"This time, I will place the entire Flying Fish Starfield beneath my rule."
Once Daniel gave the order, his followers had no choice but to obey, no matter how unwilling they might have been.
The war machine of the former Stellar Throne immediately began operating at full power.
Every Covenanter and Divine-grade expert took command of an army and departed.
Daniel watched the mobilized forces with an indifferent gaze.
The plane occupied by Mistral Manor, along with the surrounding minor and medium-sized factions, possessed territories and resources that he intended to claim for himself.
He would take all of them.
At the same time, within Mistral Manor.
The Oracle-grade expert Logan also sensed that something was wrong.
According to intelligence from their informants, Faustus had begun mobilizing his armies again after unifying the various faction-controlled planes.
And judging by their direction, they were clearly marching straight toward the Flying Fish Plane.
"What exactly is Faustus trying to do?"
For the first time, Logan was genuinely panicking.
This situation was completely different from the previous incidents.
No matter how many factions or planes Faustus had annexed before, they had all belonged to other regions and had no direct connection to Mistral Manor.
But this time—
He was actually planning to attack the plane controlled by Mistral Manor itself.

Some remained hesitant and continued observing the situation, but none dared offend him directly.

However, Daniel had no intention of allowing them to stall forever.
If they continued refusing to give him an answer, their territories would eventually be conquered by force.
For a time, the various factions began closely monitoring one another, eager to learn which of them had chosen to submit to Daniel.
Some powers became so frightened that they proactively sent people to contact Mistral Manor.

Even when they finally felt that their dignity had been damaged too severely, they merely sent a single envoy to Daniel’s territory to issue a warning.
Such intimidation was practically meaningless.
Daniel could not even be bothered to meet the envoy personally.
He casually sent an unfamiliar NPC to intercept and receive them.
Afterward, he summoned Vito.
"Master, you called for me?"
Vito had been exceptionally pleased with himself recently.
Under his leadership, the player armies had achieved victory after victory.
At present, he was the foremost contributor within Daniel’s faction.
Anyone who met him had to respectfully address him as Marshal Vito.
After spending so many years without truly tasting the pleasures of authority, he had finally learned what it meant to enjoy power.

Daniel waved his hand.
"Gather everyone who remains available."
"Many more experts have joined us recently.

"Next, I intend to purge every major faction that has still refused to submit."
Excitement appeared in Vito’s eyes.
He immediately withdrew to make the necessary arrangements.
Before long, more than a dozen Oracle-grade experts appeared before Daniel.
Aside from Ian and Aldrich, who were stationed in the Redmist Plane and Moonlight Plane, every Oracle-grade expert who had joined during this period was present.
Daniel looked across the group.
"Your next targets are the Thunder Plane, Overlord Plane, Claire Plane, and the other major powers."
"They have still refused to submit, which clearly means they intend to resist."
"The strongest among them is only a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert.

"I will assign a player army to each of you.
You will each lead one force and launch your own conquest."
"This battle permits only victory, not defeat."
"If I learn that any of you have lost, prepare yourselves for punishment."
"Understood!"

There were multiple T7 Oracle-grade experts whose factions had set their sights on that plane.
Attacking Mistral Manor now would be equivalent to making enemies of all those powers.
The risks were extraordinarily high.

"No, Lord Daniel."
"We have only just unified the various factions.
We are nowhere near ready to begin such a war."
"Our foundation has not yet been stabilized."
"If we declare war against several T7 Oracle-grade powers at the same time, every force currently under our command may be completely destroyed."
"My recommendation is that we accumulate strength gradually and fully digest the resources we already possess before considering our next move."

chapters.title: Chapter 433 -433-Assaulting the Flying Fish Plane
paragraphs: "That bastard absolutely intends to annex us."
Sorys’s gaze shifted slightly, and his expression turned equally grim.
"He has nearly unified the entire Flying Fish Star System. Mistral Manor is now the only faction that still retains its independence."
"If he annexes us as well, Faustus will effectively rule the entire Flying Fish Star System."
"That man truly has nerves of steel."
Naturally, Logan was not completely unaware of the situation. He was simply shocked by Faustus’s audacity.
"Does he not understand that Mistral Manor is currently being courted by several factions backed by T7 Oracle-grade experts?"
"Besides, what good will attacking us do him?"
"The moment Mistral Manor formally chooses a side, the corresponding power will immediately send reinforcements."
"No matter which faction comes to our aid, won’t Faustus still have to obediently withdraw?"
"Even if he beats Mistral Manor half to death, he’ll merely be conquering territory and guarding it on behalf of someone else."
"How is that any different from being another faction’s dog?"
Sorys sneered repeatedly after hearing this.
"Who knows what that Daniel is thinking?"
"Since he wants to behave so arrogantly, let him continue."
"The moment a T7 Oracle-grade expert personally intervenes, he will certainly surrender immediately."
"Surely he doesn’t believe he can contend against a T7 Oracle-grade expert?"
Logan nodded before adding,
"Still, we must make defensive preparations."
"If we are destroyed before reinforcements from the other powers arrive, Mistral Manor will truly be finished."
"Recall every Divine-grade expert stationed outside."
"Faustus is a madman. There is nothing he wouldn’t dare do."
Sorys nodded.
"That makes sense. I’ll arrange it immediately."
Under the orders of Logan and Sorys, the other Oracle-grade experts of Mistral Manor rapidly returned to the Flying Fish Plane.
They even abandoned the surrounding minor and medium-sized factions, withdrawing all their forces back to their stronghold.
At this moment, almost none of Mistral Manor’s Oracle-grade experts remained stationed outside.
They had all returned to their headquarters.
Without those Oracle-grade experts standing in their way, Daniel’s armies advanced with overwhelming momentum, occupying every minor and medium-sized faction and plane in the surrounding regions.
By now, Daniel’s faction had taken control of almost the entire Flying Fish Universe.
Even the smallest and most insignificant powers had fallen under his rule.
This was something even Mistral Manor had never accomplished.
Compared with Daniel’s current faction, Mistral Manor’s former control over the Flying Fish Universe had not even amounted to one percent!
Throughout the entire Flying Fish Universe, only Mistral Manor on the Flying Fish Plane remained outside Daniel’s control.
However, Mistral Manor’s current situation was extremely delicate.
The various top powers that had extended olive branches to Mistral Manor were also watching from the sidelines.
Just as Logan and Sorys had predicted, after seeing the manor’s current predicament, those factions not only refused to offer assistance but instead stood by and watched with malicious amusement.
The reason was simple.
Once Mistral Manor was driven into desperation, it would no longer be able to reject them.
All they had to do was wait patiently for the manor to collapse.
Then they could intervene and force Faustus to hand over everything he had conquered.
It would be the perfect scheme—obtaining something for nothing and swallowing the entire Flying Fish Universe without lifting a finger!
Such an effortless profit was naturally something none of them would refuse.
Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!
Across the vast starry sky, dozens of Imperial Bow-class warships were flying toward the Flying Fish Plane.
An Oracle-grade expert guarded each vessel.
Every one of them served Daniel and had come under his orders to seize the Flying Fish Plane!
Aboard the Imperial Bow-class warship at the very front, Daniel personally commanded the fleet, leading his subordinates toward their destination.
Before long, the protective array of the Flying Fish Plane appeared before them.
The Oracle-grade experts aboard the fleet could not help feeling uneasy.
After all, this array had been personally established by Forefather Mistral while he was still alive!
It was powerful enough to withstand the full-force strike of a T6 Oracle-grade expert.
The strongest among Daniel’s subordinates was only at the fifth stage of Oracle-grade.
None of them had any confidence in breaking through it.
The only one who might be capable of destroying the array was their new master, Daniel.
"Master..."
Vito was just about to speak when Daniel vanished from where he stood.
When he appeared again, he was already standing outside the array!
At this moment, Vito, the other Oracle-grade experts, and every member of Mistral Manor within the Flying Fish Plane turned their gazes toward Daniel.
Daniel examined the array and nodded faintly.
"With such a pitiful foundation, you are unworthy of calling yourselves the rulers of the Flying Fish Universe."
As soon as his words fell, he attacked without hesitation.
Boom!
An incomparably dazzling sword light appeared!
In almost the same instant, the array shattered like glass!
The entire plane began to tremble, and the expressions of everyone inside changed drastically.
"H-How is this possible?"
Logan cried out in disbelief.
This was an array personally arranged by the Forefather.
Even Logan himself could not break through it.
Yet Daniel had destroyed it effortlessly with a single sword strike.
Just how powerful was he?
Sorys’s expression also became exceedingly ugly.
"Damn it. We still underestimated him."
"No wonder he was able to swallow the entire Flying Fish Universe within such a short period."
"His strength can truly be described as invincible."
Swish!
After destroying the Flying Fish Plane’s array, Daniel flickered back onto the warship.
He raised one hand slightly.
"The protective array of the Flying Fish Plane has been destroyed."
"All forces, heed my command!"
"Launch a full-scale assault on the Flying Fish Plane!"
"Once we capture this plane, our mission will already be half complete!"
Rumble!
The warships immediately surged forward.
However, just as the fleet was about to enter the Flying Fish Plane, several figures suddenly charged out from within.
They were five fifth-stage Oracle-grade experts, each belonging to a different faction.
The moment they appeared, they blocked the fleet and prevented it from advancing.
Daniel narrowed his eyes, killing intent flashing within them.
They dared stand in his way?
One of the five Oracle-grade experts stepped forward.
He was a red-haired young man.
His gaze swept across the fleet before he shouted loudly,
"Which one of you is Faustus?"
"Come out and speak!"
His tone was arrogant, as though he did not take Daniel seriously at all.
Daniel frowned slightly.
The next moment, his figure appeared directly before the man.
"I am Faustus."
"What do you want?"
The red-haired Oracle-grade expert studied the young man before him with great interest.
When Daniel first appeared in the Flying Fish Universe, he had known almost nothing about him.
However, after investigating during this period, he had learned that Daniel came from the Chaosverse.
Beyond that, he had been unable to uncover any deeper information.
He only knew that the Chaosverse was a newly born universe filled with extraordinary chaos, and that a great deal of its information remained impossible to investigate.

chapters.title: Chapter 434 -434-The T8 Treasure
paragraphs: However, none of that truly mattered.
Regardless of where Daniel came from, it made little difference.
Within the Flying Fish Universe, strength was all that mattered. No one cared where a powerful expert had originated.
For example, the Heaven-Equaling Universe was still at war with the native factions of the Chaosverse, and the conflict had yet to end.
According to what they had heard, the native factions of the Chaosverse did not inherently despise the Heaven-Equaling Universe.
Rather, the Heaven-Equaling Universe had taken the initiative to infringe upon their interests.
As for whether the Heaven-Equaling Universe possessed backing from another universe, the natives of the Chaosverse did not care in the slightest.
Strictly speaking, even the Chaos Humans were outsiders.
That could be considered one of the defining characteristics of the Chaosverse.
Countless foreign races had settled there, yet its inhabitants could still somehow find the time to wage civil wars among themselves.
The Myriad-Star Cosmos was completely different.
It was an ancient and renowned universe filled with innumerable factions whose relationships were deeply intertwined.
Nearly every power had developed locally over countless years.
Whenever an outsider invaded, the native factions would immediately unite against the common enemy.
This was entirely different from the Chaosverse.
"Daniel, do you dare tell me where you truly come from?"
Logan stared directly at the young man before him and asked in a deep voice.
Daniel merely glanced at him before smiling disdainfully.
"And what exactly are you?"
"Why should I tell you anything?"
Logan’s expression instantly turned ashen upon hearing those incomparably arrogant words.
He had never imagined that Daniel would humiliate him so openly in front of everyone.
No matter what, Logan was still a veteran Oracle-grade Grand Elder of Mistral Manor.
Even if he was weaker than Daniel, shouldn’t Daniel at least show him a little respect?
Instead, Daniel had slapped him in the face without mercy, giving Logan no time to prepare himself mentally.
"You’ve gone too far!"
Logan flew into a rage.
A terrifying aura erupted from his body as he prepared to attack.
At that moment, an Oracle-grade expert dressed in pale blue suddenly spoke from beside him.
"Logan, hold your hand for now."
Logan turned toward him sharply.
"You intend to stop me?"
The blue-robed Oracle-grade expert replied calmly,
"Have you forgotten why we came out here?"
"Wasn’t our purpose to negotiate with Faustus?"
"If you attack him now, you will personally destroy the final possibility of peaceful negotiations."
"We will lose any moral ground we might have possessed."
"If the mission fails, you can explain it to our superiors yourself."
Clearly, this blue-robed Oracle-grade expert was not a member of Mistral Manor.
He was most likely an envoy dispatched by one of the top powers.
Logan’s face twisted with fury.
"Explain?"
"Does Mistral Manor not deserve an explanation as well?"
"Have you forgotten that I am the Grand Elder of the manor?"
"Faustus has humiliated me to this extent. There is no longer any need to negotiate!"
"Join forces with me and bury this entire fleet here!"
Displeasure immediately appeared on the blue-robed Oracle-grade expert’s face.
"Heh. You seem to have forgotten that the Everlight Order has not officially accepted the Flying Fish Plane into its territory."
"Until Mistral Manor formally joins the Everlight Order, I will not interfere in any conflict between you and Faustus."
"Logan, I advise you to think carefully before acting."
Behind him, an Oracle-grade expert dressed in black immediately added,
"He is correct."
"Silvercrown Fortress must also see what attitude Mistral Manor intends to take before we act."
The white-robed Oracle-grade expert standing nearby spoke indifferently as well.
"The Carefree Divine Temple shares the same position."
"You should first declare which side you intend to join. Only then will we have grounds to intervene in the internal conflict of the Flying Fish Star System."
After hearing the envoys from the three top powers speak, Logan became even more furious.
He cursed these sanctimonious hypocrites repeatedly in his heart.
They were clearly taking advantage of Mistral Manor’s crisis to extort greater benefits!
Unfortunately, there was nothing he could do.
The three factions before him were now the only source of confidence Mistral Manor possessed.
After venting his anger, Logan could only swing his sleeve and transform into a streak of light, retreating into the Flying Fish Plane.
Before leaving, he threw down one final sentence.
"Since all of you are so fond of negotiations, you can negotiate with him yourselves!"
"I refuse to remain here and endure further humiliation!"
Watching Logan disappear, Daniel could not help finding the situation amusing.
He had never expected that a single sentence would be enough to anger a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert into fleeing.
The representatives of the three great factions also realized for the first time just how difficult Daniel was to deal with.
He had completely overturned their previous understanding of powerful experts.
They had never encountered such an arrogant Oracle-grade expert before.
This man was definitely not someone who could be handled easily.
With that thought in mind, the Oracle-grade envoys of the three factions exchanged knowing glances.
In the end, the blue-robed Oracle-grade expert from the Everlight Order was the first to speak.
"Ahem. Since I am the eldest among us, allow me to negotiate with him first."
The representatives of the Carefree Divine Temple and Silvercrown Fortress nodded simultaneously.
"Very well."
"Agreed."
The Everlight Order’s Oracle-grade expert immediately flickered and appeared before Daniel.
He raised his voice.
"Faustus, I am a representative of the Everlight Order."
"Let me ask you this—what exactly have you come here to accomplish?"
Daniel glanced at him before finally answering.
"What else could it be?"
"I intend to destroy Mistral Manor."
The Oracle-grade representatives of all three factions raised their eyes at the same time.
Shock and excitement could not be concealed within their gazes.
Although they had already anticipated Daniel’s objective, they had never expected him to be arrogant enough to state his intentions so openly.
The representative of the Everlight Order frowned.
"For the sake of the Everlight Order, could you temporarily halt your campaign?"
"There is no need to force Mistral Manor into a desperate situation."
Daniel rejected him without the slightest hesitation.
"Impossible."
"How much influence do you think the Everlight Order possesses?"
"You believe your name alone is enough to stop me?"
The representative’s expression immediately became ugly.
He had never imagined that Faustus would be so completely unwilling to compromise.
The Everlight Order had offered him a way to preserve his dignity, yet he had refused to accept it.
"In that case, the Everlight Order will have no choice but to intervene in this matter."
His words carried an unmistakable threat.
Daniel remained completely unconcerned.
He waved his hand arrogantly.
"And what exactly are you supposed to be?"
"You think you are worthy of standing in my way?"
"What?!"
The expressions of all three Oracle-grade representatives changed drastically.
This madman did not even place their three great factions in his eyes!
Only now did they finally understand why Logan had become so furious.
Being treated with contempt by such an arrogant bastard truly was infuriating.
Worse still, Daniel did not merely possess a vicious tongue.
He also possessed overwhelming strength.
The faces of all three representatives turned livid with rage.

Logan turned toward him sharply.
"You intend to stop me?"
The blue-robed Oracle-grade expert replied calmly,
"Have you forgotten why we came out here?"
"Wasn’t our purpose to negotiate with Faustus?"
"If you attack him now, you will personally destroy the final possibility of peaceful negotiations."
"We will lose any moral ground we might have possessed."
"If the mission fails, you can explain it to our superiors yourself."
Clearly, this blue-robed Oracle-grade expert was not a member of Mistral Manor.
He was most likely an envoy dispatched by one of the top powers.
Logan’s face twisted with fury.
"Explain?"
"Does Mistral Manor not deserve an explanation as well?"
"Have you forgotten that I am the Grand Elder of the manor?"
"Faustus has humiliated me to this extent.
There is no longer any need to negotiate!"
"Join forces with me and bury this entire fleet here!"
Displeasure immediately appeared on the blue-robed Oracle-grade expert’s face.
"Heh.
You seem to have forgotten that the Everlight Order has not officially accepted the Flying Fish Plane into its territory."
"Until Mistral Manor formally joins the Everlight Order, I will not interfere in any conflict between you and Faustus."
"Logan, I advise you to think carefully before acting."
Behind him, an Oracle-grade expert dressed in black immediately added,
"He is correct."
"Silvercrown Fortress must also see what attitude Mistral Manor intends to take before we act."
The white-robed Oracle-grade expert standing nearby spoke indifferently as well.
"The Carefree Divine Temple shares the same position."
"You should first declare which side you intend to join.
Only then will we have grounds to intervene in the internal conflict of the Flying Fish Star System."
After hearing the envoys from the three top powers speak, Logan became even more furious.
He cursed these sanctimonious hypocrites repeatedly in his heart.
They were clearly taking advantage of Mistral Manor’s crisis to extort greater benefits!
Unfortunately, there was nothing he could do.
The three factions before him were now the only source of confidence Mistral Manor possessed.
After venting his anger, Logan could only swing his sleeve and transform into a streak of light, retreating into the Flying Fish Plane.
Before leaving, he threw down one final sentence.
"Since all of you are so fond of negotiations, you can negotiate with him yourselves!"
"I refuse to remain here and endure further humiliation!"
Watching Logan disappear, Daniel could not help finding the situation amusing.
He had never expected that a single sentence would be enough to anger a fifth-stage Oracle-grade expert into fleeing.
The representatives of the three great factions also realized for the first time just how difficult Daniel was to deal with.
He had completely overturned their previous understanding of powerful experts.
They had never encountered such an arrogant Oracle-grade expert before.
This man was definitely not someone who could be handled easily.
With that thought in mind, the Oracle-grade envoys of the three factions exchanged knowing glances.
In the end, the blue-robed Oracle-grade expert from the Everlight Order was the first to speak.
"Ahem.
Since I am the eldest among us, allow me to negotiate with him first."
The representatives of the Carefree Divine Temple and Silvercrown Fortress nodded simultaneously.
"Very well."
"Agreed."
The Everlight Order’s Oracle-grade expert immediately flickered and appeared before Daniel.
He raised his voice.
"Faustus, I am a representative of the Everlight Order."
"Let me ask you this—what exactly have you come here to accomplish?"
Daniel glanced at him before finally answering.
"What else could it be?"
"I intend to destroy Mistral Manor."
The Oracle-grade representatives of all three factions raised their eyes at the same time.
Shock and excitement could not be concealed within their gazes.
Although they had already anticipated Daniel’s objective, they had never expected him to be arrogant enough to state his intentions so openly.
The representative of the Everlight Order frowned.
"For the sake of the Everlight Order, could you temporarily halt your campaign?"
"There is no need to force Mistral Manor into a desperate situation."
Daniel rejected him without the slightest hesitation.
"Impossible."
"How much influence do you think the Everlight Order possesses?"
"You believe your name alone is enough to stop me?"
The representative’s expression immediately became ugly.
He had never imagined that Faustus would be so completely unwilling to compromise.
The Everlight Order had offered him a way to preserve his dignity, yet he had refused to accept it.
"In that case, the Everlight Order will have no choice but to intervene in this matter."
His words carried an unmistakable threat.
Daniel remained completely unconcerned.
He waved his hand arrogantly.
"And what exactly are you supposed to be?"
"You think you are worthy of standing in my way?"
"What?!"
The expressions of all three Oracle-grade representatives changed drastically.
This madman did not even place their three great factions in his eyes!
Only now did they finally understand why Logan had become so furious.
Being treated with contempt by such an arrogant bastard truly was infuriating.
Worse still, Daniel did not merely possess a vicious tongue.
He also possessed overwhelming strength.
The faces of all three representatives turned livid with rage.

chapters.title: Chapter 435 -435-The Fall of Mistral Manor
paragraphs: At that moment—
Daniel raised one hand, and a ray of golden light appeared within his palm.
An incomparably terrifying aura erupted from the golden radiance.
The pressure it released was enough to horrify even a T7 Oracle-grade expert standing before it.
The three fifth-stage Oracle-grade representatives were naturally even less capable of enduring it.
The representative of the Everlight Order was the first to react. He nearly began trembling uncontrollably.
"Damn it! That’s a high-stage Oracle-grade treasure!"
"Run!"
As soon as he shouted, his body transformed into a streak of light and fled into the distance.
He had only come here to negotiate on behalf of the Everlight Order.
He had never intended to leave his life behind.
"Damn it! Where did this bastard obtain a T8 treasure?"
The representative of Silvercrown Fortress was equally terrified. He hurriedly transformed into a streak of light and escaped after him.
The Oracle-grade expert from the Carefree Divine Temple reacted just as quickly.
"Damn it! This man is a complete lunatic!"
"He casually pulled out a T8 treasure without the slightest hesitation!"
From beginning to end, Daniel had not even moved a finger.
He had merely revealed his T8 treasure.
Yet the three fifth-stage Oracle-grade experts representing the great factions had been frightened out of their wits and fled immediately.
That was because this was a T8 treasure.
Its aura alone was enough to scare countless Oracle-grade experts to death.
Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!
In only a few moments, all three representatives disappeared without a trace.
Only then did Daniel slowly launch the golden light from his palm.
In an instant, a terrifying colossal hand spanning trillions of miles appeared within the starry sky.
The law aura surrounding the enormous palm was so concentrated that it had nearly materialized.
Even the faintest trace of pressure leaking from it was enough to instantly kill any Oracle-grade expert below T7.
Naturally, Daniel had not activated this T8 Oracle-grade treasure merely to frighten away a few insignificant insects.
His true objective was to destroy Mistral Manor within the Flying Fish Plane.
"Go!"
Daniel swung his arm with all his strength.
The colossal golden hand immediately descended toward the Flying Fish Plane.
The entrance, which had originally been nothing more than a narrow crack, was instantly torn wide open.
At the same time, within Mistral Manor on the Flying Fish Plane.
An incomparably terrifying aura suddenly descended from above.
Buzz! Buzz!
In an instant, countless experts throughout the manor were forced out of seclusion.
Logan had only just returned to the Flying Fish Plane when he sensed the overwhelming aura of a T8 treasure approaching from behind.
His expression immediately filled with terror, as though he had encountered his natural predator.
"How is this possible?"
"That’s a T8 treasure!"
"Run!"
After recovering from his shock, Logan hurriedly roared at everyone within the manor.
However, Sorys merely let out a long sigh.
He looked toward the golden hand growing larger in the distance, grief appearing on his face.
"It’s too late."
"Once a T8 treasure has been activated, there is nowhere for us to escape."
As soon as he finished speaking, the colossal palm descended across hundreds of millions of miles, carrying a terrifying and unusual law.
That special law had been prepared by Daniel specifically to target the Oracle-grade experts of Mistral Manor.
As a result, none of them possessed any opportunity to flee.
Upon seeing this, Logan understood that escape was impossible.
Yet he still refused to accept his fate.
"No!"
"Are we supposed to do nothing but remain here and wait for death?"
Sorys shook his head, a trace of reminiscence appearing in his eyes.
"It seems there is nothing else we can do."
Memories from his childhood surfaced within his mind.
Back then, he had only just begun cultivating when he discovered that his talent far surpassed that of ordinary people.
His path had been nearly unobstructed, allowing him to advance directly to Divine-grade.
Shortly after reaching Divine-grade, he sensed the existence of an inheritance ground.
He immediately entered it and obtained the legacy of a mysterious Oracle-grade expert.
With the help of that inheritance, he quickly embarked upon the path toward Oracle-grade.
Along the way, he had endured countless life-and-death trials.
After innumerable hardships, he had finally risen above the masses and attained the position of an Oracle-grade expert.
Yet the suffering had never ended.
Even after becoming Oracle-grade, he still had to face the Great Dao Tribulations that constantly threatened his life.
He had spent his entire existence struggling beneath those tribulations.
Fortunately, when he encountered a catastrophe he could not overcome, he met Forefather Mistral.
The Forefather taught him a method of resisting the Great Dao Tribulations, allowing him to cultivate smoothly all the way to the fifth stage of Oracle-grade.
Sorys’s race had also prospered because of his achievements.
But now, the moment he saw the T8 treasure descending upon them, he understood that his life had reached its end.
The countless Great Dao Tribulations that had threatened him throughout his existence had failed to claim his life.
Instead, he would die because of an inexplicable struggle between factions within the starfield.
Looking back upon his life, he had spent nearly all of it running, fleeing, and cultivating.
He had never truly rested.
At last, he could finally stop.
"I hope that in my next life, I can experience life and death as an ordinary mortal."
"Even if such a life is filled with suffering and exhaustion, it would last only a few decades."
"After a hundred years at most, I could peacefully return to rest."
The golden hand drew ever closer.
Its dense T8 pressure seemed capable of crushing him into the depths of the earth.
Sorys calmly closed his eyes.
However, not everyone could accept death as peacefully as he did.
"No! I’m still so young! I don’t want to die here!"
"My race still depends on me to continue prospering. I absolutely cannot die!"
"My next Great Dao Tribulation hasn’t even arrived yet! How could I die in a place like this?"
The other Oracle-grade and Divine-grade experts of Mistral Manor desperately attempted to escape.
They transformed into streaks of light and shot away from the manor, trying to flee beyond the Flying Fish Plane.
However, many more had already fallen into despair.
"It’s over. That treasure will undoubtedly destroy our very existences."
"We may not even have the opportunity to reincarnate."
"We always spoke of our next lives..."
"But now, we won’t even have a next life!"
"W-Waaah!"
Boom!
Amid endless curses and anguished wails, the colossal palm finally arrived above Mistral Manor.
It descended like the collapse of the heavens.
The experts attempting to escape were the first to be crushed into fragments.
Even those who had luckily escaped the immediate range of the palm were instantly countered by its laws.
Their bodies were dragged backward like iron drawn toward a magnet.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Countless structures were instantly reduced to ash.
It required only a single palm strike.
Mistral Manor, which had stood for countless years upon the Flying Fish Plane and had been established by the T7 Oracle-grade Forefather Mistral—
Was completely destroyed beneath that single blow.
Because of the unique properties of the T8 treasure, the scene of Mistral Manor’s destruction was simultaneously transmitted to the outside world.
Beyond the Flying Fish Plane—
The three Oracle-grade representatives of the great factions, who had only stopped after fleeing for a long distance, stared blankly at the sight of Mistral Manor collapsing.
The terrifying aura and heaven-defying power released by the T8 treasure made them realize for the first time just how insignificant they truly were.
Before such power—
They were no different from ants.

chapters.title: Chapter 436 -436-A New Overlord Ascends
paragraphs: As they watched Mistral Manor collapse and disappear within the Flying Fish Plane, the Oracle-grade representatives of the three great factions were overcome by complicated emotions.
"From this day forward, Mistral Manor no longer exists."
The Oracle-grade representative of the Everlight Order gave a bitter smile, his eyes filled with emotion.
When the three of them first arrived, each had carried orders from their respective factions to annex Mistral Manor.
Yet now, the manor they had intended to absorb had been completely destroyed by someone else.
The three of them had even been driven away and could only watch helplessly as the territory that should have fallen into their hands was reduced to ruins.
It was an indescribably bitter feeling.
Over this period, they had traveled far and wide for the sake of Mistral Manor’s territory and devised all manner of schemes.
Yet in the end, all their efforts had come to nothing.
And the culprit behind everything was none other than Faustus—the man who had just driven them away.
According to their original plan, Faustus should have helped them clear away the minor and medium-sized factions surrounding Mistral Manor.
Afterward, the three great factions would formally enter the stage and harvest the entire Flying Fish Star System.
Never had they imagined that Faustus would refuse to play by their rules.
He had simply uprooted Mistral Manor altogether.
"That Faustus is definitely not a normal person!"
The Oracle-grade expert from Silvercrown Fortress still looked somewhat dazed as he recalled Daniel casually producing a T8 treasure.
"I have no idea how many high-stage Oracle-grade treasures that man possesses."
"He can even take out and activate a T8 supreme treasure as though it were nothing."
"I’m beginning to suspect that he may even possess T9 Oracle-grade treasures."
However, even after he voiced his speculation, neither of the others dared respond.
A T8 treasure was already powerful enough to gravely injure a T7 Oracle-grade expert and potentially cause their death.
If Daniel truly produced a T9 treasure, the three of them probably would not even have the opportunity to stand here and speak.
At this thought, fear surged through their hearts like a violent tide.
Faustus had always acted with extreme arrogance and tyranny.
Worse still, the number of trump cards in his possession seemed utterly unfathomable.
No one knew how many he truly had.
The three representatives even began wondering whether he was the reincarnation of some ancient monster.
Otherwise, how could he possess such profound fortune and even obtain the Origin inheritance of an entire world?
Regardless, he had already destroyed Mistral Manor.
He now possessed the qualifications to stand on equal footing with the three great factions.
In fact, none of those factions dared make an enemy of him any longer.
The Oracle-grade representative of the Carefree Divine Temple could only let out a long sigh.
"It seems that from this day forward, the Flying Fish Universe will belong to the Stellar Throne alone."
"No other faction will dare involve itself in the struggle for this starfield again."
The trump card Daniel had revealed today was enough to force even a T8 Oracle-grade expert to exercise caution.
None would dare casually contend against him.
After all, no one knew whether the next treasure Daniel drew would be a supreme T9 Oracle-grade treasure.
If he truly possessed one, even a T8 Oracle-grade expert would be forced to kneel before its power.
"Faustus is no longer someone ordinary factions like ours are qualified to approach."
The strongest expert of the Carefree Divine Temple was only a T7 Oracle-grade expert.
Although Forefather Carefree was publicly hailed as invincible, even he would decisively retreat upon seeing a T8 treasure appear before him.
The three Oracle-grade representatives exchanged glances and saw the same desire to withdraw in one another’s eyes.
The anger left behind by Daniel’s earlier insults had long since vanished beneath the pressure of the T8 treasure.
Even though this expedition had caused their three factions to lose face, they could only obediently return and report the sudden development to their respective Forefathers.
From this moment onward, no outside faction dared interfere in the Flying Fish Star System.
The Stellar Throne had completely occupied the entire Flying Fish Starfield.
No power dared compete with it.
At this moment, the starfield’s true overlord officially ascended.
Daniel was currently surrounded by a sea of sacred light.
He had not personally launched the attack just now.
He had merely released the T8 treasure.
A treasure of that level already possessed a certain degree of autonomous consciousness.
With a single thought from Daniel, it could act independently and annihilate every Oracle-grade expert within Mistral Manor.
After receiving confirmation from the T8 treasure, Daniel raised his hand slightly and issued an order.
"All forces, advance."
"Occupy this plane for me."
The numerous Oracle-grade and Divine-grade experts under his command, who had been waiting for a long time, immediately surged forward like a vast tide.
They transformed into a torrent of light and swept into the Flying Fish Plane.
The world-destroying scene caused by the T8 treasure had already left Daniel’s subordinates utterly shaken.
When Daniel first announced his intention to conquer the Flying Fish Plane, they had actually attempted to dissuade him.
The Lord of Crimson Martial had even personally voiced his opposition.
At the time, they had all believed Daniel was taking far too large a step and that such recklessness might hinder their future development.

Yet none of them had imagined that Mistral Manor—a deeply rooted and seemingly untouchable power in their eyes—would be reduced to nothingness in a single instant by the T8 Oracle-grade treasure Daniel released.
They would likely never forget such a world-destroying spectacle for the rest of their lives.
Even now, many experts remained immersed in the shock of what had just happened.
"Was I dreaming just now?"
"How did everything change so quickly? That was Mistral Manor!"
"It’s truly unbelievable. Mistral Manor ruled the Flying Fish Starfield for countless years, yet Master destroyed it with a casual attack."
"I never imagined that our Stellar Throne would have the opportunity to become the new overlord."
"At last, ordinary Oracle-grade experts like us have a chance to rise."
"From now on, the entire Flying Fish Starfield answers to us!"
After unifying the Flying Fish Starfield, Daniel made no attempt to conceal the news.
It rapidly spread throughout the entire region.
Almost every faction, from those controlling individual star rivers to the major powers ruling entire starfields, began discussing the incident.
And without exception, the subject of their discussions was the newly ascended overlord—
The Stellar Throne.
"The Stellar Throne is far too terrifying!"
"It took them less than two weeks to rise and seize the position of overlord!"
"Hardly anyone would believe this if the news spread beyond the starfield."
"An unknown newcomer appeared out of nowhere and directly conquered the entire region!"
"That Faustus is an absolute monster."
By now, the various factions felt nothing but fear and reverence toward the Stellar Throne.
Not long ago, Silvercrown Fortress, the Everlight Order, and even the Sanctum of Triumph had personally intervened.
Yet even those three top powers had failed to stop the Stellar Throne.
If forces of that level could do nothing—
How could any of them possibly dare provoke or covet the Stellar Throne?

They transformed into a torrent of light and swept into the Flying Fish Plane.
The world-destroying scene caused by the T8 treasure had already left Daniel’s subordinates utterly shaken.
When Daniel first announced his intention to conquer the Flying Fish Plane, they had actually attempted to dissuade him.
The Lord of Crimson Martial had even personally voiced his opposition.
At the time, they had all believed Daniel was taking far too large a step and that such recklessness might hinder their future development.

Yet none of them had imagined that Mistral Manor—a deeply rooted and seemingly untouchable power in their eyes—would be reduced to nothingness in a single instant by the T8 Oracle-grade treasure Daniel released.
They would likely never forget such a world-destroying spectacle for the rest of their lives.
Even now, many experts remained immersed in the shock of what had just happened.
"Was I dreaming just now?"
"How did everything change so quickly?
That was Mistral Manor!"
"It’s truly unbelievable.
Mistral Manor ruled the Flying Fish Starfield for countless years, yet Master destroyed it with a casual attack."
"I never imagined that our Stellar Throne would have the opportunity to become the new overlord."
"At last, ordinary Oracle-grade experts like us have a chance to rise."
"From now on, the entire Flying Fish Starfield answers to us!"
After unifying the Flying Fish Starfield, Daniel made no attempt to conceal the news.
It rapidly spread throughout the entire region.
Almost every faction, from those controlling individual star rivers to the major powers ruling entire starfields, began discussing the incident.
And without exception, the subject of their discussions was the newly ascended overlord—
The Stellar Throne.
"The Stellar Throne is far too terrifying!"
"It took them less than two weeks to rise and seize the position of overlord!"
"Hardly anyone would believe this if the news spread beyond the starfield."
"An unknown newcomer appeared out of nowhere and directly conquered the entire region!"
"That Faustus is an absolute monster."
By now, the various factions felt nothing but fear and reverence toward the Stellar Throne.
Not long ago, Silvercrown Fortress, the Everlight Order, and even the Sanctum of Triumph had personally intervened.
Yet even those three top powers had failed to stop the Stellar Throne.
If forces of that level could do nothing—
How could any of them possibly dare provoke or covet the Stellar Throne?

chapters.title: Chapter 437 -437-Everyone Grows Stronger
paragraphs: Mistral Manor had been destroyed before countless witnesses, while the Stellar Throne openly seized control of the entire starfield.
The three great factions had even issued direct orders forbidding their subordinates from provoking the Stellar Throne.
They had clearly lowered their heads and admitted defeat.
If only one faction had chosen to retreat, others might have assumed that its leader was simply too cowardly.
However, all three factions had made the exact same decision.
That alone was enough to prove that the Stellar Throne possessed a trump card capable of intimidating the entire region.
From that point onward, nearly every faction acknowledged the Stellar Throne as Mistral Manor’s successor and the new overlord of the Flying Fish Star System.
Daniel also relocated the Stellar Throne’s headquarters directly to the ruins where Mistral Manor had once stood.
After all, the most valuable territory in the Flying Fish Star System was the Flying Fish Plane.
The plane had always been famous for producing Twelve-Winged Flying Fish.
They were top-tier Origin-grade treasure materials capable of generating an enormous amount of wealth for Daniel and the Stellar Throne.
At this moment, within the Flying Fish Plane—
All manner of players stood before Daniel.
Without exception, they were the leading figures of the player population.
Daniel tapped his fingers against the table and asked calmly,
"Report the current numbers."
"How many players have reached quasi-Divine-grade combat strength?"
Pierce immediately answered,
"Master, the number is approaching ten million."
"Nearly ten million already?"
Daniel nodded slightly.
When he first received the starfield conquest mission, its first requirement had been to raise the number of quasi-Divine-grade players under his command to ten million.
The second objective had been to gain complete control of the Flying Fish Star System.
Daniel had already completed the second objective ahead of schedule.
Only the requirement of ten million quasi-Divine-grade players remained.
The players’ leveling speed had always been extraordinarily fast.
Furthermore, they had spent this entire period waging wars and killing enemies from the surrounding territories.
At their current rate of expansion, they would likely satisfy the final requirement very soon.
Daniel immediately issued an order.
"Pass down my command."
"All player armies are to accelerate their campaigns and kill as many enemies as possible."
"I want every one of you to level up and keep pace with me."
Under Daniel’s orders, only a few days passed before the entire player population underwent another massive increase in strength.
The target of ten million quasi-Divine-grade players had finally been reached!
A system notification rang in Daniel’s ears.
[Ding! Congratulations, Player. You have completed the main-story Starfield Conquest Mission!]
[Ding! Congratulations, Player. You have obtained a clue leading to a Fragment of the Greater Cosmic Will!]
Daniel, who had been studying his own abilities, suddenly returned to his senses when he heard the notifications.
A smile appeared on his face.
"This mission has been holding me back for far too long."
"At last, it’s complete."
"And I’ve finally obtained the clue to the Fragment of the Greater Cosmic Will!"
Unable to suppress his anticipation, he immediately retrieved the mission reward.
To his surprise, it was an ancient-looking mask that appeared completely ordinary.
"Why is it a mask?"
"Could the clue to the Fragment of the Greater Cosmic Will require me to disguise my identity?"
Daniel examined the mask from several angles but failed to discover anything unusual.
"A mask usually means I’ll need to conceal my identity while carrying out some kind of operation."
"Let’s see what it actually does."
He immediately opened the item’s details.
[Fate Concealment Mask]
[Item Type]: Special Mission Item
[Can only be used during the Human Player Exclusive Main-Story Mission]
[Effects]:
After equipping the mask, the player will be immediately transported to a special independent spacetime domain.
After equipping the mask, the player’s original appearance will be completely concealed. Their causal trajectory, cultivation level, and entire foundation will also be hidden.
Once the mission ends, the mask will automatically destroy itself.
[Note]: Equipping this item will be regarded as the player automatically accepting the Human Race’s Destiny Epic Legendary Mission!
"Equipping it automatically accepts the mission?"
"And what exactly is this Human Race’s Destiny Epic Legendary Mission?"
Just as Daniel became curious, a mission description appeared before his eyes.
[Mission Description]:
As one of the branches of the Chaos Humans, the Fated Human Race has developed into one of the most powerful Human races in existence.
The greatest expert in the race’s history was known as the Auric Divine Emperor, who possessed T9 Oracle-grade combat strength.
Upon accepting this mission, the player must cross the River of Time and travel to the ancient era to explore.
Fragments of the Greater Cosmic Will can be found throughout the ancient spacetime domain, along with countless opportunities related to the Origin.
Numerous supreme experts capable of traversing spacetime will cross the River of Time and enter this region in search of opportunities.
Every opportunity must be seized through the player’s own combat strength.
This mission has no time limit and carries no penalty for failure.
It also provides no additional rewards.
If the player chooses to return voluntarily, the mission will automatically be considered complete, and the mask will immediately destroy itself.
After reading the mission description, Daniel was filled with complicated emotions.
"What does it mean by competing for opportunities against all kinds of supreme experts who can traverse spacetime?"
"Isn’t this basically forcing me to undertake an absurdly dangerous enhancement mission?"
He could not help cursing inwardly.
"I’m still only an ordinary Divine-grade expert, yet it already wants me to complete a mission this dangerous?"
Daniel remembered the relevant information very clearly.
Anyone capable of freely traversing spacetime had to possess the strength of at least a T8 high-stage Oracle-grade expert.
Admittedly, Daniel currently owned numerous Oracle-grade treasures.
However, the number of T8 and T9 Oracle-grade treasures in his possession was extremely limited.
When he had previously emptied the entire inventory of the Golden Holy Merchant, he had found only a handful of T8 treasures and a few ordinary T9 treasures.
Although Daniel possessed an enormous number of low-stage Oracle-grade treasures, high-stage treasures were exceedingly rare.
Such items could only be found by chance.
Their availability depended entirely upon how many treasures the ancient experts of the past had left behind.
In other words, Daniel’s current combat strength was still insufficient to truly contend against T8 or T9 Oracle-grade experts.
Of every mission Daniel had ever completed, this one was undoubtedly the most unbalanced.
Its difficulty had completely exceeded any reasonable standard.
If the System possessed a review function, he would definitely give the mission the worst possible rating.
"An Epic Legendary Mission involving the Fated Human Race..."
Daniel drew in a long breath.
The karmic implications surrounding this mission were extraordinarily profound.
Not only did it involve the Fated Human Race, but it also mentioned the Auric Divine Emperor.
Daniel had not forgotten that he had once personally witnessed the Auric Divine Emperor within a past instance.
At that time, Auric had practically torn open the River of Time itself and descended directly into the mortal world.
He had protected the Destiny Spirit Pearl and placed it within the core of the Vescar Star.

chapters.title: Chapter 438 -438-Crossing the River of Time
paragraphs: Back then, the Auric Divine Emperor had been virtually unrivaled beneath the heavens.
To protect the Human Race, he had torn out his own eyes as the price before rushing to the Endless Battlefield and slaughtering powerful enemies.
At the time, Daniel’s strength had not yet reached that level.
He had merely assumed that Auric was an unparalleled expert.
He had never imagined that the man was actually a supreme T9 Oracle-grade powerhouse.
The spacetime targeted by this mission happened to be the ancient era in which Auric had lived.
There should be plenty of information regarding the Auric Holy Land within that ancient era.
Perhaps Daniel could use this opportunity to uncover further clues.
"Perhaps the Auric Holy Land’s trajectory of fate in this era differs from the one I witnessed."
"At this point in time, Auric probably hasn’t been suppressed by experts from beyond the domain and driven into the Myriad-Star Cosmos."
"I may even have the opportunity to witness him at the height of his glory."
Daniel silently contemplated the possibilities.
Since wearing the mask would allow him to cross the River of Time and enter that ancient territory, there was no reason for him to refuse.
As long as he kept a low profile, surely he would not end up being hunted by an entire group of T8 and T9 Oracle-grade experts.
With that thought, Daniel looked down at the mask in his hand.
It appeared to have been forged from an ancient bronze material and could cover only the area from his forehead to the bridge of his nose.
Countless multicolored lights formed from Origin laws flowed across its surface.
One glance was enough to tell that it was an extraordinary treasure.
"Forget it. I should set this aside for now."
"There are still many matters within the Flying Fish Star System that require my attention."
"Before leaving, I need to settle everything here."
Daniel immediately summoned Ian and Aldrich.
During this period, the two trusted subordinates had helped him suppress numerous rebel forces throughout the various territories.
They had already become his most dependable right-hand men.
Daniel naturally harbored no doubts toward either of them.
He directly took out several high-stage Oracle-grade treasures and handed them over.
"Master, what is this?"
Ian looked at the high-stage Oracle-grade treasures in his hands, overwhelmed by the unexpected favor.
Daniel answered calmly,
"I need to leave for a period of time."
"While I am away, the two of you must ensure the security and defenses of the entire territory."
"There can be no mistakes."
Ian and Aldrich immediately dropped to one knee.
They swore that they would protect the Flying Fish Universe with their lives.
After confirming who would be responsible for guarding his territory, Daniel summoned every Oracle-grade expert under his command.
"I will be leaving for some time."
"During my absence, drive away or annihilate any faction that comes here with hostile intentions."
"However, none of you are permitted to provoke trouble without reason."
"You are especially forbidden from starting a war over some trivial matter."
"That does not mean you should fear war if it comes to us."
"There are no cowards within the Stellar Throne."
"Understood, Master!"
The gathered Oracle-grade experts dropped to one knee and accepted his command with complete confidence.
Even now, they merely assumed that Daniel needed to travel somewhere temporarily.
None of them imagined that he intended to enter the extraordinarily dangerous ancient spacetime.
As a result, they took no special precautions to conceal the news.
Word that Daniel would be leaving soon quickly began to spread.

However, Daniel’s strength had already inspired such overwhelming terror that even after learning the Stellar Throne would temporarily be without him, none of the surrounding factions dared covet the Flying Fish Starfield.
They did not even possess the courage to watch from the sidelines.
Once everything had been properly arranged, Daniel finally had time to travel to the ancient era.
Inside his private palace, he put on the Fate Concealment Mask without alerting anyone.
"Countless opportunities of the Origin—I’m coming!"
"I hope I can truly witness the power of the Auric Holy Land this time."
"As for the causal trajectory of the Fated Human Race..."
"I will rewrite it with my own hands."
The moment the mask covered his face, a humming sound suddenly rang out.
Endless law power instantly enveloped Daniel’s entire body.
He felt an icy sensation spread across the areas covered by the mask.
At the same time, the Origin patterns within his body were activated and began circulating on their own.
In only a few moments, all the Origin within him vanished without a trace.
His body then disappeared completely from where he stood.
His consciousness plunged into the River of Time and began flowing against its current.
Buzz!
When Daniel regained his senses, he discovered that he was standing in the middle of a vast wilderness.
Directly ahead of him, an unfamiliar colossal city-state stood upon the savage land like an enormous beast.
An ancient and majestic notification sounded in his ears.
[Origin Rule of This World: The maximum cultivation level of every being who crosses realms to descend here will be restricted to Divine-grade!]
[The current points ranking has been activated. All realm-crossers may inspect it at their discretion!]
[Obtained points may be used for life-or-death wagers, cross-realm transactions, and the exchange of desired Origin treasures!]
[The temporary Official Promotion System has also been activated!]
[Every increase in official rank will randomly unlock an exclusive Origin talent belonging to one race.]
[The talent’s ownership will be permanently bound to the corresponding race and cannot be changed!]
[Attention: The Official Promotion System is subject to temporary restrictions.]
[No realm-crosser may attain an official rank exceeding the Imperial Tier!]
[The domain-wide Plundering Mechanism has now been activated!]
[Every realm-crosser will receive the negative Spacetime Plundering status. Points may be consumed to delay its corrosion!]
[Warning: Once a realm-crosser becomes completely corrupted by Plundering, their Divine Soul will perish within this world!]
After hearing the rules, shock appeared on Daniel’s face.
The Origin of this world had forcibly restricted every realm-crosser’s maximum strength to Divine-grade.
When he first accepted the mission, Daniel had believed he would have to fight T8 or T9 Oracle-grade experts directly.
Yet now, even those powerful opponents would be suppressed to Divine-grade by the Origin rules of this world.
However, Daniel did not relax because of this.
Even if the cultivation of those T8 and T9 Oracle-grade experts was suppressed, their comprehension of Origin laws and their numerous high-stage Sacred Arts would remain effective.
Ordinary Oracle-grade and Divine-grade experts still had no hope of contending against them.
In other words, those T8 and T9 Oracle-grade experts would still be invincible among others of the same Rank.
Daniel instead turned his attention toward the newly activated Official Promotion System.
"Advancing through the official ranks allows me to unlock talents belonging to the corresponding race..."
The question had only just appeared in his mind when another series of system notifications sounded.
[Your race has been automatically bound: Blue Star Human Race!]
[Attention: Every Origin reward you obtain here will simultaneously belong to and spread across all living members of the Earth Human Race!]
[The random racial Origin talents unlocked through promotion may also be lost.]
[If your official rank is reduced, one activated Human racial talent will be randomly erased!]
[After you safely leave this world, every awakened talent you retain will become permanently effective for the entire Earth Human Race!]

chapters.title: Chapter 439 -439-The Ancient City
paragraphs: "Hiss—!"
After hearing the explanation in his ears, Daniel could not help drawing in a sharp breath.
He had never imagined that every action he took and every opportunity he encountered here would affect the entire Earth Human Race.
For example, continuously advancing through the official ranks would unlock more Origin talents for Humanity.
The more talents he obtained, the stronger the Human Race as a whole would become.
However, if his official rank fell, the talents he had already unlocked would disappear as well.
That would be equivalent to weakening the entire Human Race.
"This is a tremendous amount of pressure."
Although Daniel did not possess an especially strong sense of belonging toward Humanity as a whole, he still felt an inexplicable burden settle upon his shoulders.
He drew in a deep breath before asking another question.
"Besides slowing the corrosion of Spacetime Plundering, what other uses do points have?"
Sure enough, another system notification sounded in his ears.
[Helpful Reminder: Points can only be obtained through rewards issued by the Holy See.]
[Points may be used as currency in transactions between all realm-crossers.]
[Points may also be exchanged for Origin treasures and cultivation resources desired by realm-crossers.]
[Points may be used to participate in challenges within the Life-and-Death Wagering Arena!]
After hearing the explanation regarding points, Daniel finally understood the general situation.
Curious, he opened the newly activated realm-crosser points ranking.
However, the ranking was completely empty.
There was not a single name on it.
It seemed that all the realm-crossers had only just arrived, and none of them had obtained any points yet.
After inspecting the earlier rules, Daniel finally turned his attention to the last one.
"What exactly are Spacetime Plundering and Plundering Corrosion?"
The system responded once more.
[The Heavenly Origin of this realm is the Terminal Origin of all spacetime.]
[The universe is born from the laws of the Terminal Origin of spacetime, and it will ultimately return to that terminal point through the laws of spacetime.]
[Spacetime Plundering is one of the forms through which a universe meets its end.]
[Every realm-crosser within this world will gradually develop a special form of Spacetime Plundering within their body.]
[They will slowly suffer from Plundering Corrosion and gradually become assimilated by it.]
[This process will not affect combat strength or lifespan.]
[However, once the assimilation is complete, both body and soul will be utterly extinguished.]
[A completely new soul will then be born within the original body, possessing no connection whatsoever to its former owner.]
After hearing the system’s explanation, Daniel understood.
Spacetime Plundering would effectively kill the original soul within the body and allow a new one to take its place.
Once the process was complete, the original person would cease to exist entirely.
Daniel immediately swept his body with his Divine Soul.
Sure enough, deep within his sea of consciousness, he discovered an almost imperceptible gray-white seed of Spacetime Plundering slowly taking root.
"Damn it. I didn’t expect there to be such a deadly side effect."
"If I ignore it, it will eventually erase me completely."
"I must obtain enough points to slow the corrosion."
"And judging from the situation, resisting it will probably require an enormous number of points."
"This mission is far more demanding than I expected."
Daniel’s expression became extremely grim.
He had originally believed that he had come here to harvest the opportunities of an entire era.
Instead, he had encountered a fatal survival crisis the moment he arrived.
"If I want points, I have no choice but to enter the Holy See and raise my official rank."
Daniel turned his gaze toward the colossal city in the distance.
If his guess was correct, the Holy See should be located within it.
The instant his gaze landed upon the city, another notification sounded.
[This territory is known as the Eternal Domain.]
[Eighty percent of its lands are governed by the Eternal Holy See.]
[The ruler of the Eternal Holy See is an Emperor whose Rank has reached the half-step Eternal level.]
[The current objective of all realm-crossers is to ascend to the pinnacle of imperial authority and become the foremost official beneath the Emperor alone.]
Daniel fell silent upon hearing that objective.
Had the System inexplicably sent him here to seize political power?
"This doesn’t seem to have anything to do with the Fated Human Race or the Auric Divine Emperor."
"Could the Fated Human Race be one of the races under the Eternal Holy See?"
"Or perhaps the Auric Divine Emperor is currently the leader of Humanity?"
Daniel could not make sense of it.
In the end, he simply stopped thinking about it.
He cleared the chaotic thoughts from his mind and focused on his most immediate objective.
"First, I need to make sure I can enter the Eternal Holy See."
Just as Daniel began considering how to gain entry, a violent Origin fluctuation suddenly erupted from within the distant city.
Immediately afterward, a series of furious battle cries rang out.
"Kill!"
"Quickly! We cannot allow the target to escape!"
"If the mission fails, every one of us will be executed!"
"He fled in that direction! Hurry and chase him!"
The moment Daniel heard the cries of battle, the instincts he had developed through years of warfare immediately sharpened.
In times of chaos, opportunities were often hidden within every conflict.
It seemed that his first opportunity had already arrived.
With that thought, Daniel transformed into a streak of light and rushed toward the battlefield.
The moment he entered the city, he realized just how vast it truly was.
The city-state was practically a miniature world of life, with walls reaching more than ten thousand meters into the sky.
Fortunately, even with his strength restricted to Divine-grade, Daniel could still cross tens of millions of miles with ease.
He soon arrived at the battlefield.
Two clearly opposing camps appeared within his field of vision.
One side wore identical azure guard armor.
They appeared to belong to the imperial forces, and every one of them was a Divine-grade expert.
The opposing side consisted of countless masked figures dressed entirely in black.
Their auras were strange and unnatural, and they vastly outnumbered the imperial guards.
"Their auras seem somewhat similar to mine."
Naturally, Daniel did not assume they were his allies.
He immediately realized that they were his competitors—
Realm-crossers from another plane.
However, their numbers were truly astonishing.
Compared with the vast group before him, Daniel looked pitifully alone.
At this moment, the imperial guards had divided into two groups.
The majority were desperately resisting the black-clad realm-crossers.
The smaller group was risking their lives to protect a young man dressed in luxurious robes.
Daniel swept his gaze across the battlefield and quickly took in the entire situation.
He first identified the strongest experts on both sides.
Both were only at the peak of Divine-grade.
Although they were unrivaled among everyone present, to Daniel, they were merely somewhat troublesome opponents.
Overall, no one on the battlefield was capable of truly contending against him.
Daniel relaxed slightly before turning his attention toward the luxuriously dressed young man.
Even a fool could see that the man possessed an extraordinarily noble identity.
He was most likely a prince of the Holy See.
"This man may be my first opportunity."
"As expected, every conflict in a chaotic age conceals fortune and opportunity."
The corners of Daniel’s lips rose slightly.
As he watched the prince, he had already begun considering how to use him as a path into the Holy See.
